sanskrit: papraccha girijā kāntaṃ pārvatī vṛṣabhadhvajam sūcitaṃ yoginītantraṃ tanme vada jagadguro vārāṇasyāṃ kāmarūpe [kāmākhyāyāṃ] nepāle mandarācale pāvanaṃ paramaṃ dhanyaṃ mokṣaikaphaladāyakam yathānyo labhate naivaṃ tathā kuru priyaṃvade kāṅkṣanti devatāḥ sarvāḥ śrotuṃ tantramanuttamam kathayāmi tava snehāt baddhoḥaṃ paramaṃ tvayā lolajihvāṃ ghora rāvāmāraktalocanatrayām amākalāsamullāsa kirīṭojjvalamaṇḍalām sūryakāntendukāntaughaprollasatkarṇabhūṣaṇām sṛkkadvayagaladraktadhārāvisphuritānanām danturāṃ paramāṃ nityāṃ raktamaṇḍitavigrahām vāmapādaṃ śivahṛdi dakṣiṇe lokalāñchitam koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ samastabhuvanojjvalam vidyutpuñjasamānābhajvalajjaṭavirājitam rajatādrisamaṃ devaṃ sphaṭikācalavigraham digambaraṃ mahāghoraṃ candrārkaparimaṇḍitam yoganidrādharaṃ śambhuṃ smerānanasaroruham aśeṣabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaprakāśitamahojjvalām [-mahojjvalam] koṭikoṭiśaraccandranyakkṛtamukhamaṇḍalām āraktamukhamadyābhirmattabhiranvitāṃ [-anvagāṃ ca va] tathā gṛhītaśavakaṅkālajayaśabdaparāyaṇaiḥ śmaśānālayamadhyasthāṃ brahmādyupaniṣevitām kathayāmi tava snehāt na prakāśyaṃ kathañcana gurumūlamidaṃ śāstraṃ gurumūlamidaṃ jagat

gururyasya vaśībhūto devāstaṃ praṇamanti ca pibedamṛtabhavena yaḥ sa devīpuraṃ vrajet prāyaścittaṃ na tatrāpi vede'pi sthita eva hi athavā svamataṃ vedairmahārudravaco yathā advaitaṃ devataiśvaryaṃ nādvaitaṃ guruṇā saha gururgatirgururdevo gururdevo [gururdevī] tathā priye alpajño'nalpavijño vā gurureva sadāgatiḥ gurupatnī maheśāni ! gurureva na saṃśayaḥ bhojanīyaṃ na sandeho vikāraścedadhogatiḥ gurūcchiṣṭaṃ tathā proktaṃ mahāpūtaṃ parāt param gurvantike yadi vaset pañcāśadvarṣamuttame iha bhuktvā varān bhogān ante devīgaṇo [devagaṇo] bhavet asau viharati vīro yāvaccandrārkatārakam tatsutaṃ tattanayāṃ vā praṇamedvidhipūrvakam yatrāśāyāṃ guroḥ sthānaṃ nityaṃ prātaśca tanmukhaḥ praṇamed bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sa siddho nā'tra saṃśayaḥ vṛkṣālī kalpavṛkṣālī latā kalpalatā smṛtā gurugehe sthitā dāsyo bhairavyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ pradakṣiṇī kṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā tvatto'pyadhika evāyaṃ gurustvayā prakīrtitaḥ guruḥ sa eva deveśi sarvamantre'dhunā paraḥ mahāśaive ca saure ca sa gururnātra saṃśayaḥ mantrapradānakāle hi mānuṣe [mānuṣo] naganandini atastu gurutā devi mānuṣe [mānuṣī na] nātra saṃśayaḥ tajjñānaṃ kurute devi śiṣyo'pi śīrṣapaṅkaje

adhiṣṭhānaṃ bhavettasya mānuṣasya maheśvari viśeṣamanuvakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ gurugocaram brahmayogapradāne [brahmavidyā] tu maryādā daśa pauruṣī gurupādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrthāvagāhanam potaṃ pūtañca kurute sarvapāpebhya eva hi guroḥ pādarajo mūrdhni dhārayed yastu mānavaḥ tenaiva rajasā devi tilakaṃ yastu kārayet tadrajo bhakṣate yena ekasmin divase'pi ca gopanīyaṃ prayatnena svakīyaṃ kulapauruṣam śrutaṃ te gurumāhātmyaṃ guhyād guhyataraṃ yat kathitā sā mahāvidyā siddhavidyā ca yāmale ājñāpaya mahādeva rahasyaṃ kṛpayā śiva yāmāsādya ca nirvāṇamuktimeti narādhamaḥ rahasyaṃ kathyate devi sarvalokā upāsakāḥ sā kālīnāṃ sahasrāṇi japyānāñca [japyāni ca] hi koṭiśaḥ kālī ca jagatāṃ mātā sarvaśāstreṣu niścitā vyajasi [tyajasi] tvaṃ parañcaitat pumāṃsaṃ paramaṃ tathā kālividyāṃ samāsādya na tyakṣati kadācana mantragrahaṇamātre tu sarve śivasamāḥ kila kālīmantragrahādeva [tvanmantragrahaṇādeva] sarve śivasamāḥ kila tasyaiva jananī dhanyā pitā tasya surottamaḥ yena bhāgyavaśād devi kālī sā vā [sā vā bhaktyā] samāśritā kadāsmākaṃ kule putraḥ kālīmantramupāśrayet kālī tārā yathācchinnā guruśca bhūpatistathā tārāśiṣyastyajet kālīṃ kālīśiṣyastu tāriṇīm

yadi vā pūjyate devi nānyad vai na prapūjayet yā kālī paramā vidyā saiva tārā na saṃśayaḥ uktaṃ tat kālikākalpe tārākalpe ca te mayā viśeṣato mahādeva rahasyaṃ japamarmaṇaḥ tasyāḥ pratinidhirdevi mahāśaṅkhamayī śubhā tadabhāve vīravandye sphāṭikī sarvasiddhidā pañcaviṃśatibhirmokṣaḥ puṣṭistu saptaviṃśabhiḥ aṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvā siddhireva maheśvari daśanairyadi kartavyā dantasaṃkhyā tathā priye anyatrāpi ca deveśi merutvenaivamādiśet tat śṛṇuṣva maheśāni krameṇa kathayāmi te sarvatra parisaṃkhyeyamaviśeṣaṃ maheśvari śatādipratisaṃkhyāyāmaṣṭottaraṃ japet priye japānte ca tathā mālāṃ śivasya [śirasi] dhārayettataḥ devyai samarpayed dhīmān phalaṃ tajjapakarmaṇaḥ uktaṃ sarasvatītantre tasmājjānīhi kāmini śṛṇuṣva parameśāni sarva tantraprasiddhaye [mantra] tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ prajapeddaśaparvabhiḥ aṣṭottaraṃ japeddevi ādyantadvitayaṃ tyajet anāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhādita [kaniṣṭhādikrameṇa] eva ca madhyamādvitayaṃ [tarjanīdvitayaṃ] parva tarjanyāḥ parameśvari aṣṭottarajape parva ādyantadvitayaṃ tyajet kāmyamapi kare kuryānmālābhāve ca matpriye snānaṃ satarpaṇaṃ homo balistṛptiśca nityabhāk kevalañcānulomena prajapet karamālayā

śaktimantraṃ japeddevi śaktisambhavamālayā śaktimālayā] sāvitrījapane śastā sarvadā karamālayā vaiṣṇave tulasīmālā gajadantairgaṇeśvare śmaśānadhuttūrabījaiḥ śastā dhūmāvatījape śastā ca bagalāmukhyāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ maheśvari na samyak phalabhāgbhūyāt tasmānniyamamācaret sakuśaṃ saphalaṃ devi gṛhītvācamya kalpataḥ yajñāsāvadano(?) [yakṣāsāvadanī] vāpi devendravadano'pi vā ādyantakālamuccārya gotraṃ nāma ca kāminām cāndraḥ saurastu sarvatra cāndraḥ syāttithicodane ṛṇadāne tathādāne pauṣṭapathyādiṣu priye māso nākṣatrikaḥ proktaḥ sāvano varṣaparvaṇi saure māsi śubhā dīkṣā na cāndre na ca tārake kriyāvatī vedamayī cāndramāse'pi śasyate prātaḥ kālaṃ samārabhya yāvanmadhyandinaṃ raveḥ krūrakarmāṇi kurvīta śeṣe'pi parameśvari kālo naktaṃ japasyoktaṃ pūjākālamiti śṛṇu pūjākālo bhavedyāmaścaturvargapradaḥ sadā sā mahārātriruddiṣṭā tat kṛtaṃ cākṣayaṃ phalam tatsarvamakṣayaṃ yāti tathānantyāya kalpate muktikāmaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe bhaktikāmaḥ site tathā śubhe kāle śubhaṃ sarvamaśubhañcārtibhiścaret vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvadā sarvamācaret viśeṣañca [aviśeca] divārātrau sandhyāyāñca mahāniśi

kāśyāñca nodeti kadā sandhiyogādvarānane [sandhiyogo-] āyāmaprasthato devi nityeyaṃ nityadā śubhe [śubhā] brahmāṇḍaṃ sthāpayettatra sakūṭaṃ vastumānavam sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ dvijārpaṇaṃ niṣkāme [niṣkāmo] karmabandhaśca sarvaṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam mṛtaṃ pūtaṃ nayet kāśyāṃ mukto mamopadeśataḥ tatra yadyatkṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ labhet tatra sāṃyogikaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra caiva vimucyate svalpatve tithikālatve kriyākālagatirbhavet sandhyāyāṃ patitāyāntu gāyatrīṃ daśadhā japet itaḥ parataraṃ kiñcit tad brūyāstava mānase yuddhasya vāraṇaṃ deva jvarādivāraṇaṃ tathā nāśutrātā [nāsti] ca jagatāṃ tvāṃ vinā parameśvara prākṛtenaiva vākyena kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva tat grahajvarādibhūteṣu sarvakarmasu yojayet datte ca siddhihāniḥ syāt yoginīnāṃ bhavet paśuḥ sadācāraratāya ca nirjitāśeṣaśatrave idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi jagadvaśyakaraṃ param nāradena purā puṣṭaṃ mattaḥ kailāsamūrdhani tenaiva kavacenaiva nārado brahmasambhavaḥ tadasambhavamālokya viṣṇurāha vidheḥ sutam tatsarvamabhavad viṣṇau viṣṇurāha samudrajām papraccha nārado dhīmān sarvalokahite rataḥ kimetasyāḥ phalaṃ deva kimetanmohanaṃ bhavet trikāle gopitaṃ devi kāle kāle prakāśitam

tacchṛṇuṣva muniśreṣṭha trailokyamohanaṃ tvidam kavacairvarjitaṃ yatra tatra māṃ pātu kālikā eteṣāṃ [ityetat] paramaṃ mohaṃ bhavadbhāgye prakāśitam idaṃ kavacamajñātvā pūjayed vīrakāminīm alpāyuḥ sa bhavedrogī kathitaṃ tava nārada samantrakavacaṃ dhṛtvā icchāsiddhiḥ prajāyate kavacasyāsya māhātmyaṃ nālaṃ vaktuṃ mahāmune idaṃ kalpadrumaṃ devi [deva] tava snehāt prakāśyate gopanīyaṃ prayatnena paṭhanīyaṃ [paṭhayecca] mahāmune avaśyaṃ vaśamāyāti trailokyaṃ te carācaram tatpāṭhānnāradenāpi mohitañca carācaram narāṇāmupakārāya brūhi yogaṃ suvistaram yenāśu labhate kīrtiṃ yenāśu labhate'khilam uktaṃ phetkāriṇītantre nīlatantre ca vistaram vā pated bhuvi] yogarājo maheśāni avyartho me sadaiva hi kuliśaṃ devarājasya tathā yogo mayoditaḥ tathaiva niścito devi yogo'yaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ayaṃ yogavaro devi tathaiva parikīrtitaḥ āyāmaprasthito devi ṣoḍaśāṅgulasammite tathāyānamite devi tad vattāmre vināśane likhenmantraṃ varārohe tāriṇyāḥ sarvasiddhidam vṛddhyarthī vilikheddevi lekhinyā sumanoharam uttarāśāmukho bhutvā pūjayitvā ca tāriṇīm kāśmīraṃ kasturīṃ lākṣāṃ sindūrañca varānane

tanmadhye vilikhettārāṃ sārdhavedākṣarīṃ parām sādhyaṃ likhettacca sādhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva śambhuvallabhe p. 21) amukasyāmukaṃ jñānaṃ siddhiṃ kuru ca kurviti amukasyāmukaṃ dhanaṃ dehi dehīti kāmini klībahīnāt dīrghavarṇān ṣaṭkoṇe ṣaṭsamālikhet aṣṭapatraṃ likhettatra kiñjalkayugalaṃ yugam tathā caturasraṃ caturdvāramevaṃ yantraṃ samālikhet gurau śukre tathā some maṅgale vada budheḥni ca pītavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya jatunā pariveṣṭayet svarṇapīṭheṣu saṃsthāpya saṃkhyānamācaret kṛtī vidīrṇaṃ laṅghitaṃ vāpi naiva kuryāt kadācana ghaṭaṃ kuryāt prayatnena sarvadṛṣṭimanoharam tāmreṇa caiva yuddhārthī mṛdānyatra [mṛdāpyanyatra] ghaṭañcaret dhānyaṃ kṣiptvā mukhaṃ tasya pallavaiḥ pratipādayet aṣṭāṅgulasvarṇapatre caturasraṃ samantataḥ catuḥṣaṣṭyupacāreṇa yajettārāṃ parāṃ śivām rājake puṣpake devi ṣoḍaśācchādanaṃ kule nivedayenmahāyuktyā balimantreṇa mantravit aṣṭottarasahasrantu hutvā sādhakasattamaḥ bhūmiṃ grāmamitāṃ dadyād rājyamicchati kāmukaḥ śālagrāmaśilāmekāṃ svarṇarekhādyalaṅkṛtām bhojayed brāhmaṇān dhīraḥ kumārīḥ kalpapallave [kalpapallavi] ityevaṃ kathitaṃ ramyaṃ na devaṃ prāṇasaṅkaṭe idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vīraṣaṭkarmasādhanam

striyāstu siddhasaṃsthānāṃ sarvayogavilāsinām māraṇaṃ parameśāni ṣaṭkarmedaṃ prakīrtitam kathayāmi tava snehāt ataḥ siddhikaraṃ [drutasiddhikaraṃ] param durgā caiva bhadrakālī karmādau karmasiddhaye śūnyāgāre mahāraṇye devatāyatane'pi vā tadabhāve pitṛbhūmau vāsāṃsi kathayāmi te tadabhāve raktakṣaumaṃ nānyad vastraṃ prakalpayet vidveṣoccāṭane tāmraṃ kapālaṃ māraṇe śubham adurbhikṣāvyādhimṛto mālā tasya śubhāvahā mṛdau vā komale vāpi viṣṭare vā sureśvari ekahaste dvihaste vā caturhaste samantataḥ bhaye jāte maheśāni bhairavoktamanu japet sarvabhūtānataḥ kūrcamantrānto bhairavo manuḥ aśvatthena maheśāni tad dharmakīlakañcaret śanau ca māraṇaṃ devi niścitaṃ vīravandite prāgvidvān prajapet samyak svamantramayutaṃ śave tataḥ sādhyadine mantrī yāmamātre gate niśi digvāsāgalitāśeṣacikuraḥ kulakaulikaḥ lakṣasaṃkhye maheśāni śaktipūjāpurassaram māṃsaṃ madyaṃ tathā matsyaṃ huned vahnau śataṃ śatam evamuktavidhānena digbhyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥ nāpekṣā jāyate kānte cāvaśyaṃ phalabhāgbhavet pūjānte satataṃ devi tanmāṃsairvahnimarcayet krameṇa phalamāpnoti vyatyaye pātakī bhavet gopanīyaṃ khale duṣṭe paśupāmarasannidhau

ṣaṭkarmasu yathāyogyaṃ vada me karuṇānidhe stambhane ḍākinī jñeyā vidveṣe pauṣṭikī matā etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devi kathitaṃ kulamohane stambhanoccāṭane devi praśastā nāgavallabhā gaurāṅgī dīrghakeśī yā sadā sāmṛtabhāṣiṇī mantrasiddhikarī hyeṣā śaṅkhinī sāpi bhāvinī samāṅgī śūdradehī ca na kharvā nātidīrghakā kṛṣṇāṅgī ca kṛśāṅgī ca danturā madatāpitā sadā kruddhā dīrghadehā mahārāvaparāyaṇā iyaṃ sā ḍākinī proktā mṛtyuyoge praśasyate grāhyā kularasaiḥ pūjyā bhaktibhāvena kāminī tattanmantraṃ maheśāna yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā vajravairocanīyo yo manurekādaśākṣaraḥ bahunātra kimuktena śṛṇu yatprāṇavallabhe avaśyaṃ phalamāpnoti nānyathā vīravandite bhavedetat maheśāni tadā sarvaṃ vṛthā bhavet tathāpi nahi siddhiḥ syāt citrametannagātmaje śāntaṃ vahnisamāyuktaṃ vāmanetravibhūṣitam kūrcayugmaṃ tato devi amukaṃ māraya māraya khādirāṅgāramādāya kujāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ niśāyāṃ mastake netre lalāṭe hṛdaye kare mantravarṇān samālikhya pratiṣṭhāṃ tatra kārayet dīrghākārāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ sadordhvastanamastakām śatrunāśakarīṃ devīṃ dhyāyecchatrukṣayāya ca oṃ śatrunāśakartryai nama iti dattvā maheśvari

māṃsaṃ khādaya khādaya hrīṃ nama iti mantrataḥ japedekādaśāhe ca rogaḥ syāt nātra saṃśayaḥ athavānyaprakāreṇa śatrukṣayamahaṃ vade viparītakrameṇaiva japapūjādikaṃ caret śivāya nama iti mantreṇa gaṭhanañca samācaret śatrupratikṛtiṃ likhya tatra saṃsthāpayecchivam śatrorvakṣaḥsthitaṃ rudraṃ jvaladagnisamaprabham naracarmāmbaraṃ devaṃ mahāvyālādiveṣṭitam śūlapāṇaye nama iti snāpayet sādhakottamaḥ agnikoṇādiparyantaṃ sūryarītyā maheśvari hu/ kṣamayeti vāmena kareṇa tu visarjayet iti yaḥ śivaḥ nama ityapi sakṛjjapet avaśyaṃ jāyate devi satyaṃ satyaṃ trilocane kumbhakārasya bhavanādānayet piṭhare jalam [śūlam] ānīya ca ūkhāmadhyād bhasma paryuṣitaṃ tathā bhasmopari ca saṃsthāpya vāṭikāyāḥ sureśvari punarmadhyāhnakāle ca nirjane sati bhāvini tattāvatīmahaṃ bhūmiṃ caurebhyo rakṣayāmi ca tāvatīñca tato bhūmiṃ vāmāvartena bhāvini tatraiva nirjane garte śalākāṃ lauhanirmitām saṃsthāpya mṛdbhiḥ saṃpūrya tadgartaṃ gṛhamāvrajet ayaṃ yogavaro devi durlabho vasudhātale dine dine dharmavṛddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tada vadasva maheśvara sārdhayāmagatāyāntu niśāyāṃ sādhakottamaḥ

abhyukṣya mūlamantreṇa śayyāyāṃ tatra saṃviśet parameṣṭhiguruñcaiva vāme'bhyarcya gaṇeśvaram tato māyamāsanāya nama ityarcayecchive likhitvācamya yatnena svamantroktavidhānataḥ pratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ hū/ phaṭ svāhayā yutam aṅganyāsakaranyāsau mātṛkānyāsameva ca dhyātvā bhaktyā samabhyarcya mānasaiḥ sādhakottamaḥ praṇavañca tato devi vaṭukebhyo namastathā tatastu vahnibījena samantājjaladhārayā japaṃ kṛtvā samarpyātha vidhinā parameśvari homañca tarpaṇañcaiva abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ param kāñcanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā chidrāvaraṇamācaret evamuktaṃ mahādevi śayyāsādhanamuttamam atha śṛṇu trivārasya caturvārasya sādhanam praṇamed gurumabhyarcya maṇidharīti mantrataḥ dayāṃ kurvantu te sarve siddhidāśca bhavantu me tataḥ pūrvamukho vāpi uttarāśāmukho'pi vā sthānaṃ sammārjya tatraiva pretabījaṃ likhet sudhīḥ tatropaviśya deveśi hṛdīṣṭadevatāṃ smaret kālyādibhyo maheśāni pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ pūjābalyādikāḥ smṛtāḥ kṛtvā sthānaṃ parityajya devīṃ smṛtvā gṛhaṃ vrajet yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ sādhakānāṃ paraṃ hitam bilvamūlaṃ maheśāni samantāt ṣoḍaśaṃ karam ṛgyajuḥsāmasadṛśaṃ patratrayaṃ varānane

mahālakṣmīrvilvavṛkṣo jātaḥ śrīśailaparvate vṛttāntaṃ paramāścaryaṃ vada me karuṇāmaya satye tu pūjayāmāsa liṅgaṃ rāmeśvarābhidham tatra me'nugrahād vāṇī sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ gatā tādṛk prītirna lakṣmyāñca jāyate keśavasya ca prāptaṃ malliṅgamekānte tapastepe'tidāruṇam tadā sā vṛkṣarūpeṇa sthitā liṅgāgrataḥ satī koṭivarṣe maheśāni tato me'nugraho'bhavat sadaiva parameśāni viharet sā sadaiva hi sadaivāpūjayad mām sā madbhaktā sātulā śive sarvatīrthamayo devi sarvadevamayaḥ sadā tatphalaistatprasūnairvā tatpatrairyaḥ prapūjayet tatkāṣṭhacandanaṃ bhāle yo dhārayati saṃbhramāt atastaccandanaṃ devi dhārayenna kadācana bilvamūle maheśāni prāṇāṃstyajati yo naraḥ atastatsādhanaṃ devi sarveṣāṃ priyakārakam abhyarcya yatnato devi kṣetrapālaṃ prapūjya ca siddhiṃ dehi jagatkartā dehi sthānaṃ namostu te tataḥ sthānantu sampūjya likhettatra varānane tadante mūlamantrañca vilikhet sādhakottamaḥ saṃkalpyāṣṭottarayutaṃ japtvā cchidrāvadhārayet ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ sārāt sāraṃ parāt param idānīṃ śṛṇu deveśi muṇḍasādhanamuttamam naramahiṣamārjāramuṇḍatrayaṃ varānane śivāsarpasārameyanṛṇāṃ [vṛṣabhānāṃ] bhavā maheśvari

athavā parameśāni narāṇāṃ pañcamuṇḍakān niyutañcāthavā koṭiṃ nṛmuṇḍān parameśvari āyāmaprasthito devi caturhastau samācaret tataḥ paraṃ mahādevi śatahastamitāñcaret pūrvoktabhūtanāthāya namo mantreṇa deśikaḥ evantu dakṣiṇe devi śmaśānādhipamādarāt śmaśānamuttare tadvat pūjayitvā baliṃ dadet pādyādibhiranenaiva kuṇḍebhyaḥ paripūjayet tatraiva pūjayed bhaktyā bhāratīṃ svasvavigrahām [śubha] anena manunābhyarcya baliṃ tasyai nivedayet dayāṃ kuru mahābhāga siddhido bhava majjaye śave kuryād vahnisaṃsthaṃ pāśamindukalānvitam pādyādibhiranenaiva kuṇḍebhyaḥ paripūjayet vāyavye hrīṃ bhadrakālyai namo mantreṇa tatparam agnau hrīṃ caṇḍogrāyai namo mantreṇa sādhakaḥ śmaśānavāsino ye ye devā devyaśca bhairavāḥ anena praṇavādyena puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet viṣṭarāsanamāstīrya upaviśya maheśvari sthānaṃ pariṣkṛtya natvā devīṃ dhyāyan gṛhaṃ vrajet kīlakaṃ naiva kuryāttu trimuṇḍopari karhicit bilvamūle śmaśāne vā nirjane caikaliṅgake evaṃ vā prothayitvā ca nāraṃ muṇḍaṃ vidhānataḥ yat kṛtvā sarvasiddhānāmadhipo bhuvi jāyate gurustvaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ karuṇāmayasāgara tvayā tatra viśeṣeṇa vada me candraśekhara

tadyogādabhavat kaulo divyavīro maheśvari samāyogī [sa no yogī bhaved] yajeddevi mumukṣuḥ kulakāmini ātmānaṃ paramaṃ brahma cintayedathavā na cet divyayogamidaṃ devi sāvadhānena gopaya bindutrayaṃ kalākrāntaṃ prathamaṃ paricintayet bālārkakoṭisaṃjyotiḥ prakāśitadigambaram binduyāvanmadhyadehaṃ kaṇṭhādikaṭiśīrṣakam yonyādikañca pādāntaṃ kāmāntaṃ paricintayet evaṃ kāmakalārūpaṃ svātmadehaṃ vicintayet saṃkṣepāt kathayiṣyāmi tayorācāramuttamam idamācaraṇaṃ devi paśorna divyavīrayoḥ yadi daivād maheśāni madyādi ca na labhyate tathāpi na hi vaktavyamidamācamanaṃ śive tasmād madyādikaṃ devi sevitavyaṃ dine dine guruṇā dīkṣito bhūtvā kaulanyāsaṃ samācaret mayoktaṃ tat krameṇaiva abhiṣekadvayaṃ caret divyaṃ vā vīrayogaṃ vā yathā karmānusārataḥ yastu divyo bhavet satyaṃ sa viṣṇurnātra saṃśayaḥ yatra deśe narastiṣṭhed divyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥ siddhikṣetraṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ samantāddaśayojanam yoginī durlabhāpyetadḍākinībhiḥ sarīsṛpaiḥ guhyakairdānavairvāpi mārībhiryakṣakinnaraiḥ [māyābhiḥ] avaśyaṃ maṅgalaṃ tatra tatpurīparivardhanam sphuranti sarvaśāstrāṇi sarvasmādapi nityaśaḥ taravo'pi hi jīvanti paśuḥ pakṣī sa jīvati

yatra kutra mṛto devi divyo vā vīrapuṅgavaḥ kuladharmamimaṃ devi saṃsevyaṃ sanirantaram munayo mānavo nāgāḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ kuladharmaprasādena te sarve kulanāyakāḥ ye yathā māṃ prapadyante te tathā phalabhāginaḥ vānaprastho patiścaiva bhaveyuste kulānugāḥ guḍārdrakarasenaiva surā tu brāhmaṇasya ca vaiśyasya mākṣikaṃ proktaṃ kāṃsyasthaṃ varavarṇini bhūrjadhānyādikaṃ yadyaccarvaṇīyaṃ pracakṣate brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇasyaiva kṣatriyā kṣatriyasya ca trivarṇānāṃ maheśvari śūdrā vā brāhmaṇādīnāṃ trivarṇānāmabhāvataḥ trivarṇavihitānāñca yatīnāṃ śṛṇu samprati maithunaṃ paramaṃ [śayanaṃ] divyaṃ yatīnāṃ parikīrtitam pauṣṭikādīni sarvāṇi madyāni tasya śāmbhavi pūrvoktā ca bhavenmudrā devatā sādarānvitā kṣatayonistāḍitavyā akṣatāṃ naiva tāḍayet dvādaśābdādhikā yoniryāvat ṣaṣṭiḥ prajāyate avadhūtasamācārāḥ śūdre sarvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ brāhmaṇīṃ kṣatriyāṃ vaiśyāṃ tyaktvā tu sarvajātiṣu gṛhamedhī bhavecchudro nānyāśramī bhavet kadā guruvad dve trivarṇe tu tathā mātāmahe kule kālī tārā chinnamastā sundarī bhairavī tathā etāsāṃ sādhakācāraścāvadhūtaḥ samaḥ smṛtaḥ sarvasthāneṣu sarvatra na viśeṣaṃ kvacid bhavet

evaṃ vipro devatāyai svagātrarudhiraṃ dadet p. 44) śaktināśaḥ vikāro'sti svadeharudhirārpaṇe śuddhyādi sakalaṃ devi vyañjakasyāparārdhakam bhairavāya dvitīyena śivatvañca tṛtīyakam pareṇa paratāṃ yāti mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥ jāyante na bhairavāste veśāstatsamadarśinaḥ tathā māyāvṛte vṛtte jñānadīpena dṛśyate [hanyate] jīvanmukto dehabhāvo dehānte kṣemamāpnuyāt brahmadhyānaṃ maheśāni brahmanirvāṇakāraṇam svakīyajīvadehādi brahmāṇḍo'nanta eva ca na cintanīyaṃ tatsarvaṃ nāstīti paribhāvayet ahameva jālarūpaścādhāradehavarjitaḥ brahmadhyānamidaṃ proktametat sthiratarāya ca kṣaṇaṃ brahmāhamasmīti yaḥ kuryādātmacintanam mayā vā brahmaṇā vāpi viṣṇunāpi kathañcana dravyābhāve maheśāni jalenāpi samācaret vakṣye'yutavidhiṃ bhadre śṛṇuṣva kamalānane pibed yogī maheśāni satyaṃ satyaṃ śivaḥ [varānane] svayam pāpapuṇyaṃ paśuṃ hatvā jñānakhaḍgena śāmbhavi manasā sendriyaṃ sarvaṃ saṃyamyātmani yojayet aśeṣabrahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ parabrahmaṇi saṃnayet gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ mama sarvasvasādhanam jāyāśeṣa jagannātha bhaktavatsala īśvara divyavīraprabhedena śrutaṃ yogadvayaṃ mayā āsaphalaṃ sādhanañca vada me parameśvara

svāhā tadante svapurāvāhi kāli sambodhanadvayam dehi padāt kālībījamante vahnivadhūntathā mahācamatkārakarī mahākālena bhāṣitā tataḥ siddhā bhaved vidyā svapne tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ mṛtasañjīvanīṃ vidyāmataḥ śṛṇu nagātmaje amṛtaṃ bījamābhāṣya mṛtasañjīvanīti ca sasupteyaṃ mahāvidyā sārātsārataraṃ smṛtam nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japamātreṇa śāmbhavi siddhidā sā bhavedvidyā mṛtasañjīvanī tataḥ mantraṃ japan spṛśecchavaṃ tadā devi varānane vakṣye madhumatīṃ vidyāṃ sarvarañjanakāriṇīm trailokyākarṣiṇī vidyā prokteyaṃ devadurlabhā tataḥ siddhā mahāvidyā sarvajñānaprakāśinī nadīṃ ratnāni ca purīṃ striyaḥ śailān vanaspatīn purasthānaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ rājñāñca vidviṣāmapi naktaṃ talpaśatajapāt siddhiṃ prāpnoti sādhakaḥ paśyāvatīmahāvidyāṃ sarvavidyāvinodinīm praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tadantaram trailokyavārtāmante ca kathaya dvandvamuccaret aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityaṃ japedvarṣadvayaṃ priye talpe sthitvā naktayoge japed mantraṃ śatāṣṭakam vṛttāntaṃ kathayet svapne vidyā padmāvatī śubhā alpasādhyaṃ mahādeva drutasiddhikaraṃ mahat purā te kathitaṃ devi yogināṃ jñānasambhavam

gopitavyaṃ prayatnena sarvadā paśusaṅkule śatrunāma likhitvā tu vāmapādatale nyaset aṣṭottaraśataṃ devi tadā vādī vaśo bhavet tārkṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā sarpo jaḍo bhavati kāmini tathānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi vaśīkaraṇamuttamam praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya sundarī bhairavī tathā vaśaṅkari tathā procya aṃ iṃ ṛṃ tathā vadet anena manunā devi tailañca candanañca vā taccandanena tilakaṃ bhāle dadyānnagātmaje cettu paśyati yaṃ devi sa vaśo nātra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ punarmānavān devi sārvabhaumān narādhipān sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ devi mohanaṃ paramādbhutam praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya vadedrājamukhīpadam kāmabījaṃ tataḥ paścāddevī devīpadadvayam sambodhanāntaṃ deveśi padametaccatuṣṭayam svāhānto'yaṃ mahāmantraḥ sarvavaśyaprado mahān trivāraṃ dakṣahastena mukhaṃ saṃmārjayet kṛtī avaśyaṃ jāyate vaśyaṃ jagadetaccarācaram svāpnavatī ca yā vidyā kathitāvagatā mayā tadvadasva mahādeva yadi te'nugraho mayi praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya vadhūbīja'm samuddharet divā bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ rātrau japtvā sahasrakam manasā cintitaṃ yadyat tat sarvaṃ parameśvari yena vijñānamātreṇa sarvaṃ jānāti niścitam vidhānaṃ pūrvavat sarvaṃ japānte prārthanaṃ śṛṇu

vāmadevasurūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ iti mantreṇa saṃprārthya sarvaṃ jānāti bhāvataḥ [tattvataḥ] rahasyaṃ paramaṃ ramyaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam nirantaraṃ mahādevi sevitaḥ siddhaśaṅkaraiḥ yācantaṃ parameśāni tasmāttvāṃ samupāśrayet tvāṃ japantu tato [vinā] devi phalasiddhiḥ samīritā siddhavidyāprabhāveṇa syuḥ susiddhāḥ surāsurāḥ gopanīyaṃ khale duṣṭe paśupāmarasannidhau tasmāt sarvaprayatnena gopanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ bhaktāya pāpahīnāya sādhakāya mahātmane devadānavagandharvasiddhacāraṇasevitam paraṃ pāraṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ mahat kathayasya mahādeva kevalānandavṛṃhitam atyantaguhyaṃ paramaṃ devāsurabhayaṅkaram śṛṇu vakṣyāmi cārvaṅgi samāsena śivapriye brahmāṇḍasyāyuṣaḥ śeṣe sarva sattvavivarjitam tvāṃ māṃ vinā maheśāni nāsīt kiñcijjagattraye mamādhikā yogyatā vā tavāpi vā maheśvari sthātuṃ sthānaṃ na kutrāsti kutra sthāsyāmi bhāvini viviktoḥaṃ sadā divye [devi] bhavasaṃsārakarmaṇi iti śrutvā tadā devī krodhenāruṇalocanā yad yat kṛtaṃ tvayā deva māmupāśritya sarvadā yoge hi te maheśāni mayā sarvamidaṃ tatam kāraṇāvasthayāpannā sadāhaṃ dhāturūpiṇī [dhātrīrūpiṇī] kāryabhāvasamāpannā sadā prakṛtirūpiṇī

mama māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ devacarācaram iti śrutvā vacasteḥaṃ vajratulyaṃ sudāruṇam vāritoḥaṃ [paritoḥaṃ] sadā devi duḥkhenāntarajena ca jagāma paścime bhāge brahmāṇḍasya varānane svadehabhasmanā daityaṃ prāgadṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā [mudam] koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaprasthitam pañcāśallakṣavadanaṃ jvālāvalisamākulam sarvabhāvairmatsadṛśaṃ vidhāya taṃ sudāruṇam so'pi tasthau dānavendraḥ śayyāṃ kṛtvā jalārṇave tadā mama mano jñātvā tvamavādīśca māṃ prati ājñāpaya mahādeva paśyāmi sakalaṃ śiva uvāca tvāmahaṃ bhadre āgaccha paścimāṃ diśam strīṇāṃ svabhāvo deveśi ya evādhaḥ sthito bhavet iti jñātvā mayoktaṃ tanniṣedhavacanaṃ śive tatra gatvā mahādevī jaganmohanakāriṇī karān prasārya sakalān āha cāṭuvaco bhṛśam trāhi māṃ kāmajaladhau nimagnaṃ svāṅgadānataḥ āliṅgya patibhāvena jīvanaṃ rakṣa sundari tataḥ sā tvamavādīśca sakaṭākṣaṃ śucismitam tvaṃ vīryavān sarvavināśanaśca tvāṃ vai varāmo yadi tatkaroṣi sa me hi bhartā na cānya eva tadādito yuddhamitaḥ śrayasva uccairnibhartsayāmāsa pralayāmbhodhighargharam samāhartuṃ tadā daityo dhāvati smākhilaṃ jagat tadā bodhena [vegena] mahatā japtvā [gatvā] ca dānaveśvaraḥ pādāghātāduparatā magnāścaiva jalārṇave

ūrdhvādhaśca kaṭāhāntaṃ mahābhīmataraṅgakam kṣamo'bhavat yadyad yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena kathituṃ naiva śakyate yattejasā maheśāni tatrāpi krodhamūrcchitaḥ āścaryaṃ śṛṇu deveśi yuddhaṃ vṛttaṃ mahojjvalam jalajātāt kaṭāhāttu dhūlirutpadyate [budhirut] bhṛśam ahaṃ yogaṃ samāśritya sūkṣmasūkṣmataraṃ vapuḥ kathañcidapi na prāpya tvāṃ prahartuṃ daityarāṭ tadā vardhayitvā śarīraṃ svaṃ gharṣayitvā ca bāhunā iti sañcintya manasā vardhayitvā kalevaram uvāca tvāṃ tadā daityaḥ hatā yāsyasi kutra vā tvayokto'sau ghoradaityastiṣṭha tiṣṭha sudurmate adhunaiva mahāduṣṭa jānāsi nahi māṃ kadā [kathaṃ] mayaiva pālyate sarvaṃ mama māyāmayaṃ jagat śṛṇu mūḍhavarāsmākaṃ paramaṃ maṅgalaṃ mahat bhajante māṃ yathā ye hi tathā kāmaṃ dadāmi te tvayāhaṃ sevitā daitya bahukālaṃ na saṃśayaḥ śivo'si nātra sandeho yat kṛte yadbhramastava yad dṛṣṭvān punaḥ ko'pi kadāpyāvirbhavet kila tadrūpaṃ paramaṃ dhāma kālī rūpamiti śṛṇu ityuktvāhaṃ tadā devi bhavāni bhavamocanī asakṛt parameśāni jātā tvaṃ kālikā tadā muṇḍamālā valī ramyā muktakeśī smitānanā amākalāsamullāsā kirīṭojjvalavigrahā mahārāvaiścaturdikṣu yātā ghoraparākramaiḥ

samantād ghorarūpasthā mahāyuddhamahotsukāḥ bhāsante satataṃ devi sarvāḥ sūryamayāḥ punaḥ pratīto'sau mahākālyā dṛṣṭvā śrīmukhamaṇḍalam tatastaṃ dānavādhīśaṃ jñāne bhaktaṃ sunirmalam brahmāṇḍasahitaṃ mātā carvayitvā mṛtā kṣaṇāt nānāyantrasya bṛhataḥ patākā vyāpikā sadā ahaṃ jagāma sahasā tatra kāntāramuttamam saṃdṛṣṭañca śrutaṃ yadyat kathituṃ naiva śakyate atīva bṛhadākārāḥ brahmāṇḍāḥ koṭikoṭiśaḥ evañca vividhākārā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ sarvāścaryamayaṃ devi dṛṣṭvā kuśalamānasāḥ ahaṃ kā kutra āyātaḥ ko na pṛcchati kutracit kadā mama] tatra gatvā mayā sarvaṃ dṛṣṭamāścaryasundaram sukhamokṣayoḥ dehaḥpurāṇamaṅgāni smṛtayo yāni yāni ca jīvātmanoryathābhedastathā bhedāgameṣvapi dṛṣṭvā varṇāvalī yātu tīvratejomayī śubhā anyāni sarvaśāstrāṇi kṣudrāṇi yāni kāni ca tato mayā śataṃ devi karṇikāntarmahojjvalam koṭi koṭi mahāvahnitejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitam sūryakoṭisamābhāsaṃcandrakoṭi suśītalam vahnikoṭimahojjvalaṃ paraṃ brahmamayaṃ dhruvam sarvayajñamayaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ sadā brahmajñānamayaṃ devi brahmānandamayaṃ tathā

pramāṇaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ brahmatejaḥ paraṃ hitam sarvamāyāmayaṃ devi sarvavidyāmayaṃ punaḥ sarvamuktimayaṃ devi sarvavedamayaṃ tathā sarvaśāstramayaṃ devi sarvayogamayaṃ tathā gataśarvaryatho'drākṣaṃ yathā sūryodayojjvalam saṃśayaḥ tataḥ ki~jalkapuñjeṣu gatvā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā kila nyāyo mīmāṃsakaṃ sāṃkhye pātañjalaṃ tathā punaḥ tato varṇāvalīṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇikāprāntadeśataḥ āyurvedabhiṣagvedā mayābhyastā tadaiva hi sahasrādityasaṅkāśā śūdravarṇā mahojjvalā mayābhyastaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ tadantare yathā dṛṣṭaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham vedāntamiti vikhyātaṃ varṇapuñjamahāprabham tadantare mayā dṛṣṭaṃ varṇapuñjasamujjvalam sarvajñānamayaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ sadā pramāṇaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ śāstrādīnāṃ maheśvari mayābhyastaṃ hi tat sarvaṃ tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ sarvajñānasarvatattvaṃ sarvasiddhimayo hyaham tata uḍḍīnamāsādya dvidale cāgataṃ mayā tadā mama smṛtirjātā brahmaviṣṇukṛte punaḥ cyutau svedau maheśāni tābhyāṃ jātau guṇocitau tadā tau ca gatau tūrṇaṃ nāsikārandhrayordvayoḥ īḍāyāśca tato viṣṇustatra gatvā ca tau śubhau sadantau satataṃ devi vismṛtaṃ ki bhaviṣyati

tāvīśvarau maheśāni mahāduḥkhena duḥkhitau tasmai dattaṃ mayā jñānaṃ mantraṃ paramamaṅgalam tasmai dattaṃ sarvaśāstraṃ vāṅmātreṇāgamaṃ vinā tamādāya gatastatra brahmāṇḍe parameśvaraḥ mahājñānī mahādevi tatkṣaṇāt sa pitāmahaḥ sa vidhiḥ parameśāni mama śāsanatastadā gatavyathastadā brahmā hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ sadaiva hi tadaṅgīkṛtya tajjñānaṃ saha tābhyāṃ maheśvari śivābhiryoginībhiśca mahānṛtyaparāyaṇā nānāvādyamahollāsā nānālaṅkāragāthikā [-gāyikā] utthitaiḥ patitaiḥ puṣpairdivyagandhairmahotsukā śataśo brahmāṇḍasamā patākābhiśca rañjitā ataḥ stotuṃ samārabdhā vayaṃ kālīṃ karālikām tadādau [tadāsau] vidhirastauṣīt sarvaśāstreṇa bhaktitaḥ yadguṇastvamaho dhātaḥ sarvaśāstrārthavismṛtaḥ ityājñaptastato dhātā kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadā tatastamavravīcchivā dharmajño'si pālakastvaṃ bhava sṛṣṭeśca rakṣakaḥ tatoḥaṃ paramāṃ nityāṃ kālīṃ brahmasanātanīm viṃśakoṭivatsarāṇāṃ māmuvāca tadā tu sā saguṇastvaṃ mahāyogī sṛṣṭisaṃhārako bhava pañcakoṭidivyavarṣaṃ māmuvāca tatastu sā kiṃ prārthyate mahādeva dadāmi nātra saṃśayaḥ tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ mātastvadīyacaraṇāmbuje tat koṭikoṭyaṃśayuddhaṃ kariṣyatyeva yo mayā

bhaviṣyati [bhaviṣyasi] sa [tva] deveśa mahiṣāsuranāmadhṛk tatā taṃ [tvāṃ] nāśayitvāhaṃ bhadrakālī svarūpataḥ idānīṃ tvaṃ mahādeva mama pādatale sadā ityājñaptā vayaṃ devyāḥ patitāḥ padasannidhau tatraivāntaragāt kālī cidrūpā brahmaniṣkalā gopanīyaṃ prayatnena sarveṣāṃ sadhanottamam vadanto bhṛśaduḥkhārtā nimagnāḥ śokasāgare kīdṛk caraṇarāgaṃ te kṛpāsāgarasañcayam kiṃ bhūtaṃ nakhacandrāṇāṃ jyotiḥ paramamaṅgalam kiṃ bhūtaṃ kiṃ bhavenmātaḥ kva yātamidamadbhutam asmākaṃ mātṛbhāvena na paśyāmaḥ punaśca tat [tvāṃ] ruditvā ca ruditvā ca vayaṃ sarve tathā [tathāhvayan] sthitāḥ nītā vayaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ varṣāṇāmambujekṣaṇe mātaryātaḥ kva yātā tvamasmākaṃ [yātāsi] kiṃ bhaviṣyati dayā nāsti aho mātarvayante dīnabālakāḥ tvāṃ vinā jananī nāsti nāsmākaṃ tāt [bhāva] eva ca kathaṃ bhavati he mātarjñāyatāṃ svayameva hi sovāca yoginī vāṇīṃ mahāmṛtapravarṣiṇīm mama nāśo nāsti kadā niḥsandehāstu tiṣṭhata dhyātvā tadrūpamamalaṃ japaṃ kuruta me manum idānīṃ brahmaṇo dehe viśa viṣṇo sthiro bhava yāvat sṛṣṭiṃ karotīśa imāṃ jñānakriyāmayīm icchājñānakriyāśaktīḥ sarvakāryārthasādhanīḥ mahyaṃ dattvā jñānaśaktiḥ sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ahaṃ viśāmi yuṣmāsu pūrṇarūpeṇa śaṅkare

ayaṃ hi vaktā śāstrāṇāṃ nāpyanyo'pi vidhirhariḥ mohayiṣyāmi brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāpi maheśvaram ayañca mādhavo dehe praviṣṭo brahmaṇastadā tato brahmā svayaṃ jñātvā svayaṃ juhoti cāvyayam kiṃ karobhi kva gacchāmi iti cintāsamākulaḥ jalameva sasarjādau vyāpakaṃ paramaṃ mahat tatra sthitvā hemarūpamasṛjad vārthasañcayam [vīrya] tattad brahmāṇḍamākhyātaṃ plavate kāraṇārṇave karomi satataṃ devi rudramūrtidharaḥ svayam ekaikarudrarūpeṇa tiṣṭhāmi satataṃ śive tathā karomi satataṃ sthitvā tatkāraṇārṇave pratibrahmāṇḍamadhye tu tiṣṭhāmo nātra saṃśayaḥ praviśyekaikarūpeṇa anyatattvacatuṣṭayam etaistu pañcabhistattvaiḥ sarvāṃ sṛṣṭimakārayat brahmadehāt samudbhūya pālayāmāsa tāṃ sadā ahaṃ hi parameśāni brahmadehaṃ samāśritaḥ sarva kāryaṃ mamaivaitajjānāti hi jagannidhiḥ devādisakalaṃ devi digvidik ca carācaram sarvaṃ jānāti hi brahmā matkṛtaṃ māyayā punaḥ ruṣṭā cet [sā] saiva mātā me bhūmiyogaṃ prayacchati yasya tuṣṭā mahādevi mama mātā hi kālikā aśrutaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ brahmādīnāmagocaram idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yat proktaṃ kāraṇārṇavam sīmānaṃ vada deveśa yadi sneho'sti māṃ prati atigopyaṃ sugopyaṃ hi brahmaviṣṇvādyagocaram

mahārṇavo bhaved devi mahākālo maheśvaraḥ śūnyarūpaṃ hi krīḍārthaṃ bhartāraṃ paryakalpayat bhūtvārdhatejaso rūpā mahākālañca vibhratī sīmā pṛṣṭā tvayā devi sīmā [saiva] brahmaiva kevalam tat prakāśaṃ mahādevi vyāpyavyāpakavarjitam idaṃ hi sakalaṃ devi sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ punaḥ idaṃ hi kathitaṃ tubhyaṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam idaṃ hi paramaṃ jñānaṃ sarvamāyānikṛntanama koṭikoṭimahādānāt koṭikoṭimahātapāt koṭikoṭimahātīrthā vagāhācca [snānāt] maheśvari tadā mukto bhaved devi saṃsāre na punarbhavet yathānyo labhate naivaṃ [naiva] tathā kuru prayatnataḥ gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mama sarvasvamuttamam jñānine devadeveśiṃ anyathā narakaṃ vrajet brahmajñānaṃ mayā devi kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi gopanīyaṃ sadā bhadre paśupāmarasannidhau gaṇeśanandicandreśa govindavidhivandita yā proktā paramā vidyā kālī kaluṣanāśinī mudrāṃ baliṃ tathā homaṃ bhāvaṃ sthānaṃ tathaiva ca idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi sthānaṃ bhedaṃ maheśvara jhaṭityeva mahādeva kṛpayā vada śaṅkara prayāsasya ca bāhulyaṃ hitvā hi parameśvara drutasiddhikaraṃ devi mahāmokṣaphalapradam tatra yad yat kṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ labhet na tu maivaṃ mahādevi bhāvayuktaḥ saśaktikaḥ

anantaphaladā pūjā sarvatraiva jale sthale śāktaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi śaivaṃ vānyaṃ tathā punaḥ prātaḥ kālaṃ samārabhya yāvanmadhyandinaṃ bhavet nirvāṇaṃ tasya deveśi avaśyaṃ jāyate śive avimuktaṃ mahādevi tathā gaurīmukhaṃ punaḥ tatra yadyat kṛtaṃ devi kiṃ tasya kathayāmi te nepālasya kāñcanādriṃ brahmaputrasya saṅgamam uttarasyāṃ kuñjagiriḥ karatoyāttu paścime dakṣiṇe brahmaputrasya lākṣāyāḥ saṅgamāvadhi ṛṇāni trīṇyapākartuṃ yasya cittaṃ prasīdati tīrthayātrāṃ samāsādya yadyeko'pyatra gacchati triṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ dīrgheṇa śatayojanam īśāne caiva kedāro vāyavyāṃ gajaśāsanaḥ trikoṇameva jānīhi surāsuranamaskṛtam tatra yadyajjalaṃ devi tat sarvaṃ tīrthameva hi siddhapīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ brahmapīṭhaṃ tadantaram navayoniriti khyātā caturdikṣu samantataḥ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhadre phalamevaṃ suniścitam pūjane japane caiva dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ phalam āyonimahiparyantamāvidyāgandhamādanam brahmaviṣṇusureśādyaiḥ sevitaṃ paramādbhutam yonipīṭhe maheśāni pañcakrośamite śive ye ca sūryākaraṃ kleśaṃ prāpnuvanti na karhicit te sarve śaṅkarā jātāstrinetrāścandramurdhajāḥ pūjanaṃ japanañcaiva kurute sādhakottamaḥ

tanmadhye ca mahādevi girirnīlācalojjvalaḥ tanmadhye parameśāni manobhavaguhā parā koṭiliṅgasamākīrṇā kāmākhyā kalpavallarī asyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa lauho yāti suvarṇatām asyāḥ sparśanamātreṇa śivatvameti mānavaḥ atra yadyat kṛtaṃ karma tadanantaphalaṃ bhavet āpātālād hradaṃ devi procchalajjalamaṇḍalam aiśvaraṃ tajjalaṃ devi kāraṇārṇavasaṃjñakam saṅketenaiva kathitaṃ mātarjānīhi sundari tajjalasparśa mātreṇa tadhradasparśanena ca puṇyapāpavinirmukto jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam jihvākoṭisahasraistu vaktrakoṭiśatairapi hrade hastaṃ viniḥkṣipya jalamadhye maheśvari mantrasiddhirbhavettasya tat kṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ japanti ye hi mantraṃ te siddhimāyānti tatkṣaṇāt etatte kathitaṃ devi kāmākhyāyonimaṇḍalam kintvasya kathyate devi māhātmyaṃ te yaśasvini chinnamastā bhairavī sā sapta sapta vibheditā bhagaklinnā bhagādhārā tathā caiva bhagandarī upavidyāśca yāḥ proktāḥ sarvābhistābhireva ca brahmamukhāśrayaṃ pīṭhamugratārādhidaivatam vyaktād guptaṃ puṇyataraṃ durāpaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ manobhavaguhāvahnau devīśikharamunnatam siddhi kālī brahmarūpā devatā bhuvaneśvarī tatpīṭhopari saṃviśya daśadhā ca japenmanum

yat kṣaṇaṃ te mayā proktaṃ hṛnmadhye hi sulocane arghaṃ jālandhare jñeyamuḍḍīyāne tadardhakam nīlakaṇṭhasamīpe tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā trayodaśāhe mahāsiddhirekābhrakānane tathā rāḍhāyāṃ vikaṭākṣāyāṃ drutañja parvatātmaje puṣkarākhye ca lakṣeṇa prayoge viṃśalakṣataḥ tathaiva viraje kṣetre lakṣadvādaśataḥ śive kailāse daśalakṣeṇa jayantyāṃ pañcalakṣataḥ avaśyaṃ mantrasiddhiḥ syājjapanāt pūjanācchive mātṛjārasamaṃ devi sarvadā parigopayet kāmākhyāyonimāhātmyaṃ yaduktaṃ me tvayā śiva tattvena [taṃtrena] tanmayā jñātaṃ kalau kiṃ na susiddhidam kimetat kāraṇaṃ nātha vada me karuṇāmaya pṛthivīgarbhasambhūto dānavānāmaddhīśvaraḥ pṛthivīvacanāt so'pi dānavo yuddhadurdharaḥ punaśca bhagavān tasmai nivāsāya dadau mudā jitvā'bhiṣecanaṃ rājye viṣṇuḥ śaktiṃ dadāvapi susnātaṃ narakaṃ tadvad vidheyāmāsa vai tadā brahmatvaṃ brahmaṇā prāptaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca mayā punaḥ tasmādyoniṃ pūjayasva yatnāt sarvātmabhistvamūm yadā te vimukhī mātā tadā te na śubhaṃ suta iti jñātvā pujayasva viśeṣeṇa vadāmi kim narakaḥ pālayāmāsa viṣṇūvataṃ yadyadeva hi brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro vaśiṣṭho'tīva sadyati tatraivaikadine devi pūjayituṃ [japtuṃ caiva] sureśvarīm

tatra taṃ varayāmāsa narako brahmasambhavam idānīṃ pūjyate devī pūjānte tvaṃ gamiṣyasi uvāca narakaṃ vipro vaśiṣṭhastāmralocanaḥ kāmākhyāpūjane kāle mā labhema gṛhāntare idānīṃ paśya vīryaṃ me tava nāśakaraṃ mahat kamaṇḍalormahādevīṃ śaśāpa dāruṇaṃ muniḥ hitvā tvāṃ hi vrajāmyadya na kiñciducyate tvayā siddhirna jāyate karhi kāle madvacanāt punaḥ nīlācalaṃ parityajya gato'sau khāṇḍavaṃ girim mahājyotirmayī devī sarvaprakāśarūpiṇī tatkṣaṇāt parisandagdhā gatā kailāsamandiram mahāndhakārapaṭalairāvṛtā tadviyogataḥ tatastāṃ paramāṃ māyāṃ viṣaṇṇavadanāṃ punaḥ kathaṃ śive samāyātā tyaktvā tadyonimaṇḍalam tvaṃ devi paramārādhyā sthīyatāṃ me hṛdi svayam sarvaṃ pratikaromyeva viṣaṇṇavadane katham madyonimaṇḍale nātha dvāraṃ me samupāgataḥ dvārapālo'bhavadrājā yāvanme pūjanaṃ bhavet evaṃ nityaṃ niyamitaṃ narakenāsureṇa ca tatastenaiva muninā śāpo dattaḥ sudāruṇaḥ śāpaṃ śṛṇu mahādeva kathane rodanaṃ mama tad mama vihataṃ deva ko vopāyo'sti me vada brahmavadhodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ satyaṃ te'dya bhaviṣyati siddhirna jāyate karhi kāle madvacanāt punaḥ āgatyāhaṃ yonipīṭhe jajāpa kālikāmanum

kāmākhyāṃ sthāpayāmāsa pūrvavad yonimaṇḍale brahmaśāpo maheśāni phaliṣyati suniścitam narakasya prasaṅgena tat sarvaṃ kathitaṃ mayi yacchrutvā sādhavaḥ sarve dayāmeṣyanti sarvadā taddināt parameśāni brahmaśāpaḥ pravartate prajāpīḍā rogakṛtvā bahudoṣo bhaviṣyati devadānavagandharvāḥ sadā pīḍāparāyaṇāḥ saumāraiśca kuvācaiśca yavanairyuddhamulvaṇam tato raṇe ca saumāraṃ jitvā yavanavāñchitam [īpsitaṃ] tat sahāyaṃ samāsādya kuvācaḥ svīyarājyabhāk kumārīcandrakālendau gate śāke maheśvari kāmarūpe tathā rājyaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ maheśvari ṣaṣṭhavargapañcamādistataḥ śarīramicchati yavanaśca kuvācaśca saumāraśca tathā plavaḥ evameva bahuvidhaṃ vakṣye lakṣaṇamīśvari vaśiṣṭhasya tapasyādāvagniḥ śāmyati kāmini svargahāre śilāpāte caike vepurasannidhau brahmaputrasya deveśi sūkṣmadhārā tu tasya ca vigato bhavitā nūnaṃ saumārakāmapṛṣṭhayoḥ gamiṣyanti ca rājānaḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ tribhirmlaicchaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ mahāyuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati lohityo raktapūrṇaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ kāmākhyā varṇakaśyāmā [kaṇakā] balihastā hasanmukhī parvatāgraṃ samāśritya raktapānaṃ kariṣyati karatoyānadīṃ yāvat kariṣyati mahadraṇam

tato vipro nṛpo bhūtvā kāmarūpanivāsinaḥ evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍī dvijo nṛpaḥ tato dvādaśadale nābhiḥ kalpate pūrvabhūmipaḥ tadrājyaṃ sakalaṃ devi dharmeṇa pālayiṣyati savitaṃ [saritaṃ] tanayaṃ sādhvī rājānaṃ rājaputrakam tāvat sparśācale sparśamaṇirāvirbhaviṣyati bhaviṣyanti tadaiva syāt vaśiṣṭhaśāpamocanam kāmākhyāsannidhāne ca bhaviṣyati kalau yuge yathoktaphaladā devi kāmākhyā hi bhaviṣyati kāmākhyā devavandyāṅghrikamalā lajjitā svayam kiṃ śrotavyamito devi girije kathyatāṃ tvayā kva gacchasi muhurnātha kṛpayā vada śaṅkara sādhvī satī śāsikā hi revatī janaviśrutā [janavismṛtā] tat kucau kaṭhinau dvandvau yonau tasyāśca pīnatā tat sannidhau maheśāni tayā me ramaṇaṃ mahat tvayā sārddhaṃ ratiryasyā nālpasya tapasaḥ phalam idānīṃ kimabhūt sā hi kṛpayā parayā vada tat sādhvīcaritaṃ kiñcit kathayāmi śucismite vedāṅgasambhavā sādhvī yoginī sā surī matā māmāptumutkaṭaṃ taptamasmin me kṣetrakāmade [kāmadā] tatraiko brāhmaṇo yāto bhikṣārthaṃ tāmuvāca ha tataḥ śaśāpa viprastāṃ mlecchatāṃ yāhi durmade ityuktvā sa yayau vipro mlecchatvamāpa yoginī tasyāstu tapasā devi krītoḥamabhavaṃ sadā tasyāḥ putro vinusiṃho madaurasasamudbhavaḥ

vinirjitya nṛpān sarvān ekaḥ śrīmān mahāmatiḥ kuvācā dhārmikāḥ sarve rājāno yuddhadurmadāḥ tiṣṭhatyavyaktarūpeṇa paṭṭa ākalpamambike yathā jāyā nandimatā tatheyaṃ yoginī matā vinusiṃho'pi kalpānte parāṃ siddhimavāpsyati bhaviṣyanti mahātmāno gaṇeśāḥ [dhaneśāḥ] sarvaśālinaḥ viharanti sadā devi krīḍante bhairavā yathā tadā tadā'vatīryāsau svasya kāmasya pālakaḥ kalpāntamevaṃ deveśi yāvacchāpo vimucyate kalpameva maheśāni kalau varṣaśatatrayam kāmākhyā tu mahāmāye tadante sakalaṃ bhavet kāmākhyāyā maheśāni sākalyena mayā dhruvam takṣakeṇāpi daṣṭasya pratīkāro hi tat kṣaṇāt narakānniṣkṛtirnāsti tasyābhāvānna saṃśayaḥ nānāvidhamahotpātairyāvat syāt sāptapauruṣam sarvadevamayo vipro brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ brāhmaṇairbhujyate yatra tatra bhuṅkte hariḥ svayam pitaro devatāḥ sarve bhuñjate nātra saṃśayaḥ brāhmaṇañca kumārīñca śaktimagniṃ śrutiñca gām pūjitaikā kumārī ceddvitīyaṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet kumāryaśca śaktayaśca sarvametaccarācaram sarvā eva parā devyaḥ pūjitā syuḥ na saṃśayaḥ labhyate koṭiguṇitaṃ viśvāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ gogrāsaṃ pāvanaṃ loke sarvapāpanikṛntanam kalpakoṭiśatāyutaiḥ

paraloke mahābandhurdharmo nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ tataścāgamike dharme dharmeṇaiva pravartate tatastu bahujanmānte jñānamāsādya mucyate jñānānmuktirmahādevi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayocyate tadā yogī vimuktaḥ syādityāha bhagavān śivaḥ tasmāt karma mahāmāye sarvadā samupācaret na vṛthā gamayet kālaṃ dyūtakrīḍādinā sudhīḥ dvividhañcaiva tat karma bāhyāntaravibhedataḥ aśucirvā śucirvāpi yatra kutra sthale'pi vā kuryācca mānasaṃ dharmaṃ na doṣo mānase kvacit japayajño maheśāni matsvarūpo na saṃśayaḥ sarvadā parameśāni jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm vyāghrādyā jantavo devi tathaiva kupitāntarāḥ dānavā bhairavā duṣṭā ye vai śmaśānavāsinaḥ na spṛśanti ca pāpāni kadāpi sādhakaṃ priye upāṃśuḥ syāt śataguṇaḥ sahasro mānaso mataḥ kiñcit suśravaṇopeta upāṃśu parikīrtitaḥ vācikastu japo bāhyo mānaso'bhyantaro yataḥ japena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati sādhanañca japañcaiva dhyānañcaiva varānane yadi bhāgyena deveśi bahujanmārjitena ca brahmajñānañca yat proktaṃ samādhistat prakīrtyate itaḥ paraṃ mahādevi kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi plavaśca yavanaścaiva saumāraśca maheśvara

kathaṃ jātā mahādeva vada me karuṇāmaya nānyo vaṃśadharaḥ kaścittadvaṃśe tu trilocane yuvatī sundarī ramyā tapaḥśīlā mahāmatiḥ sthitvā viśveśvarāgre tu dvāre me muktimaṇḍape taddvārapālako devi cukṣubhe tāṃ nirīkṣya ca kapālamālī madirāmoditonmattaveśavān kīrterjāto mahādevi bandhukāmalakadyuti kīrteḥ suto mahādevi mahākālasya retasaḥ tayā'niśaṃ ratiñcāpi mahāṅkuśamahābhujam mahāṅkuśaḥ] śālvaṃ rājyaṃ datvā mahāṅkuśe samarcayan yathā kāśyāṃ tathā tatrāpi sarvadā evante kathitaṃ devi caritaṃ plavasammatam āsīt tretāyuge rājā bahudharmaparāyaṇaḥ pitṛśatrūn vinirjitya saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām bahukāle mahāmāye tataḥ svamadamohitaḥ nipātya pitṛśatrūn yaḥ pitṛśrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ hi yat tasmāttu pāpasañcāro jātastasya mahābhujaḥ ahaṅkāro yuddhacaryaḥ sadā naivāvyavasthitiḥ tasya tenaiva bhāvena rājalakṣmīrvinicyutā mantrayitvā ca rājāno laṅghayitvāmbudhiṃ tadā ādau parājitastebhyo bāhurmāsena niṣkraman mamāra tadvane bāhuḥ samastaṃ niṣprabhaṃ tadā vaśiṣṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yātau rakṣarakṣeti vādinau etasminnantare bhūpaḥ sagaraḥ khaḍgamūrchritaḥ [krodhaḥ-] tattathā bhūpamālokya vaśiṣṭho brahmasambhavaḥ

mā hiṃsīrbāhunandana abhayaṃ dattavānaham brahmavākyaṃ vṛthā na syāt pratijñā me'pi pūrvajā iti sañcintya tat sarvaṃ vaśiṣṭhamabhyavedayat tatra tadvacanaṃ śrutvā gatoṣmi kiṃ karomyataḥ yadyupāyaṃ na karoṣi śreyo ye maraṇaṃ tadā evaṃ śrutvā vaśiṣṭho'sau satvaraṃ pratyabhāṣata vedācārabahirbhūtān kārayāmāsa dūrataḥ itthaṃ me vacanaṃ tiṣṭhet pratijñāpi ca te vibho [śiśo] vede'pi sthiramevaṃ hi samānaṃ samudāhṛtam te'pi vai kṣatriyāḥ sarve haihayāstālajaṅghakāḥ suṣeṇamunimāśritya tadācāravirājitāḥ yamāśritya mahādevi mlecchācāraparāyaṇāḥ saṃyogañca viyogañca mantrāṇāñca dvidhā gatiḥ bāhyāntaraviyogena saṃyogo hi anuttamaḥ tāmasaḥ paralokasya bāhyastaddharma īśvaraḥ mayā datto varastebhyo śṛṇu kāmayituṃ varam kālaṃ tathendvaṣṭanavān gate śāke kalau yuge evameva maheśāni kāmarūpādhipāḥ śive bahubhūpasamākīrṇaḥ kalau bhuṅkte mahīṃ mudā idānīṃ śrūyatāṃ yuddhe saumāracaritaṃ tathā vihāya devarājyaṃ ca [devarājaṃ ca] kauśāṅgyā sahitaḥ svayam tauryatrike samyagicchā jātā bahuvidhāstathā ādideśa samānīya nṛtyaṃ kartuñca rambhayā nānāvidhividhānena indraṃ tutoṣa mohinī sā

ratirdhairyaṃ tayorjātaṃ tasyāstatskhalane punaḥ uvāca niṣṭhurāṃ vāṇīṃ śṛṇu devi manoharām ataḥ pracalitaṃ cittamāvayoratikarmaṇi evamuktaṃ duṣṭaśāpaṃ kauśāṅgīmukhaniḥsṛtam vilalāpa bahuvidhaṃ dhṛtvā ca caraṇe muhuḥ gamiṣyasi kaṅkatī mohinī ramyā dhārtarāṣṭraṃ patiṃ gatā tūrṇañca kaṅkatī sāgāccandracūḍaṃ giriṃ bhiyā prāpyartuṃ svargaveśyā sā dvitīyadivase diśi gatvāpaśyat tu sundarīm bodhayitvā ca sarvaṃ [sarvāṃ] tāṃ kāntāṃ kāmavimohitām kaṅkatyā parameśāni parvate gandhamādane tataḥ so'rindamaścābhūt mlecchācāraparāyaṇaḥ sarvamāṃsādano devi kirāto ghaṭito yathā madyamāṃsabhagāmodī kadācāraparāyaṇaḥ tatastāṃ devarājo'sāvuvāca tatpurasthitaḥ tapasā te'tisantuṣṭo yadicchasi dadāmi ca draṣṭuṃ na śaktā deveśa yathecchasi tathā kuru bhavet satyaṃ na sandehaḥ puttroyantu narādhamaḥ yathecchasi kuru tathā māṃ tu naya drutaṃ prabho devādhīśa eṣa kāmyo nānyaḥ kāmyaḥ kadācana tvarito neṣyāmyadhunā tvāmahaṃ susthirā bhava ataḥ śatāṣṭaviṃśe ca puruṣe kṣayite [hārite] sati puṇyaślokā dharmamayāḥ sadācāraparāyaṇāḥ bhaviṣyanti na sandeho brahmatattvavidaḥ punaḥ

layameṣyanti tatraiva yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam guptena tvāmahaṃ pṛcche kāmākhyā kā vadasva me kāmākhyā saiva deveśi sarvasiddhipradāyinī sarvaṃ me kṛpayā nātha vadasva candraśekhara tadāhaṅkāradoṣeṇa pūrito'sau pitāmahaḥ tamahaṅkāramādāya sthito brahmā jagannidhiḥ kevalāhaṅkārayuto dhātrā bhūto hi sarvadā tathāpi māyayā devi brahmāhaṅkāramoditaḥ taddehāt kalpayāmāsa tadahaṅkārataḥ śive niḥsṛtya brahmaṇo dehād daityaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ tataḥ palāyanañcakre viṣṇunā sa pitāmahaḥ keśipuramidaṃ khyātaṃ tatra sthitvā hi dānavaḥ brahmāṇḍamaṇḍale astauṣījjagatāṃ dhātrīṃ [mātāṃ] kālīṃ vighnavināśinīm nijabījasvarūpāñca kāmabījasvarūpiṇīm māyābījasvarūpāñca kūrcabījasvarūpiṇīm ghorarāvāṃ śivasaṅgīṃ muktakeśīṃ digambarīm praṇamāmi sadā hṛdyāṃ tāṃ mātāṃ bhuvaneśvarīm bho viṣṇo tvaṃ mahābāho kimicchasi ca tadvada āvayoḥ sakalaṃ nītaṃ [hṛtaṃ] nityaṃ tat tena maṇḍalam dehi dāsyaṃ padāmbhoje māhātmyaṃ tannivedanam idānīṃ parisaṃjñātaṃ te yānti ca tavādhikāḥ ahaṅkārāptamīkṣitvā vighnaṃ dattaṃ durāsadam mā bhayaṃ kuru bho viṣṇo sthiro bhava mahāmate huṅkāreṇaiva taṃ bhasmīcakāra dānavottamam

keśīṃ mahāsuraṃ kālī vidhimāha tatastu sā tatpāpasyāpanodāya kriyate parvatottamaḥ tadgrāsabhasmanā nityaṃ gauste pāpaṃ kṣayiṣyati kamaṇḍalujalakṣepāccakāra parvataṃ vidhiḥ tadgrāsabhasmanā gauśca tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirbhaved dhruvam yathā yathā [yathāśruti] cātti gauśca tadgrāsaṃ parvatottame tāvattu niṣkṛtirdhāturyāvad govardhano giriḥ evamevāparādhaste prādhānye yadi jāyate tato brahmā jagaddhātā viṣṇuśca jagatāṃ patiḥ dadāmi vatsau tat sarvaṃ bhavantau kātarau katham mahāmuktipradañcaiva tvadīyamatinirmalam kathaṃ tat pūjayiṣyāvaḥ sarvaṃ maṅgaladāyakam sarvadā pūjayiṣyāvo mahābhaṅgalakāraṇam tadāvayordānavādyairaśubhaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyati p. 109) avaśyaṃ nau tariṣyāvo dustarāt tvatpadārcanāt jalahuṅkārabījena [yena] cakāra bhasma dānavam mahātejomayaṃ viddhi tadbījaṃ param padamaṃ āpātālaṃ krośamātraṃ tadbījaṃ tejasāvṛtam tatsthānaṃ tvaṃ samādāya māṃ pūjaya yadīpsitam devadānavagandharvairanyairapi mahāmate sarvāpadbhyaḥ paritrāṇaṃ tvāṃ kariṣyāmi sarvadā icchāśaktistu dattā vai ādyañcaiva mayā purā saiva vṛndāsvarūpeṇa pure'tra sambhaviṣyati keśipurasya bhavitā tayā te krīḍanaṃ dhruvam daityavighnaṃ hi bhavitā sarvadaityaniṣūdanī

keśidaityavadhārthāya yatra te pūjanaṃ kṛtam mama tejaḥ samudbhūtaṃ jānīhi yonimaṇḍalam jānīhi prakṛtiṃ deva yoniṃ me yāṃ tu māmakīm kutrāpi ca bhayaṃ na syāt tava kvāpi pitāmaha jānīhi tadadhiṣṭhātṛrūpaṃ me'ti suśobhanam yonimaṇḍalamāsādha kāmākhyāṃ yastu pūjayet na bhayaṃ tasya kutrāpi kasmādapi prajāyate pṛthivyāṃ bhārate varṣe kāmarūpaṃ mahālayam navayonyātmake brahman kāmarūpe manoharam kintvidānīṃ bhavatpāpaṃ prapaśyāmi [na paśyāmi] kathañcana kāyikaṃ vācikañcaiva mānasañca tathā punaḥ tat pāpadhyānadhārābhirbaddhībhūtaṃ divāniśam tat trayasya praśamanaṃ vadāmi tacchṛṇuṣva me śreṣṭhatāmehi he deva dṛṣṭvā pīṭhaṃ tapaḥ kuru tāvat kuru tapo ghoraṃ tadante pātakadvayam tatra tapovaśāt tattu kenāpi nahi vīkṣyate sthānaṃ tadgāsyate vatsa sarvaloke nirantaram kālīṃ paramakalyāṇīṃ tāṃ natvā vidhikeśavau prācīnamatigopyaṃ hi vṛttāntaṃ kulanāyike sārātsārataraṃ devi bhaktimuktipradāyakam īśvaroḥamīśvaroḥamuktavantau jalārṇave aprameyaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ madīyaṃ pāvanaṃ param tanmadhyeḥaṃ rudrarūpo babhrāma vṛṣavāhanaḥ stutvā ca vividhaiḥ stotrairūcaturmāṃ punaśca tau kastvaṃ vada bhīmarūpa utthito'si jalārṇave

utthitoḥaṃ ca yuvayodīśvaratvaṃ parīkṣitum nigūḍhaṃ dhyānto jñātvā santuṣṭo mādhavo'bhavat kevalaṃ rudrarūpaṃ māṃ jñātvā'sau kamalāsanaḥ vicikitsāparo bhūtvā viṣṇumāha tadā vidhiḥ bho viṣṇo matkapālād yo jāto rudro'pyasau mataḥ cakāra bahudhā devi vighnaṃ dattaṃ sudāruṇam tadvighnamasuro bhūtvā madhyāhnasamaye raviḥ sarveṣāṃ sakalaṃ nītamindrādīnāṃ maheśvari garuḍañca vinā lakṣmīmanyat sarva hṛtaṃ balāt himālayaṃ samāsādya viṣṇurāha tadā vidhim tenaiva cāparādhena vayaṃ sarve prapīḍitāḥ tadaiva maṅgalaṃ lebhe bhūyo me rocate hṛdi himālaye tadā devāḥ prasādo me'bhavat tadā brahmāṇa sārathīṃ kṛtvā vedān rajjūṃstathaiva ca dhanuḥ kṛtvā sumeruñca jyāñca kṛtvā tu vāsukīm carācareṇa sahitaṃ devadaityādibhiḥ saha yatra bhasma kṛtaṃ devi jagadetaccarācaram mṛtānāṃ sarvadevānāṃ tejastatra vyavasthitam nirmāya māyayā dehaṃ traipuraṃ tasya vakṣasi tattejasi mahākālyāḥ parā caitanyarūpiṇī mahādīpaprayāṇantu tejasaḥ kālīkīrtitam ato girimukhaṃ nāma munibhiḥ parigīyate ānandakānanaṃ tasmād gīyate vedavādibhiḥ yathā tu sāgare gacchan śīkaraḥ sāgaro bhavet yathā nānājalaṃ devi gaṅgāyāṃ patitaṃ yadi

sarvaṃ kālyabhavat pūrṇaṃ nāsti bhedo maheśvari tāṃ kālīṃ śirasādhāya pañcakrośamayīṃ sadā ato viśveśvaratvaṃ me sadaiva nātra saṃśayaḥ viśveśvaraḥ sa eva syānnāparaḥ parameśvari tatra tasyāḥ kṛpā jātā vāgbhavā yā'śarīriṇī ataḥ kāśyāṃ mṛtānāṃ tvamānandaṃ dehi sarvadā dadāmi paramaṃ brahma mumūrṣoḥ karṇagocare jale sthale cāntarikṣe vārāṇasyāṃ mṛtāstu ye dadāmi paramaṃ brahma teṣāṃ hi karṇagocare mahākālyāḥ prasādāt jñānayogataḥ kāśīsparśanamātrāt te pūrṇānandamayāḥ sadā tūlarāśiṃ dahatyagniḥ kiñcitkālādyathā śive kāśīsthānaṃ puṇyacayaṃ kiṃ vāhaṃ kathayāmi te tadā kāśīphalaṃ kiñcit devi vaktuṃ kṣamo bhavet te sarve muktimāyānti kāśyāñced bhāgyato mṛtāḥ yugabhedājjanaireva dṛśyate hi caturvidhā dvāpare sā śilārūpā kalau bhūmimayī śubhā satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi śapathena vadāmi te pāṣāṇeśvaralobhitvāt tiṣṭhet kāśyāṃ sa yantritaḥ prāṇānte'pi mahādevi kāśīṃ na nistyajedbudhaḥ vṛthaiva mūrkhalokena kāśīṃ prāpya samujjhitam tadā naiva tyajet kāśīṃ prāṇānte'pi kadācana sa gacchedapi yatnena mama vārāṇasīṃ purīm prāṇānte muktidātāḥaṃ kāśyāṃ sthitvā sadaiva hi paramaṃ pāvanaṃ mokṣaṃ kimataḥ śrotumicchasi

jagadūrdhvakalādhīśa vada kolānipātanam mahākālīprasaṅgena vṛttāntamidamadbhutam pīḍitastena pāpena tapaścakre sa sarvavit aṣṭākṣarīṃ mahāvidyāṃ mahākālyāḥ sadā japan tasyāḥ santoṣamātreṇa viṣṇorhṛdayapaṅkajāt tena daityena balinā sarvaṃ nītaṃ durātmanā hṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma brahmaṇaḥ kamalāsanam kolānagaramāsthāya kumārīrūpamāsthitā ānandajaladhau magnāḥ śikhivannanṛturghanāt tamayācata tadbhakṣyaṃ kumārī daityapuṅgavam kṣudhitāhaṃ mahārāja bhojyaṃ mahyaṃ pradīyatām dayayā tāṃ kare dhṛtvā viveśāntaḥpure svayam atropaviśa bāle tvaṃ āsane maṇirañjite bhuktvā sā sakalaṃ devi punardehītivādinī nāhaṃ tṛptā vadantīṃ tāṃ kolovāca tadā'suraḥ ityudīritamākarṇya kālī bālāsvarūpiṇī kṣaṇena bubhuje kālī kolāsuraṃ mahābalam tataḥ kolāpuraṃ śūnyaṃ kṛtaṃ kālyā kṣaṇācchive nirantaraṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ cakruste nanṛtuḥ param avidyādharī devapatnī kinnarībhiḥ samantataḥ asarvalokaiḥ pūjitā ca kumarī sā gṛhe gṛhe evaṃ te'dya mayā proktaṃ kolāsuraniṣūdanam vāgvajrañca brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā jānīhi kāmini santuṣya brāhmaṇān devi tuṣṭā vayaṃ sadā surāḥ yadyakāryaśataṃ devi brāhmaṇaḥ svayamācaret

nāpamānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sarvadā surapuṅgave aprasūtiśca sā kālī kumārīrūpadhāriṇī brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ kumārī pūjyate sadā kumārīpūjanaphalaṃ vaktuṃ nārhāmi sundari tasmācca pūjayet bālāṃ sarvajātisamudbhavām jātibhedānmaheśāni narakānna nivartate devībuddhyā mahābhaktyā tasmāttāṃ paripūjayet ekā hi pūjitā bālā sarvasya pūjanaṃ [deva pūjanam] bhavet kumārīṃ labhate kānte sarvasvenāpi sādhakaḥ tadā tasya mahāsiddhirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ priyaṃvade sarvasiddhiyuto bhūtvā krīḍate bhairavo yathā haṭhāttu [tathā tu] jāyate sarvaṃ yadyanmanasi vartate avyāhatājñaḥ [avyāhataśca] sarvatra yathā purandaraḥ śive vidyādharī rājanārī sevate taṃ divāniśam kumārīpūjane kāle sādhakaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet mahāpuṇyatamaṃ bhūyāt samantāt krośapañcakam apūjayat kumārīṃ tāṃ veśyākulasamudbhavām bhūtvā nityā hi tatsthāne [tat svapne] gṛhṇāti pūjanaṃ sadā mokṣadā sā purī jñeyā pañcakrośamayī śubhā tatsarvaṃ pūjanaṃ tasyāścitrametannagendraje evantu pūjitā bālā kampillena mahātmanā adyāpi dṛśyate loke [lokaiḥ] śilārūpeṇa tiṣṭhatā sarvayajñayutaṃ devi maharṣīṇāñca veṣṭitam ye vasanti mahādevi kāmpillanagre pure

sarvasampatsamākīrṇānante devyāḥ prasādataḥ yadi kāmo bhavet ko'pi vaikuṇṭhaṃ paramaṃ vrajet kiñcidevaṃ mahāmāye punaḥ kiṃ parikathyate idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kaholacaritaṃ param hitaṃ hi sarvalokānāṃ yogināṃ hṛdayārthadam paribabhrāma medinīm |] sarvatīrthapūtaḥ sarvārthavarjitaḥ sarvavarya ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ paribabhrāma medinīm sahasrasūryasaṅkāśaḥ sa evāsīt purā śive tadākāśasamudbhūtā śrutā vāṇī maharṣiṇā sa guruḥ sarvasattvānāṃ sakalaṃ te kariṣyati gatvovāca kaholo'sau [-me] vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ hi tam candrākṣarī sarvajñānabhāvanī [-mānavī] cinmayī śubhā kathitañca mayā tasmai kaholaputra tacchṛṇu bhāvayitvā pūjayed yaḥ sarvājñānavināśinīm ityājñaptaḥ kaholaḥ sa ṛṣirvedaviśāradaḥ tasya te saṃśayā vighnāḥ palāyante dine dine tatastasmin kṛpā jātā mahākālyā ṛṣeḥ śubhā ātmānaṃ kālikārūpaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam sarvamāyāvinirmukto jātaḥ sa ṛṣiruttamaḥ ātmadehādikaṃ kiñcijjānāti na ca karhicit bhasmībhūtaṃ maheśāni ṛṣesstasya mahātmanaḥ atyācāreṣu sarveṣu rataḥ syāt sphurate hi saḥ cakāra līnaṃ tamṛṣiṃ svīyadehe tu kāraṇe devāsuramunīndrāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām kāṃ vidyāṃ prāpya sā jātā tāṃ vadasva mayi prabho

śravaṇāt sarvapāpāni nāśamāyānti nānyathā mahādevyā mahākālyā mahādevena bhāṣitam punaśca nijabīja hi vidyāyaśaskarī parā mama jaṭātaṭe sthitvā [sthitā] japedvidyāmaharniśam siddhamantrasvabhāvena [-prabhāve na] kālī tejo'tibṛṃhitā [tejopa-] ato hi sarvatīrthānāṃ sā vidyā sarvapūjitā yannāmasmaraṇādeva pāpino muktibhāginaḥ teṣāñca pātakaṃ hitvā sa gacched vaiṣṇavīṃ purīm dharmārthamokṣakāminaḥ] prāyaścittaparāṇyapi sadā devi śubhā gaṅgā pravāhayet yatra deśe [pravahati] vased gaṅgā sa deśaḥ puṇyabhājanaḥ tatra yat kriyate karmaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ saṅgamaṃ [sāṃgaṃ-] vā vihīnaṃ vā kathitaṃ śambhuvallabhe bhuktvā ca vividhān bhogān kṛtvā ca sukṛtaṃ sadā yatra [k pustake adhikaḥ] gaṅgāpravāho'sti devarṣigaṇasaṃstute jñānato mokṣamāpnoti vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatprabhāvataḥ [tadabhāvataḥ] gaṅgāmuddiśya yo gatvā pathi prāṇān vimuñcati tattīre yastyajet prāṇān nyāyato'nyāyato'pai vā yāvadasthīni gaṅgāyāṃ nikṣipyante mṛtasya ca gaṅgājalasamāyogānmriyate yatra kutracit gaṅgātīre caturhaste piṇḍaṃ dadyāt samāhitaḥ pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ kṛtvā [bhūtvā] viṣṇuloke vasennaraḥ mahātṛptirbhavet satyaṃ pitṛṇāñca śatābdikam divā vā yadi vā rātrau sandhyāyāṃ vā mahāniśi sarvaṃ kuryāttu gaṅgāyāṃ kālabhedaṃ na cācaret

tadante parameśāni cāṇḍālo nityaduḥkhitaḥ janmatrayaṃ maheśāni tadante śūdrayoniṣu caturjanmavyatīte tu kṣatriyatvaṃ trijanmataḥ gaṅgāyāṃ harate yo hi yatkiñcit parameśvari ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ [ka pustake adhikaḥ] devi kathitaṃ te sureśvari śvapaco jāyate yo nityaṃ daśajanmani kāmini saptajanma mahādevi tadante niṣkṛtiṃ labhet kālikāyā maheśāni gaṅgāmāhātmyakāraṇam apāre ghorasaṃsāre patitānāṃ mahārṇave gurustvaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ yato [mataḥ] bhavān śrutaṃ sarvaṃ jagannātha tvanmukhāmbhojanirgatam kāṃ vidyāṃ samupāśritya karālabhairavaḥ svayam vidravanti bhayārtā vai yasmāddevāsurādayaḥ tāṃ vidyāṃ śrotumicchāmi vada nātha digambara brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sarvasvaṃ jīvanāvadhi kathyate nāmamātraṃ hi jñāyatāṃ kulabhairavi vidyā rājñī ghorakālī aniruddhasarasvatī mene [akarot] sa pūtamātmānaṃ sarvasmādadhikaṃ svayam sa tūdayācale pūrva tapastepe'ti duṣkaram bhūtvārdhacaraṇo devi varṣāṇāṃ niyutadvayam kanakāśrame tathā lakṣamuḍḍīyāne dvilakṣakam puṇyaśaile tathā lakṣaṃ pañcaviṃśatimānataḥ evaṃ taptaṃ [tepe] tapo hyevaṃ koṭivarṣaṃ suduṣkaram tathāpi taṃ prati prītā mābhūt kālī kadācana nivedayāmāsa tathā vṛttāntaṃ tapasaḥ śive

mannāthaḥ parameśāni bhāvanāvaśatāṃ gataḥ kathaṃ tvāṃ paramācāraṃ kathayāmi savistarm guhyātiguhyaguhyeti brahmādīnāmagocaraḥ kālīpratyakṣabījo'yaṃ mama sarvasva eva ca sattvaśānto mahāyogī gopitastena yatnataḥ mama [sarvasvametaddhi] svasvapadaṃ śambhurnirudvego'pyacetasaḥ sadācārasya nigūḍhaṃ tattvajñānaṃ mahāmatiḥ ajarāmaratāṃ prāpto mahāśāntaḥ pareśvaraḥ padaṃ madīyaṃ gurutvaṃ datvā tasmai samāsataḥ sarveṣāṃ tu sahastrāre tiṣṭhāmi kamale pare śivaḥ śivoḥantu śivo na bhedaḥ kutracit sadā so'pi śānto mahāyogī ācārakṣama eva saḥ śivasya kṛpayā caiva kevalaṃ sādhakaḥ kṣamaḥ ūrdhvato'yaṃ bhīmakarmā karālabhairavaḥ sadā yathā me kālikārādhyā tathācāro'yameva hi yogyaṃ na paramācāraṃ dātuṃ kālīhṛdaṅgamam ājñāpayāmāsa gaccha putra trilocanaṃ prati yāto mātuḥ kālikāyā stataḥ [samīpaṃ] sa bhairavaḥ svayam yadyajjaptaṃ tapo hyevaṃ yātu yātu vṛthā hi tat ataḥ śarīraṃ tyakṣyāmi na vakṣyāmi kadācana seyaṃ samīritā tavāṃśajam [avadhāraya] gurvājñā viphalā yātu tava vai bhairavottama kathaṃ tubhyaṃ mahāsiddhiṃ darśanaṃ vā dadāmyaham ādināthaṃ tava guruṃ vṛttāntaṃ kathayedṛśam

tadāvaśyaṃ mahācāraṃ tubhyaṃ sa tu pradāsyati acirāttaṃ pradāsyāmi yadyanmanasi vartate kulācāraṃ vinā yo hi japet sa nārakī bhavet adhikaḥ |] mahākālyā śrutvā [labdhā] sa bhairavottamaḥ mahākālaṃ mahādevaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ jagadgurum mahākālyāḥ karālabhairavaṃ prati |] tadā niyamapūrvaṃ hi karālabhairavo'vadat mahākālo jagannātho'bhiṣiktaṃ tañcakāra ha dadau nāma karālāya krodhavaktro'tiviśrutaḥ (sa) madirāmatsyamudrāntu pātraṃ kāraṇapūritam tadānīṃ śuśubhe sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram śrīgurupādukām paramānandapūritaḥ śakti kope [śaktipāde] maheśāni bhūyo natvā guroḥ padam astauṣīt parayā bhaktyā saṃsārasāgare sthitaḥ arūparūpaṃ sphuṭameva satyaṃ kṛpāvatāraṃ khalu śūnyarūpam prakāśabhāvaṃ praṇamāmi nityam yajjñānajaṃ locanameva satyaṃ sa ca praviṣṭastvayi nātha satyam tameva kālīṃ paramārthabījaṃ namāmyahaṃ taccaraṇāravindam prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne teṣāṃ muktipradā bhava gaccha śīghraṃ yonipīṭhaṃ devīśikharamāśritaḥ acirādvāñchitā [tasiddhiḥ] siddhirbhavitā te na saṃśayaḥ evaṃ vadati sā kālī tasmādveśyāparo bhava tasmādbhrāntiṃ parityajya kuladharmaṃ samāśraya viśuddhacitto bhūyāccet siddhiḥ syādaparārdhagā

yonipīṭhaṃ samāsādya devīśikharamāśritaḥ pañcaveśyārato bhūtvā kulācāraparāyaṇaḥ vidyārājñīṃ ghorakālīmaniruddhasarasvatīm [-aniruddhyāṃ] kālī karālavadanā tejorūpā sanātanī taddṛṣṭvā sumahattejo bhairavo bhayavihvalaḥ āśvāsyovāca taṃ krodhaṃ vācā'mṛtasamānayā muhurmuhurnanāmāsau tataḥ kālīmuvāca ha mano'bhīṣṭaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ sarvadā me manomayī nityaṃ nigrāhakastvaṃ hi bhava bhairavasattama sa me putratvamāgacchet satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ tava vaktraṃ kālarūpaṃ sarvanigrāhakaṃ param mahākālo bhairavo'pi vajrapāṇirbabhūva saḥ vajrapāṇirmahākālīprasādādīśvarābhidhaḥ gopanīyaṃ sadā bhadre yoniḥ paranare yathā idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi kāmarūpasya nirṇayam bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ deva kiṃ me tat kathyatāṃ vibho pūrṇaśailasya sambhūtistretāyugamukhe'bhavat ghorasya kalipāpasya vināśāya maheśvari trayaṃ trayaṃ mahākṣetraṃ puṇyāraṇyaṃ trayaṃ trayam pratipīṭhe sthitā gaṅgā pārvatī pratipīṭhake kalau gṛhāt sudūre ca tīrthabuddhiḥ prajāyate pratipīṭhe pṛthagdharma ācāraśca pṛthak pṛthak pṛthak pūjā pṛthaṅmantro martye ca tārapīṭhakam jālandharantu pāścātye pūrṇapīṭhantu pūrvataḥ jālandharantu vāyavye kolāpūrantu [kolvā-] uttare

śrīhaṭṭamapi pūrve ca upapīṭhānyatho śṛṇu prastāre oḍrapīṭhasya āyāme'ti guṇaṃ bhavet caturdvārasamāyuktaṃ vāyuvimbena cihnitam tatra someśvaraṃ liṅgamādipīṭhaṃ tathā param kṣetraṃ virajasaṃjñañca ekāmraṃ tadanantaram kuśasthalī mahāpuṇyā daṇḍakasya vanaṃ tathā paścime dhenukāraṇye uttare tu gayāśiraḥ triṃśadyojanavistīrṇamāyāme śatayojanam bhūgolapīṭhakaṃ nāma yatra vai golakeśvaraḥ avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ haṃsaprapatanaṃ tathā kurukṣetraṃ tu tatraiva yatra māyāsvanā nadī kacātmakaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ tatra pātālaśaṅkaraḥ dakṣiṇe vṛṣabhaṃ liṅgamuttare kadalīvanam ānanābhaṃ tathā padmaṃ raktavarṇaṃ vibhāvayet aśītyaṣṭau ca prastāre trikoṇaṃ pīṭhamuttamam sītāyāśca mahākṣetramagastasyāśramastathā mādhavāraṇyakaṃ kṣetraṃ harasyāraṇyakaṃ tathā uttare brahmakṣetrañca dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhi etanmadhyatamaṃ pīṭaṃ puṇyākhyaṃ nāma nāmataḥ śivarātrau ca gamanaṃ sauramāsena māsakam tatpuṇyaṃ tatsamaṃ vettha navavyūhaṃ trimaṇḍalam madhyapīṭhaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ yatra kāmeśvaro bhavet kanyāśramaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra rudrapadadvayam mānasaṃ kṣetrakañcaiva yatra viśveśvaro haraḥ picchilā yā dakṣiṇato gautamasya mahāphalā

dakṣiṇe mandaśailaśca uttare vihagācalaḥ ayutatrayañca trissrotaḥ pañcodbhavaṃ tathā daśa tasmin vasati sā devī jñānāddhyānādbhavo'pi vā saumāramiti kathyate dikkarasya ca vāyavye nīlapīṭhaṃ sudurlabham pārijātaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatrādityastu śaṅkaraḥ śivam pūrve sauraśilāraṇyaṃ paścime svarṇadī śubhā etanmadhyagataṃ pīṭhaṃ [puṇyaṃ] bhuktimuktipradāyakam sahasrayojanavyāsaṃ [-vyāmaṃ] hayatāmrañca pañcamam saumārākhyaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ śivatattvañca pīṭhakam kedārakṣetraṃ prathamaṃ yatra kedāraśaṅkaraḥ durgāraṇyaṃ somāraṇyaṃ bhadrāraṇyaṃ tathaiva ca cauhārākhyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra gatvā na śocati nandanaṃ pārijātañca śivāraṇyaṃ tathā param purve tu hīrikā nāma nadī puṇyatamā smṛtā dakṣiṇe nāthavṛkṣastu pīṭhantu parikīrtitam māsahīnantu prastāre tripīṭhaṃ nāma nāmataḥ kumārakṣetraṃ prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ nandanādvayam siddhāraṇyaṃ dvitīyantu tṛtīyaṃ vipulaṃ vanam pañcatīrthaṃ bhavet pūrve paścime dhanadā nadī etanmadhyagataṃ devi śrīpīṭhaṃ nāma nāmataḥ abhyarcya vidhivadbhaktyā paścād yātrāṃ samācaret gurupitroranujñāpya brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ siṃhe dhanuṣi meṣe ca na gacchet pūrvapīṭhakam

vṛṣe'ṅganāyāṃ makare na gaccheddakṣiṇālayam karkaṭe kīṭamīne ca na gaccheduttaraṃ sudhīḥ makare karkaṭe mīne nair-ṛtyāṃ parivarjayet siṃhe mīne karkaṭe ca aiśānyāṃ tu na cintayet na gacchenmandavāre ca pūrvadeśaṃ mama priye kujavāre tathottaraṃ [cottaraṃ ca budhe'pi] budhe cāpi diśaṃ bhajet śanivāre tathaiśānyāṃ some cāgnau viśeṣataḥ na gacchedyātriko yātrāṃ yoginī sammukhā yataḥ trayodaśī pañcamī ca na gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam pūrṇimā saptamī caiva vāyavyāṃ sarvathā tyajet viṣkumbhaḥ prītirāyuṣmān pratipatsu vivarjayet sukarmā ca dhṛtiścaiva tṛtīyāyāṃ vijānīhi caturthyāṃ varjayeddevi pañcamyāṃ harṣaṇaṃ tathā varīyān parighaścaiva saptamyāṃ parivarjayet navamyāṃ śubhaśukrañca daśamyāṃ brahma eva ca uttarātrayaṃ trayodaśyāṃ viśākhāntu caturdaśīm pratipat kṛttikāyāntu dvitīyāyāntu jyeṣṭhake yātrāyāntu na duṣṭaṃ syāt karaṇasya vicintanam aṣṭamyāñca navamyāñca sadākāleṣu varjayet godhūlisamaye caiva pūrvadeśe vijānīhi aiśānyāñca tathā rātrau nair-ṛtyāṃ sandhyayordvayoḥ vāruṇādiṣu yogeṣu yathākāle samācaret prācīdiśaṃ samāgacched yātrāṃ kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ kusumaṃ yāvakaḥ śaṅkho bherī vādyañca bhūmipaḥ siddhānnaṃ māṃsapiṇḍañca bhaktaṃ bhājanajaṃ gurum

kanyā vai mithunaṃ veśyā pūrṇakumbhāḥ striyastathā agre dadhiphalaṃ yātrā śubhadā parikīrtitā tadā siddhiṃ vijānīyādanyathā vighnamādiśet na kuryād yātriko yātrāṃ vāyase vanasaṃsthite krandanaṃ kalahaṃ śrutvā na gacchettu kadācana devatādar"anaṃ yātrāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ naiva kārayet vāpīkūpataḍāgādi yantrasyārambhakastathā devavrataṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ yajñasyārambhaṇaṃ tathā prāgdarśanañca devānāṃ na kurvīta kadācana na kālaniyamastatra tathā ca rohiṇīvrate deśadāhe grahāṇāñca viśubhaṃ karma ārabhet ityarthaṃḥ) nepāle'vantyāṃ ca budhasya hi mathurāyāmarkajñasya rāhoraṅge ca baṅgake jālandhare caturhastamūrmikaṃ hastapūrṇake kolvapīṭhe turyahastaṃ cauhāre dviguṇaṃ bhavet upapīṭhe ca pātāle hastameva vijānīhi baladevāśrame caiva tathā kanyāśrameṣu ca yānenārthaphalaṃ vidyāttathācchatre ca pāduke tīrthe prāpyānuṣaṅgena tīrthasya ca phalaṃ labhet tīrthe cācamanaṃ varjet pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathā anyatīrtharatiñcaiva sadā tīrtheṣu dūṣaṇam na tīrthatīre nivased dakṣiṇe tu viśeṣataḥ tīrthe tathottare bhāge [tīrthasyottare bhāge ca] aṣṭakoṭisahasraśaḥ tīrtheṣu brāhmaṇaṃ naiva parīkṣecca kadācana vanditavyāśca pūjyāśca teṣāṃ vākyena pūtatā

na kālaniyamaḥ śrāddhe piṇḍe tu varjayenmadhu grahaṇe caiva tīrthe ca tathā ca pitṛvāsare brāhmaṇe dānayogyaṃ na śrāddhayogyaṃ na tadbhavet nāvāhanaṃ na cārghyañca na cāgnīkaraṇaṃ tathā tīrthaśrāddhe na kurvīta vāsaḥ sūtrapradāpanam śrāddhaṃ samāpya tat piṇḍaṃ na dadyācca kadācana divase daśa cāṣṭau ca pañca saptatrayaṃ tathā lauhitye caiva śoṇe ca gayāyāṃ virajeṣu ca mukurāṅge ca ekāmre maṇḍalañca vivarjayet aṣṭāvaṣṭau samānte [vatsarānte] vā muṇḍanañca punaścaret uttarābhimukho bhūtvā bāndhavān snāpayedbudhaḥ tattirthasya turīyāṅgaṃ phalaṃ prāpya na saṃśayaḥ kṛtvā tīrthaphalasyārdhaṃ brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate na snāpayettvāptagotraṃ na tīrthe tu pratigraham na gṛhṇīyādito'nyatra tilaṃ gāñca viśeṣataḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena parayajñaṃ vivarjayet sadāsau saṃsthitastatra pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ tattu pīṭhaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ sāmprataṃ priye vāyukūṭasya carame dhanurhastapramāṇataḥ tantuvāyuṃ samabhyarcya vāyulokamavāpnuyāt dakṣiṇe ṣaṇmukhaśca jayantaśca aśvakrānte janārdanaḥ yo vasedvāyukūṭe tu dhanānāmadhipo bhavet pāpī bhavati godante aśvakrānte tu muktidaḥ lauhityamadhye deveśi dhanustriṃśat pramāṇataḥ

uttare candraśailasya tyajet ṣoḍhā dhanurbudhaḥ pañcaviṃśatidairghyeṇa candrakuṇḍāhvayaṃ saraḥ candratīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ samam sudhīśavaṃśasambhūta mādhavaprītidāyaka bhṛguḥ prāyaḥ sarvayugaṃ ādipaṃktisamanvitam nādabindusamāyuktaṃ punarjāntaṃ subhāvikam meṣe mīne paurṇamāsyāṃ japan kāmamanuṃ niśi snānañca divase kuryānmahāpātakanāśanam avacchinnamantrasiktastu yāvattiṣṭhati medinī tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge caturdhanaḥpramāṇataḥ kārtike śuklapakṣe tu snānaṃ tatra samācaret tasmānna saṃśayastīrthaṃ viṣṇutuṣṭipradāyakam tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge aṣṭāviṃśaddhanurmitam varṣāsu caturo māsān yastatra snānamacaret mantreṇa snānaṃ kuryāttu arghyadānena [arghyabhāvena] sādhakaḥ amṛtādhivāsaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇināṃ kilviṣāt param snātvā [svāhā mukteḥ] ṛṇatrayānmukto bhavabandho na jāyate māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ snātvā muktiñca vindati dakṣiṇe aśvakrāntasya kiñcidāgneyagocare nāgalokādutthitaśca kalkirūpī [devadevo] janārdanah samāharet] brahmaṇāsevite puṇye vārāṇasyāḥ kalādhike gṛhāṇārghyaṃ sastrīkaśca yuktiṃ tatra dadāmyaham namaḥ aśvamedhādikaṃ puṇyaṃ mausalasnānamātrataḥ

dānamakṣayatāṃ yāti pitṛṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā sa yogaḥ padmako nāma aśvakrānte sudurlabhaḥ snānaṃ ye'tra kariṣyanti teṣāṃ lokā mahodayāḥ kariṣyanti maheśāni satyametadudāhṛtam kārtikī tu viśeṣeṇa puṇyā [sarva] pāpaharā parā yadā tu snānamātreṇa śubhairapi subhāvitaiḥ upapātakasaṃsargāḥ svayaṃ yānti mumukṣayā tat prāpnoti naraḥ kṣipramalpāyāsena śāṅkari yathāśaktyā ca bhaktyā ca sa vibhurbhuvane vaset [viṣṇuloke mudā] yaḥ karoti naraḥ so'pi mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt te'pi tasyānubhāvena svargaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ te mṛtāḥ svargamārūḍhāḥ padmāsanacaturbhujāḥ prāyopaveśaṃ ye tatra prakurvanti narottamāḥ nṛtyanti pitarasteṣāṃ tuṣṭāścaiva pitāmahā spṛṣṭvā [spṛṣṭāstu] tu pāpinastatra mucyante bhavabandhanāt yāvadatandritaḥ ye punarbhāvitātmānastatra snātvā janārdanam brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro nityaṃ sannihitāstrayaḥ virajāmalatoyaṃ [virajamamantraṃ] tat triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ye tu varṣaśataṃ sāgryamagnihotramupāsate sarvayajñaphalaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam tīrthe trisandhyā samupāsitā] bhṛṅgāreṇa karaṅkeṇa mṛṇmayenāpi śāṅkari samādhinā samādheyāt saprāṇāyāmapūrvakam tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi bhavet sandhyā suvanditā

upavāse'pyanantaśca prāpnoti sumahat phalam ekāhaṃ yo vaset tīrthe sa tat puṇyaphalaṃ labhet saṃśayaḥ] tatra tasmai dadyādataḥ param pāṭhaḥ kha pustake] saṅgamastu varṣāsu ca pradṛśyate yastatra muṇḍanaṃ kuryāt prayāge muṇḍanaṃ phalam iha loke daridro yo bhraṣṭarājyo'thava punaḥ kṛtvā pūjopahārañca devānāṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ekacakro [cakravartī] bhaved rājā satyametanna saṃśayaḥ bhavanti vividhāstasya yairyātrā kartike kṛtā śṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva pramucyate bahuvarṣaśatena ca kimatra bahunoktena na tadastīti bhāṣitam sarvayajñaphalaṃ tulyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam yairgatvā aśvatīrthe tu snātaṃ sakṛd yathāvidhi śikhariṇīñca pradātṝṇāṃ yuvatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ kāśīvāse yugānyaṣṭau dinaikaṃ puruṣottame tat sadṛśaṃ guṇaṃ vidyādaśvatīrthe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe sarvakratoradhikamapyadhikaṃ bhavāmbhaḥ ca kasmin sthāne bhavān sthitaḥ nāmnā ca katamaṃ sthānaṃ śobhate dharaṇītale kānyakubje vedagarbho bhṛgukacche pitāmahaḥ prabhāse padmajanmā ca svarganadyāṃ surapriyaḥ nīlācale ca kāmeśaḥ piṅgalo hastiparvate bhasmācale bhayānandaścandrakūṭe ca mādhavaḥ bhadrapīṭhe ca divyeśo aśvakrānte janārdanaḥ

padmapāṇiḥ kuśahaste mānaśaile munīśvaraḥ kanyāśrame ca rudro'haṃ [bhavedrudro] maināke viśvanādakaḥ mūlikākhye tathā viṣṇurmahendre bhārgavastathā maṇikūṭe hayagrīvo varāho vinduparvate parameṣṭhī brahmaputre viśvaśaile tu gahvaraḥ vṛndāvane padmapāṇiḥ kuśahastastu naimiṣe bhāgīrathyāṃ padmagarbhaḥ kāmpille kanakapriyaḥ vaśiṣṭhaścārvude caiva śvetanadyāṃ manobhavaḥ yajñagarbhastu āgastye urvaśyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ vāyanaścaiva gomante kāśyāṃ viśveśvarāhvayaḥ gangādharo madrapīṭhe mātaṅge caiva tryambakaḥ gaṅgāhrade trilokeśo bhittipuryāṃ divākaraḥ dāsavane mahāliṅgaḥ aśoke tu vināśakaḥ mārkaṇḍeyo vaṭe caiva ikṣudvāre divākaraḥ aṣṭottaraśataṃ sthānaṃ mayā te parikīrtitam eteṣāmapi yastvekaṃ paśyet ca bhaktimānnaraḥ mānasaṃ vācikañcaiva kāyikaṃ yacca duṣkṛtam bhavati mokṣamārgī ca yatrāhaṃ tatra saṃsthitaḥ dhyānena ca sthireṇāśu prāpsyate parameśvari dvāviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ kṣetraṃ paramadurlabham pūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ jyotirvyomaphalaṃ labhet uṣitvā tatra deveśi prāpsyate paramaṃ padam dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ aśvatīrthaṃ kalau yuge yadanyatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe yāti ca lāghavam dvādaśāhaṃ daśāhaṃ vā māsārdhaṃ māsameva vā

mahādevaṃ tato devī praṇatā paripṛcchati kathaṃ tat kṣayamāpnoti tanmāmācakṣva śaṅkara sarvatīrtheṣu vikhyātamaśvakrāntamataḥ param etadeva paraṃ jñānametadeva paraṃ tapaḥ yathā nārāyaṇaḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ śerṣa tapastaptaṃ kṛtañca yat aśvakrānte paro yogo aśvakrānte parā gatiḥ merumandaratulyo'pi rāśiḥ pāpasya sarvaśaḥ aśvakrāntaṃ sthitaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pāṃśubhirvāyuneritaiḥ na sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gayādvāre ca puṣkare na dānairna tapobhirna yajñairnāpi ca vidyayā brahmahāpi adhyāgacchedaśvakrāntaṃ kadācana na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kadācidapi dṛśyate sarvo'pyasya śubhaḥ kāla aśvakrānte varānane aśvatīrthe tu kākinyāṃ dattāyāṃ labhate'kṣayam phalaṃ varṣasahasrasya labhate matparāyaṇaḥ ekāhañca vaseccātra tayostulyaṃ [tattulyaṃ] phalaṃ bhavet tat phalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ aśvatīrthe kṣaṇe kṣaṇe sevanāccaiva madhyāhne aparāhṇe ca śāṅkari aśvakrāntaṃ samāsādya sarvo vrajati saṃkṣayam sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ brahmalokoparisthitaḥ yathā surāṇāṃ sarveṣāmādistu madhusūdanaḥ anulomavilomābhyāṃ tathā vyastasamastayoḥ tathaivottaramāraṇye tadeva phalamaśnute pañcakālokanādeva naraḥ prāpnoti tat phalam

sānnidhyamaśvatīrthe ca muktidvārasamīpataḥ tāvat pañcakamṛtastu brahmaloke mahīyate nirdahet pātakaṃ sarvaṃ sakṛt snātvā tu śāṅkari ekena janmanā muktiṃ [sa tu] yogānmokṣañca vindati sarvataḥ ekaikaśo maheśāni [yaḥ karoti] punāti saptamaṃ kulam dhanuraṣṭapramāṇena siddhakuṇḍamihocyate dvijātīnāntu kathitaṃ tīrthānāmiha sevanam enolopī brahmacārī tīrthānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt punīhi sarvapāpebhyastīrthavarya namo'stu te trayodaśyāṃ snānamātre punātyubhayataḥ kulam catuṣaṣṭidhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmasaraḥ smṛtam pāpakartṝnapi pitṛn tārayennātra saṃśayaḥ svayantu brahmaṇā sṛṣṭam īśvarapriyakāmyayā ityanena tu mantreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi datvā dānañca vidhivad brahmaloke mahīyate rāmakṣetraṃ vijānīyāt tasya kuṇḍaṃ kule priye tīrthebhyaḥ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ rāmatīrthaṃ varānane tava tīre mahābhāga śrīrāmeṇa mahātmanā ityanena tu mantreṇa vaiśākhe kṛṣṇapakṣake tasya pūrve navadhanuḥ sītātīrthaṃ varānane tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti saśarīrā dvijātayaḥ sītayā rāmabhadreṇa nirmitaṃ tīrthamuttamam maunī bhūtvā trayodaśyāṃ tatra snātvā mahāphalam mucyate sarvapāpebhyo brahmaloke vasenmṛtaḥ

tatrābhiṣekamātrañca vijayī sarvadā bhavet tatra liṅgaṃ maheśasya vijayaṃ nāma viśrutam uṣitvā tatra deveśi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ śambhornivāsaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ īpsitān labhate kāmān rudrasya dayito bhavet vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa snātvārghyaṃ vinivedayet yogakuṇḍa mahābhāga māṃ punātvamarārcita tatrāpi [tasyāti] snātvā vidhivat santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ snātvā kaulena bījena tattvenārghyaṃ nivedayet tithihastamitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ devagandharvasevitam indraśailasya yāme tu dhanurdvādaśamanataḥ adṛśyamūrtirbhagavān saptāśvarathavāhanaḥ [tatra saptaratheritaḥ] yadā haraśca [mahāharaśca] niratanivāsaṃ kṛtavāniha bhānubījena snātvā tu arghyaṃ tāreṇa dāpayet durgakūpadvayaṃ tatra brahmayūpaśca tiṣṭhati mantrāṇāmayutaṃ japan pitṛṃśca tārayettena brahmaloke mahīyate yasya mitrasya yadvittaṃ śodhayet pūrvajanmani maṇīśvaraṃ tataḥ paśyennirayācca pramucyate indrakūṭasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā maṇināthaṃ sa vāyunā carame lomatīrthasya dhanuḥ pañcapramāṇataḥ nāgakuṇḍe hi vaikuṇṭhaḥ snātvā nāgān samarcayet [samāhvayet] snānaṃ kurvanti ye martyā bhaktyā śrāvaṇapañcamīm śrādhaṃ pitṛṇāṃ ye tatra kariṣyanti narā bhuvi candrāduttarataḥ śailaścatuḥṣaṣṭipramāṇataḥ

gayāśīrṣaṃ pūrvabhāge dhanurdvāviṃśamānataḥ gayātīrthaṃ paraṃ guhyaṃ pitṝṇāñcātivallabham yātrābhede dadet piṇḍaṃ gayāyāñca sakṛtpriye gāyanti pitaro gītaṃ kīrtayanti maharṣayaḥ eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrāḥ śīlavanto guṇānvitāḥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇastu viśeṣataḥ dhanyāstu khalu te martyā gayāyāṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ pāyasena ca tilapiṇyākakairdeyaṃ bhaktimadbhirnaraiḥ sadā mūṣikagṛdhrakākāśca nānudṛśyaṃ caranti te kartuṃ tatra prayatnena bhuktirevāca kāraṇam āyuḥ putrān dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ kāmānanyān prayacchati akālepyathavā kāle gayāśrāddhaṃ sadā naraiḥ piṇḍadānañca tenāptaṃ pitṛṇāñcāti vallabham āśayā parayā bhaktyā āśāmeṣāṃ prapūrayet acchinnā santatisteṣāṃ sadākālaṃ bhaviṣyati pitaraścaiva karhicit taiḥ satvaraṃ tattat kāryaṃ dvijaiḥ pitṛparāyaṇaiḥ viṣuve tu tathā vāpi janmanakṣatrapīḍane kṛte śrāddhe nave puṃsāṃ pīḍā bhavati dehajā śatrurājabhayaṃ tathā] labhate nātra sandehaḥ prajāpativaro yathā mātṛmukhyaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ pitṛmukhyantu anyataḥ pātayet kṣīradhārāśca ārohet somaparvatam kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ

gṛhaṃ gatvā samabhyarcya gṛhadevīṃ yathāvidhi yuñjīta brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ dakṣiṇāmupapātayet daśāśvamedhikaścaiva tathā viṣṇupadeṣu ca punarākarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śāpaḥ patati mūrdhani āgastye viraje caiva pātayecca dinatrayam somaśailasya aiśānyāṃ dṛṣṭimātrāntare priye maṇīśvarasya aiśānye kiñcit pūrvādigocare dvāviṃśad dhanurāyāmaṃ sarvadevaiśca saṃyutam karatoyā divyanadī lohityo ghargharastataḥ dṛṣadvatī devikā ca tathā carmaṇvatī nadī kāverī yamunā caiva ye cānye nānukīrtitāḥ udadhirgahvaraścaiva kṣīrodaśca tathā payaḥ hradāśca saritaścaiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ samāyānti sumadhyame jaganmāye jagadbīje jagatpāpapraṇāśini ityanena tu mantreṇa anyenārghyaṃ nivedayet dvāviṃśatidhanurmānaṃ kuṇḍaṃ maṇikarṇikāhvayam satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ satyameva suniścitam yugādiṣu ca saṅkrāntau uparāge maheśvari maṇikarṇe suraśreṣṭhe maṇīśvari maṇipriye mantreṇānena snātvā tu praṇipatya prapūjayet [visarjayet] nīraṃ nīraṃ vahantīva pāpaughāni punīhi mām [prārthayenmantramuccaran] kalāhastadvayāṃśena siddhakṣetramihocyate mantro'yaṃ devadevasya ṛṣigargairudāhṛta [ṛṣi gargaṃ-]

chando'nuṣṭup bhavo [rudro] deva iṣṭārthe viniyojayet paramaṃ mṛgastham saṃjñam] paścāddevaṃ vāmanaṃ kālasaṃjñam svairmantraiḥ svīyakalpoditaiśca aiśānyāṃ maṅgalā devi etanmadhyatamaṃ priye dakṣavaktre ca kāmeśīṃ hayagrīvantu paścime pūrvavaktre ca virajā uttare kauśalodbhavam ramaṇāyāḥ samudbhūtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pañcaśataṃ śatam bhūmyantarasthaṃ lakṣañca sārdhalakṣaṃ jale priye bhūmipīṭhe saptalakṣaṃ vṛkṣamūle tu lakṣakam sandhyā sandhyāṃśake caiva kuṇḍaṃ lauhityapāvanam tryaṃśe sandhyāṃśake caiva yadā śūdro bhavennṛpaḥ ante naiva śākeśvarī sphuṭitā madhyameṃ'śake bhūśāke mādhavo vyaktaḥ sudhāṃśe virajā priye vāyavye mānaśailasya varāho nāma parvataḥ tasya pūrvadakṣiṇe ca naranārāyaṇaṃ saraḥ tasya paścimatīre ca liṅgaṃ someśvaraṃ param [haram] sevanāt kṛtapiṇḍānāṃ pāpajit kāmadaṃ nṛṇām sa śatadhanurāyāmaṃ prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam tīrthaṃ bindusaraḥ puṇyaṃ snānāt pātakanāśanam bhūliṅge ca bhavet koṭījyāmutra ca sarasvatī nāṭakācalapūrve tu mataṅgo nāma parvataḥ antargṛhamṛtā ye ca yānti brahma sanātanam maṇiśaile sthitā ye ca ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ aśvatīrthendramadhye tu brahmāvadhirudāhṛtaḥ

āṣāḍhe varṣaṇe viṣṇoryadā matsyodaraṃ bhavet śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati niścitam kārtike dṛśyate kiñcit phalaṃ daśaguṇottaram bhasmācalaṃ sthiraṃ kṛtvā samīkṣet kāmamuccaran tat kṣetrasyottare bhāge dhanurarkapramāṇataḥ māghe māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāñca samāhitaḥ dinakṣaye ca grahaṇe na snāyāddhi kadācana tāraṃ śravaṇaśūnyañca vārāhaṃ sa śikhī sthitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudrasarāṃsi ca mantreṇa vidhivat snātvā uttarāśāmukhena tu pūrvāśāmajjanaṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmīḥ sthirāyate [vimucyate (?)] ṛṣayaḥ siddhagandharvāstīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca bhṛgvantaṃ gaganaṃ devi bhṛguḥ svargāntiko manuḥ ravivāśare raktāṃśo viṃśasambhūta mahāpātakanāśana tat pūrve tu pañcadhanuḥ kāmākhyaṃ nāma vai saraḥ dhātrīphalaṃ mukhe kṛtvā yastu snānaṃ samācaret caitre sitatrayodaśyāṃ snātvā rājyañca vindati saṃskṛtaḥ sūryatīrthe cārghyadānaṃ yaḥ karoti varāṅgane dvādaśakṛttathāṣṭau vā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet snātvā ravyudaye kāle kuṣṭhī pāpādvimucyate tatrābhyarcyārghyadānena sā nārī puṣpitā bhavet sapta janmani dāridryaṃ mṛte sā [tadabhijāyate] cābhijāyate karavīreṇa vārkeṇa tathā dhātrīphalena ca

abhāve karavīrasya patrāṇyapi nivedayet tathā raktatayā devi śastaṃ bhāskarapūjane ekañca karavīrañca raktapadmasahasrakam tasmāt sarvaprayatnena karavīreṇa pūjayet uccaret karavīreti na tathā koṭijāpyataḥ saṃvatsarasya madhye tu vāraikaṃ saptamīvratam aparāhṇaṃ paraṃ kālaṃ pareśāni [vijānīhi vratasya ca] vijānīhi dvipakvaṃ varjayed yasmād ghṛtañcaiva kalāpakam amlañcaiva tathā tiktaṃ dūṣitañca na bhakṣayet madanasya dakṣabhāge dhanuḥ paṃktipramāṇataḥ gaṅgātīre naraḥ snātvā pitṝn devāṃśca tarpayet viṣṇupādarajaḥsambhūte gaṅge tripathagāmini tulāyāṃ makare caiva śuklāṣṭamyāñca bhāmini tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥ yaḥ śrutvā majjayenmartyaḥ sarvajñatvamavāpnuyāt kāmākhyāyāśca krīḍārthamāgastyaṃ kuṇḍamuttamam devadānavavidyādhṛgvanditaṃ [-gandharva-] sarvakāmadam śalyenotpāditaṃ kuṇḍaṃ mahādevyāśca tuṣṭaye daśamyāṃ snānamātreṇa puṣkarasya phalaṃ labhet sahasrajanmajaṃ pāpaṃ viṣuve ca dinakṣaye snānañca varjayeddevi bhāryāhānirbhavedyataḥ [dhruvam] guhyaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā yatra gatvā naraḥ sadyo mucyate sarvapatakaiḥ gaṅgādisaritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāḥ sapta eva hi yathā carācaraṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhāsayellaghu

āgneye tasya kṣetrasya kiñcit paścimagocare vāsave parame tīrthe snātvābhyarcya ca vāsavam vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa dharaṇyārghyaṃ [indrāya-] nivedayet tatrāmbhasi nimajyātha yathoktaphalado bhava dhanuḥsaptapramāṇena rambhātīrthaṃ maheśvari sahabhartrā mṛtā yā ca jñānānnārī pativratā yāti nāstyatra sandehaḥ śeṣe ca guruvāsare kāmadravi namaste'stu trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt kṣetrasya paścime bhāge dhanustriṃśat pramāṇataḥ mukhasya kṣālanaṃ kṛtvā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā snānaṃ kandarpabījena śṛṇu kṣālanamantrakam rūpavānaśvinoryāti rūpaṃ satyena dehi me pitṝṇāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ snānād yāti parāṃ gatim tṛptihetormahābhāga aghorānmāṃ punīhi ca agastyasya tu dakṣe ca gatvā snātvā ca tarpya ca tatra gatvā ca saptamyāṃ pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet pāvanaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sa māṃ punātu pāpataḥ pidhāya tilakaṃ dadyāt kṣetraṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam tatra devi ṣoḍaśake pitṝn samarcayed budhaḥ dakṣiṇādi kramāccātra ekaikairhastakaṃ catuḥ gayākūpe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devamumāpatim viṣṇurbrahmā ca rudraśca agastyaśca śatakratuḥ cyavanaḥ kaśyapaścaiva pulastyaśca yathākramāt atra mātuḥ pṛthak piṇḍamanyatra patinā saha nākasthāśca divaṃ yānti svargasthā mokṣamāpnuyuḥ

ye cāpyakṛtacūḍāśca ye ca garbhādviniḥsṛtāḥ bhūmau dattena tṛpyantu tṛptā yāntu parāṃ gatim mātā pitāmahī caiva tathaiva prapitāmahī nihatāśca ye agnidagdhāśca ye kecinnāgnidagdhāstathā pare paśuyonigatā ye ca pakṣikīṭasarīsṛpāḥ asaṃkhyajanasaṃsthā ye ye nītā yamaśāsanam jātyantarasahasrāṇi bhramanti svena karmaṇā anyeṣāṃ yātanāsthānāṃ pretalokanivāsinām ye bāndhavābāndhavā vā ye'nyajanmani bāndhavāḥ ye ye pitṛkule jātāḥ kule mātustathaiva ca ye ye kule luptapiṇḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ teṣāṃ piṇḍaṃ mayā dattamakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām kuladvaye ye mama dāsabhūtā mṛtāstathaivāmṛtasevakāśca devo gadādharastatra praṇipatya pradāpayet mayā gayāṃ samāsādya pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā tvameva sākṣī bhagavānanṛṇo'ham ṛṇatrayāt vartulaṃ kārayet piṇḍaṃ kṣīradhārāṃ ca pātayet tatra mātṛgayā devi dakṣiṇena sutīrthakam taṃ praṇamya prayatnena na bhūyo jāyate naraḥ dṛṣṭvā maunena viprarṣiḥ pitṝṇāmanugo bhavet urvaśyā dakṣiṇe tīre yā śilā kanakaprabhā upāgamya tu nāmaśaḥ sāvitrīñcaiva madhyāhne dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet tatra piṇḍapradānena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī
