taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ mucyate vai ṛṇatrayāt makare vartamāne ca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ tadbrahmakalpitaṃ sthānaṃ viprā brahmaprakalpitāḥ tarpayettu gayāviprān havyakavyavidhānataḥ yaḥ karoti mahādānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ karoti yaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭi dhanurmānaṃ kṣetramāgastyamīritam urvaśī ca tathā sūryaḥ kāmaḥ putraśca vāsavaḥ udbandhanamṛtā ye ca galapāśamṛtāśca ye nāntyeṣṭirna ca dāhaśca nāśaucaṃ teṣu vidyate amāyāñca samārabhya kuryāccaiva trirātrakam viphalā ca kriyā teṣāṃ careccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam anyatīrthe [aśvatīrthe] kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gayāyāntu vinaśyati rāmakṣetre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ maṇikūṭe vinaśyati nīlaśaile kṛtaṃ pāpamantargehe vinaśyati maṅgalāyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpam āgastye tu vinaśyati mandare yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepe vinaśyati [vajralepo bhaviṣyati] aśvakrānte kṛtaṃ pāpam urvaśyāṃ tadvyapohati dinaṃ nayenmaheśāni rātrau viṣṇuvicintanam tato'nyadivase kālyā [vipra] āgastye snānamācaret tatra svāhā maheśāni agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet janmajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ hara me parameśvari devasya pūrvabhāge tu vāpī tiṣṭhati śobhanā āgneye bhasmaśailasya dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥ piśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinam vāyavye bhasma kūṭasya dhanurmadanamānataḥ [dhanurvadana-]

pūjanīyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ tasmin snāto varārohe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati tasyottare dhanuḥ pañca kapilā nāma vai śive kapilāhnadatīrthe'smin snātvā saṃyatamānasaḥ pūrvāśābhimukhenaiva ārohedbhasmakūṭakam ārohayāmi śikharaṃ bhasmakūṭaṃ namo'stu te daśajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati dhanaṃ putraṃ kalatrañca sarvaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt vṛṣadhvajasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu devi varānane tadā bhasmācalaṃ gatvā devamabhyarcya yatnataḥ gandhādyaiḥ snāpayelliṅgaṃ kamalaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ mahātmānaṃ tataḥ kuryānmāsānte pratiparvaṇi prasādena tu mantreṇa rudrapuṣpeṇa pūjayet yaścaturo devadevaḥ dhāma dharmaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ haram śaktīḥ sampūjayeccaiva rāmādyāḥ proktalakṣaṇāḥ pīṭheśāṃśca tathā bāhye pīṭheśāṃścāgrato'rcayet nandīśaṃ mukuṭañcaiva dikpālān pūjayet kramāt praṇamya parameśānam idaṃ stotramudāharet hiraṇyakṝtacūḍāya hiraṇyapataye namaḥ namo bālārkavarṇāya jvaladrūpadharāya ca bhavāṅgojjhitakeśāya muktakeśāya vai namaḥ varṇāśrameṇa vidhivat pṛthak karmapravartine śvetapiṅgalanetrāya kṛṣṇavaktrekṣaṇāya ca namastriśūlahastāya umākāntāya vai namaḥ

prasīda pārvatīkānta umānandāya vai namaḥ praṇamya pūjayitvā ca imaṃ mantramudīrayet nirvighnā pātu me siddhiryasmāt pūjā kṛtā'dya me arcayāmyadya deveśa ājñayā te maheśvaram [-ra] devasya paścime bhāge mātaṅgaṃ nāma kṣetrakam mātaṅgaṃ pūjayettatra gaṅgādyairbhaktimānnaraḥ tatrastho mandiraṃ paśyeddakṣiṇābhimukhena tu namo mandaraśailāya viṣṇurūpāya vedhase vīkṣet sandhyācalaṃ paścādimaṃ mantramudīrayet tato'rghyaṃ bhānave dadyāttilavārikuśānvitam ādityasya vratāṅge tu arghyadāne viśeṣataḥ vicakṣaṇaḥ daśāśvamedhanair-ṛtye dākṣiṇye mama sundari tatrārohaṇamāntreṇa sukṛtañca vinaśyati kaliḥ spṛśati yāṃ dhārāṃ sā dhārā mama vāhinī mandarasya hi caiśānyāṃ dhanuḥṣoḍaśakaṃ mitam grahāpadoṣajañcaiva pātakaṃ yat kṛtaṃ bahu taddoṣāt pātakaṃ yacca sarvaṃ snānādvinaśyati cakrāṅkitaṃ bhaveddevi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā tat phalaṃ prāpya [prāpyate jantuḥ] tejasvī mṛte haripuraṃ vrajet tīrtharāja namaste'stu trāhi māṃ bhavabandhanāt cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā vedhasaṃ yastu pūjayet cakratīrthaṃ spṛśan śailaṃ nandanaṃ nāma parvatam janārdanañca deveśaṃ kalau bauddhasvarūpiṇam karkaśaṃ pauṇḍravardhañca yā śilācakra udgatā

janārdanasya cihnañca rūpañca parikīrtitam dakṣiṇe gajaśailasya paścime śaubhraliṅgakam evaṃ śatamitaṃ kṣetramasambhavādikaṃ smṛtam tatra piṇdapradānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ eṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana kaliśeṣasya [kalāvetasya] pūrve tu dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥ tatra piṇḍapradānena na preto jāyate kvacit liṅgaṃ laulaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tiladugdhaiḥ pratarpayet kalidvāparayoḥ sandhau dhanurardhapramāṇataḥ bandhanāt aṅgāreśañca siddheśaṃ gayādityaṃ gajaṃ tathā gayāgoleśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā snāpayitvā janārdanam brahmalokaṃ prayāntīha puruṣā ekaviṃśatiḥ cakratīrthaṃ gamiṣyanti vāramekaṃ dine dine kupādaṣṭaguṇaṃ devi śreṣṭhā mātṛgayā śubhe gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet pañcakāntaṃ kāmarūpaṃ picchilāntā sarit śubhe viraje ca tadhā cāśve karṇivāme ca somake yatrāgastye mahākṣetre svakaṃ piṇḍaṃ dadettu yaḥ svahaste tu vṛṣotsargaṃ yaḥ karotyaurdhvadaihikam pitrośca jīvatoḥ putro na kuryādaurddhvadehikam kṣayakṛṣṇagate putre triputre vā maheśvari dānañcaiva vṛṣotsargaṃ kuryānnaiva daśāhikam ekatra maṇḍale kuṇḍe vṛṣotsargaṃ pṛthak caret paragotrakṛte caiva svalpālpaṃ phalamāpnuyāt

pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ gacchet pratigrahavivarjitā svargārohaṇasopānaḥ pitṝṇāntu pade pade aśvatīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ nīlakūṭe ca pañcake ārustye muṇḍanaṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ janārdanam viṣuvaddvaye āmaśrāddhe āmamāṃsaṃ pradadyādavicārataḥ sāmiṣantu kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yastu bhuṅkte nirāmiṣam dīrghatantumayaṃ kuryād gṛhītvā tatra śāṅkari nirāmiṣaḥ kṛto yena kuryāt śrāddhaṃ nirāmiṣam sadyo nimantrayet śrāddhe karma kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayed yastu bhuṅkte viṣṭhāñca śāṅkari gaudhaṃ kaurmañca śālvañca śāśakaṃ śaukaraṃ tathā akalau tu gavāṃ māṃsaṃ sārameyañca tattvavit kṛṣṇacchāgasya māṃsena pitṝn yastu pratarpayet hīnendriyachāgamāṃsairyastu pitṝn pratarpayet māhiṣaṃ dvādaśābdena tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī cāmareṇa śataṃ varṣaṃ sāhasraṃ godhayā priye śālūmāṃsena [vārāheṇa tu] ṣaṇmāsaṃ śāśakena navaiva tu śatābdaṃ [ṣaḍabdaṃ] cāmareṇaiva sthūlamāṃsantu varjayet atisthūlamiti proktaṃ tasmāt tat pūrvasūribhiḥ mārgasya vṛhadājasya sthūlasyāpi hi śasyate caturnakhaṃ vārijātaṃ varjayecca mama priye varjayet kūrmakaṃ vidvān yadi cakreṇa cihnitam mahāśalkaṃ prauṣṭhikañca matsyaṃ ca pārvatīyakam

bhakṣaṇe somadhānyasya vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇañcaret rājadhānyaṃ śiśnadhānyaṃ [sisna-] bhakṣaṇād viṣṇulokabhāk nārāyaṇaṃ mādhavasya bhogañca mama sundari nimantritaṃ brāhmaṇañca yadi śrāddhe vivarjayet nimantrito yadi gṛhe bhuṅkte vipraḥ kathañcana nimantrito vratasthaśca brahmacāryathavā punaḥ sadyoghṛtaṃ sadādhānyaṃ māṃsaṃ tailaṃ tathaiva ca gayāśrāddhe pretapakṣe tathānumaraṇe priye muktitīrthaṃ vinā viprā nānugacchet svakaṃ patim kriyā kāryā daśāhena anyatra tu nivārakam paryuṣite śave caiva kṣayakuṣṭhiśave tathā bahuputrā sagarbhā ca tathā caiva rajasvalā tato'nugamanārthañca ekāhaṃ sthāpayet śavam videśamaraṇe caivabharturyadvastu vidyate tṛtīyāyāṃ mṛto bhartā caturthyāmapyanu vrajet ekatra maraṇe devi piṇḍamekatra nirvapet dampatyoścaiva piṇḍañca vartulaṃ kārayennaraḥ na piṇḍena saha kṣīraṃ śuṣkāmraṃ na kadācana dāḍimaṃ bījapūrañca urvārukaphalaṃ tathā kaśeruñca yugānañja kapilākṣīrameva ca jambūphalañca padmākṣaṃ jīvantīñca nivedayet kuladharmamanujñāya dātavyaṃ mantrapūrvakam mantravarjañca vidhivad vahnipākavivarjitaḥ śikhareṣu girīndrāṇāṃ puṇyadeśe tu śāṅkari saṅgrāmeṣu nadīnāñca sāgareṣu ca saptasu

divyapādapamūleṣu tulasīmadhyageṣu ca virajasyottare tīre lauhityasya ca dakṣiṇe pūrveṣu karatoyāyā na deyaṃ śrāddhamucyate paurṇamāsīṣu śrāddhañca kartavyamakṣagocare naimittikaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ karmākarmādikeṣu ca kanyāgate savitari dināni daśa pañca ca yo dadāti guḍairmiśrān tilān vā śrāddhakarmaṇi kṛttikāsu pitṝnarcya muktimāpnoti mānavaḥ madhāsu ca prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu ca api naḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa cāhave yadā pañcadaśaśrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmyabhāvataḥ daśamyādikamārabhya pañcamyādikameva ca śrāddhaṃ kuryādamāvasyāṃ māsi māsi tadā kvacit nityaśrāddhe tarpaṇe ca surārcā nityapūjane śrāddhāśaktau pretapakṣe brāhmaṇān bhojayet priye pitrośca jīvatordevi yajñādau śrāddhavāsare abhojite hato yajñaḥ śrāddhañcāpi hataṃ bhavet brāhmaṇānāṃ bahūnāñca bhojane ca maheśvari gayāṃ gaṅgāṃ tato gatvā kuryāt śrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ tāvat pitṛpurī śūnyā yāvad viṣṇoḥ prabodhanam niśvasya pratigacchanti śāpaṃ datvā suduṣkaram khaḍgapātreṇa deveśi jīvatpitṛko varjayet kadāpi gayāṃ vrajet evaṃ śāstreṣu niścitam
