śāsanaṃ hṛdayaṃ vahneḥ priyā dhruvavapuḥ saraḥ kulaṃ dhānvantaraṃ yāvad viṣṇukuṇḍamiti śrutam guru cāruśilārūpam agre mañjusamanvitam prāṇasthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yoniśca saritāṃ patiḥ snātvānena varārohe ekādaśyāñca phālgune vṛndārakāhvayaḥ [-samaḥ] śrīmān rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokañca gacchati ekādaśadhanurmānaṃ śivakuṇḍamiti śrutam śivakuṇḍe caturdaśyāṃ māsi māsi mama priye tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ viṣṇusnānasamudbhavam snātvā cānena mantreṇa haṃsenārghyaṃ nivedayet pūjayet kamalaiḥ śvetaiḥ karavīraiḥ sitaiḥ śubhaiḥ javāḍhyañca [pūjāḍhyañca] natiḥ paścāduddharet janakādiṣu nārado'sya ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā hariḥ śvetañca dvibhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ cakraśaṅkhalasatkaram dhyānaṃ kṛtvārcayeddhīmān pātrapūrvāditaḥ kramāt bālāñca kamalāñcaiva tathā saṅkarṣaṇādikam lauhitye vidhivat snātvā pāṇḍunātha prapūjayet manvantaragataṃ sāgraṃ [yāvat] jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ vaiṣṇavam pāṇḍunātha namaste'stu namaste mokṣakāraka nirmalāmbhodasaṅkāśa [nirmalārkasya] namaste puruṣottama namaste hemagarbhābha [hemagarbhāya] namaste garuḍadhvaja namaste'ñjanasaṅkāśa namaste bhaktavatsala namaste vibudhāvāsa namaste vibudhapriya

namaste vibudhaśreṣṭha namaste kamalodbhava namaste nīlameghābha namaste tridaśārcita narasiṃha mahāvīrya trāhi māṃ dīptalocana devasya nair-ṛte bhāge dhanuḥpañcapramāṇataḥ saṃhitāṃ prajapettatra gītaśāstraśca sañjapet labhate nātra sandeha ekāvarte sahasrakam devasya pūrvabhāge tu dhanustāvat pramāṇataḥ śrībījena samabhyarcya mālatīkusumairyajet paurṇamāsyāṃ tulārke tu lakṣmīstasya prasīdati dhanuraṣṭapramāṇañca kolakṣetraṃ vijānīhi lolaṃ dṛṣṭvārcayedbhaktyā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati dhanuryugmapramāṇena tatra snātvā śriyaṃ labhet mantrena snātvā śrītīrthe gatimāpnotyanuttamām śriyaṃ dehi yaśo dehi pāpaṃ hara namostu te tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam dakṣiṇāmūrtimantreṇa snātvā svarge mahīyate daśajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ hara tīrthaṃ namo'stu te dhanurvedapramāṇañca campakeśaṃ samarcayet mucyate sarvapāpaiśca brahmalokaṃ vrajed yataḥ tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ manasā saṃsmared yastu puṣkarantu maheśvari tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ tatra snātvā bhavenmukto brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam tadābhigamya deveśaṃ purūhūtamaninditam kamalāsya [he puṣkara] mahābhāga namaste ca tripuṣkara

anena snānaṃ kuryāttu anenārghyaṃ nivedayet aṣṭāviṃśaddhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ vadarikāśramam gosahasraphalaṃ prāpyaṃ [prāptaṃ] snātvābhyarcya harerdine ekena śatakoṭīnāṃ vratasya phalamāpnuyāt prāsādena samabhyarcya rudratvamadhigacchati pūjayitvā tatra rudraṃ prasannaṃ parameśvaram pūjayitvā namaskuryād gośatānāṃ phalaṃ labhet kumāratīrthe yaḥ snāyād gāṇapatyañca vindati naramāraṇyakaṃ devi [tīrthaṃ] sarvadevagaṇairvṛtam oṃ oṃ īṃ hūṃ jagadvyāpta pāpaṃ hara kumāraka tatra devo mahādevaḥ sthāṇurityabhidhīyate tadvanaṃ campakaṃ nāma siddhabrahmarṣivanditam brahmakūṭasya dhanade śilāpañcakamadhyagam daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa snātvā kāmānavāpnuyāt trikṛtvā pañcamaṃ vātha kṛṣṇavijayapuṣpakaiḥ pūjayitvā paraṃ devaṃ naraḥ śrutidharo bhavet sāpi tadgatimāpnoti śaratkāle viśeṣataḥ bilvapatreṇa deveśi śāśvatīṃ siddhimāpnuyāt kaulaśca viṣṇuśailaśca śaṅkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ nīlaśveto bhūbhāge uttare saṃsthitācalaḥ kamalaśca śikhā caiva kapoto marutācalaḥ dyumantaḥ kanakaścaiva vāyavyo nīlalohitaḥ lohitaḥ kamalaścaiva nair-ṛte nir-ṛtistathā paścime brahmayūpaśca hayamedho girīśvaraḥ ādityo vāyukoṇe tu vāyurbhallātakastathā

aiśānyāṃ maṇḍalaścaiva aśvakrāntaḥ sacandrakaḥ tato gacchennīlaśailaṃ madhyāhne parameśvari viṣuve ayane vātha ravisaṃkramaṇe tathā uttare muktikāmastu rājyakāmastu paścime hatarājyo bhaved rājā anyeṣāṃ jāyate kṣayaḥ vāyavye cāgninair-ṛtye mahābhayakaraṃ bhavet nāgahārottarīyañca vṛṣabhasthaṃ vicintayet mantreṇārohayet śailam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet nīlaścaiva [nīlo hyeṣa] mahābāho dharmakāmārthamokṣada durgākūpe tu pūrvasyāṃ devamāmnātakeśvaram tasya devasya yāmye tu dhanuraṣṭāntare priye tasya pūrveṇaiva dhanuḥ saṃsthitaśca trivikramaḥ tasyāṃśapañcakaṃ yāvad dhanureva pramāṇataḥ krīḍāpuṣkariṇī sā tu kāmākhyāyāḥ sureśvari tasya paścimatīre ca snātvā tatra ca maṇḍalam pañcame'nyadine prāpte jale snātvā vidhānataḥ pitṝn santārayatyāśu devī loke pramodate namoṅkārau vaṣaṭ svāhā pāpaṃ hara namo'stu te aiśānye tasya kuṇḍasya lohityo nāma vai saraḥ agnau kuṇḍaṃ kālahastaṃ yāmalaṃ nāma vai saraḥ nair-ṛte pañcakaṃ hastaṃ saubhāgye parameśvari kolābhyantargataṃ kuṇḍaṃ saubhāgyaparikīrtitam saubhāgye tāni sarvāṇi mandībhūte divākare tulāviṣuvasaṅkrāntyāṃ yastu snānaṃ samācaret gaṃgāsaro vijānīyāt snātvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet

anantākhyaṃ vijānīyāt kuṇḍaṃ tasyopari priye bhāryām aputraḥ putravān bhavet snātvā saṃvīkṣayeddevīmagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet sarvatīrtheṣu deveśi na kuryāt kāmyatarpaṇam vārāṇasīhrade caiva bhārgave merupuṣkare pṛthvīpradakṣiṇe yacca phalaṃ proktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ kuṇḍasyāgneyabhāge ca tulādūre vyavasthitam smareṇa [svareṇa] bhāvayuktena natyantena prapūjayet lakṣmīkānta namaste'stu ananta puruṣottama namo varadaliṅgāya kamalāya namo namaḥ stutvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā tato devīgṛhaṃ vrajet pañcāmṛtena toyena snapayet suśubhairjalaiḥ kāmatantraṃ [kāmamantraṃ] kuśītena likheddakṣe mama priye devyaṅge citrake puṣṭimaṇau khaḍge ca śāṅkari yantre tantre śālagrāme maṇḍalañca visarjayet na gṛhṇāti ca tat pūjāṃ padaṃ [tyaktvā] viṣṇorbrajet puram mahāmaṇḍalakaṃ devyāḥ saṃsthitastatra pūjayet aṣṭahastaṃ sapulakaṃ liṅgaṃ lakṣārdhasaṃyutam bahumātramitañcaiva prastāre dvādaśāṅgulam urvaśī yamunā dhārā kāverī ca sarasvatī yāti nāstyatra sandeho yo viṣṇuṃ pūjayed hṛdā māsatrayādhike ṣaṣṭivarṣe śuṣkabalā bhavet śuṣkadhārā bāhye viṇmūtramādiśet bāhye bhavati durbhikṣaṃ tatra kaścinna saṃśayaḥ hṛtarājyo bhaved rājā pararāṣṭrasamāgamaḥ

karavīraṃ ghṛtānvitam trimadhvāktena deveśi godhāmāṃsena vā sudhīḥ āvartitena kṣīreṇa ājyayuktena homayet anantasya ca pāścātye asirnāma sthitā nadī tat paścime ca yā dhārā varuṇā nāma sā nadī siddheśvaraṃ koṭiliṅgaṃ hemakaṃ muktimaṇḍalam pratimāsu ca lauhitye caiva gaṅgāyāṃ sāgare tīrthasaṅgame yatra kāmaśilā caiva pīṭhaṃ tanmaṇipūrakam śilāyāṃ parva tasyāgre tathā parvatagahvare sampūrṇaphaladāyinī āryāvarte madhyadeśe brahmāvarte tathaiva ca [śrīhaṭṭake] daśaguṇā smṛtā tasmāt śataguṇaṃ bhadre maṇikūṭe maheśvari tato daśaguṇā proktā aśvatīrthe jale sthale sarvottamā yathā anyatra viralā devī kāmarūpe gṛhe gṛhe sa ceha labhate kāmān paratra śivarūpatām vāñchitārthaṃ varo labdhvā cirāyurbhavati dhruvam ||] mahāmāyāṃ na gacchet siddhimānasaḥ snānena vīkṣayet spṛśejjātu yuvatiṃ ca viśeṣataḥ na vrajet pārvatīgṛham caivādīkṣitena ca nāgajaistilakaṃ kuryān mṛgacarmaṇi saṃviśet

tato dīkṣeti deveśi [nāmnā ca khyāyate] kathitā tattvacintakaiḥ paramajñānadā yataḥ vijñānaphaladā saiva [cādye] dvitīyā [-ye] layakāriṇī sādhārā [ca nirādhārā dīkṣāsiddhividhānataḥ (nirālambā nirādhārā)] sā hi vijñeyā nirādhārā ca muktidā manovyāpāramātreṇa nirvīryā sammatā [bhavati dhruvam] tathā kunakhī śyāvadantaścādhikāṅgaḥ strījitastathā syāt samayācāravittathā svapnalabdhañca strīdattaṃ saṃskāreṇaiva śudhyati tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti anyathā viphalaṃ bhavet raveḥ saṃkrāntidivase yugādyāyāṃ sureśvari mahāpūjādine vāpi śiṣyaśuddhidineṣu vā devīpūjāvidhau yastu manuṣyo bhaktitatparaḥ caitre duḥkhāya dīkṣā syād vaiśākhe sarvasiddhidā śrāvaṇe bahuhāniḥ syād bhādre ca duḥkhadā matā śubhakṛnmārgaśīrṣe ca pauṣe jñānavināśinī grahaṇe ca mahātīrthe nāsti kālasya niścayaḥ koṅkaṇe ca mataṅge ca tathā kanyāśrameṣu ca kartavyaṃ dīkṣitaiḥ śiṣyairguroḥ śāsanamuttamam puraścaraṇacārī syād viśuddhātmā jitendriyaḥ prāptamityevamāno'pi guruṇā jñāpitaḥ sadā sayavaṃ cakravākañca krauñcaṃ pārāvataṃ tathā ityevaṃ dīkṣitenaiva kartavyaṃ divasaṃ tathā tasyāpi pūrvadivasaṃ haviṣyaṃ vā nirāmiṣam caruṃ śrapitvā bhāgārdhaṃ devatāyai nivedayet

bhuktvā ca guruṇā sārdhaṃ sarvadīkṣāsvayaṃ vidhiḥ mohāndhakāranarake kṛmirbhavati nānyathā tasya devaḥ sadā ruṣṭaḥ śāpaṃ dattvā vrajet puram puṣpaprākārasaṅkīrṇe gandhapuṣpādivāsite phalikādau tato mantrī mantraṃ tatra samuddharet yantre samuddharen mantraṃ sambhṛṇaṃ vā prapūritam bhūmau tiṣṭhati deveśi janmajanmani mūrkhatā vaṃśe naivollikhed varṇaṃ tasya hānirbhaved dhruvam mahālakṣmīpradaścaiva suvarṇasya śalākayā tathā agnimaye devi putrapautradhanāgamaḥ aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena daśāṅgulamathāpi vā tattadakṣasaṃkhyānāṃ svalpāyuryāti vai dine māsenāpi phalaṃ vindyādamāne śrīrhatā bhavet daśāṅgulaṃ tathāṣṭau ca ato hīnaṃ na kārayet samabhāge maheśāni hastādau rūpabandhanam [bedhakam] prādeśādau bhavedvedhaṃ dvyaṅgule vā samācaret bhāryāhānirbhavedāśu dhanānāṃ vā kṣayo bhavet pustakaṃ kārayet priye anyavṛkṣatvaci devi tathā ketakipatrake anyapatre bahudale likhitvā yaḥ samabhyaset bhavet pīḍā vartulaṃ śubhadaṃ bhavet satye'kṣare sthitaḥ śambhuḥ śūlapāṇistrilocanaḥ kṛte yuge pinākī ca kalau lipyakṣare hariḥ hariñca [śrīhariṃ] gandhapuṣpādyairvastraiśca sumanoharaiḥ bhavedyugasahasrāṇi svargaloke vasecciram

yāvadakṣarasaṃkhyānaṃ tāvacca narake vraset mahābījaṃ vijānīyāt japān muktimavāpnuyāt svayaṃ vadet svarānte ca natiñcaiva hṛdātmikām ādyantavarṇasaṃsthasya ātmajñānavivṛddhaye mantrāḥ puṃdevatāḥ proktā vidyā strī devatā smṛtā parameṣṭhī ṛṣicchando gāyatryāḥ samudāhṛtam vidhinā sthāpayeddevīṃ vāriṇā prathamaṃ priye dinadvayāntare devi utthāyāṣṭadināntare pakṣānte caiva māsānte mahāsnānaṃ samācaret vaidikenātha mantreṇa māyayā vā samācaret arghyasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punaḥ snānaṃ karoti ca vāriṇā prathamaṃ snānaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaram tilakṣīraṃ dadhitilaṃ madhukṣīreṇa snāpayet gandhodakañca ratnānāmudakaṃ puṣpatoyakam svarṇaśaṅkhodakañcaiva tāmrādhāramanantaram pañcagavyena yo devīṃ tathā dugdhakuśodakaiḥ kapilāpañcagavyena tathā kṣīrayutena ca kṣīreṇa snapayed yastu śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ ghṛtābhyaṅgena devāṃgaghṛtena vidhivat priye bhavārṇavāt samuddhṛtya durgāloke mahīyate rājatena vimānena śivaloke mahīyate garuḍena vimānena viṣṇunā saha modate candrāṃśunirmalaḥ śrīmān candraloke mahīyate nāgalokaṃ samāsādya krīḍate saha pannagaiḥ sauvarṇayānamārūḍho modate vasubhiḥ saha

snānakāle prayojyāni devīprītikarāṇi ca bhagavatyai naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate sa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra kāmeśvarī sthitā snapayedvidhivad bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu pañcāmṛtasya pratyekaṃ phalānāñca śataṃ śatam apāṃ kumbhaśatenaiva tailasyāpi tribhiḥ palaiḥ madhyamantu tadardhena snānaṃ yatra vidhīyate evaṃ yaḥ kārayet snānaṃ naraḥ kaścit kadācana āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ saubhāgyaṃ puṣṭireva ca evaṃ yastu mahāsnānaṃ karoti bhaktimānnaraḥ daśatolikamānena dravyāṇāñca pṛthak pṛthak aṣṭāṅgulaṃ mukhaṃ tasya ekaviṃśāṅgulodaram sūryaraśmistu lekhikā sarpaṣāṇāṃ catuṣkeṇa raktiketyabhidhīyate tolikā ca catuṣpādaiścatustolaiḥ prasṛtitaḥ palārdhena bhavenmuktirdvimuktī guḍakaṃ matam candanena sugandhena kārayaṃstilakaṃ [kārayet] sudhīḥ mayūrapicchasaṅkāśāṃ snigdhacārusukeśikām yacca vai lohitaṃ cāsyaṃ suraktakajjalaprabham karālaṃ yattu vai vaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dakṣiṇagocaram sarvasiddhipradañcaiva sarvārthasya ca sādhakam kauverīnilayaṃ yacca vadanaṃ śyāmalaṃ śivam avyaktaṃ ruciraṃ divyaṃ kuñjikāvadanottamam śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam sadāraṅgena [vṛṣabhāṃkena] bhṛṅgena nipītaṃ madhusañcayam

sūryakoṭisahasrāṃśu yadvaktramūrdhvajaṃ priye para jyotirmukhaṃ bhadre narakeśena cumbitam etā maṇḍalasaṃsthāśca devyaḥ śaktisamanvitāḥ vaiyāghracarmavasanā sarvasiddhipradā [yathā caiva irodarā] śubhā sunandā locanaprītā vyaktāṣṭādaśalocanā raudrī sarvārthadāyinī nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇakaṇṭhabhūṣaṇadhāriṇī asthiratnārcitairdivyaiḥ padmakardamanālibhiḥ śṛṇu] kapālaṃ pustikā ghaṇṭā muṇḍamālā nivītinī siṃhāsanordhvasaṃsuptā śavāsanakṛtāśrayā narakeśena saṃśliṣṭā kāmākhyā parameśvarī svanāmagrahanakṣatraṃ śrīkaṇṭhanyāsapūrvakam daśadhā yantre saṃsthāpya saṃskṛtya ca yathāvidhi pūrvādikramayogena gaṇeśañca gaṇādhipam krīḍāsaro dakṣiṇe tu mandaraṃ vāmanetrakam nārasiṃhena bījena kṣetreśaṃ paripūjayet gaurīpūtrañja vaṭukaṃ tathā samayaputrakam haṃsetyanena mantreṇa dhyātvā raktena cārcayet nivṛttiśca kalā paścāt pratiṣṭhā ca kalā tataḥ māyābījena pūrvādi tatra vai hetukādikam vāmavyādikrameṇaiva kālañcaiva karālakam asitāṅgādayaścaiva brāhmyādisiddhisaṃyutāḥ ṣaṭkoṇāgre ca madanaṃ ratiputrīṃ svapārśvayoḥ āsanaṃ pūjayitvā ca uparyuparibhāvataḥ

ehyehi parameśāni sānnidhyamiha maṇḍale mahāpadmavanāntasthe kāraṇānandavigrahe kāmākṣyāvāhanaṃ kuryāditi mantreṇa śāṅkari paśūnāṃ pataye caiva sarvānandātmane sadā trinetrāya trikālāya tripurandhāya vai namaḥ lohitāya ca dhūmrāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ sūryāya sūryapataye siddhināthāya vai namaḥ sarvāśvetā kṛṣṇavarṇā godhikāyā śilā yataḥ gayātīrthañca udare uttare parikīrtitam śīrṣapārśve rāmagayā rāmapiṇḍantu dakṣiṇe tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vidhipūrveṇa karmaṇā tīrthaṃ pretaśilākhyañca śrāddha svargaṃ nayet pitṝn tathākṣayavaṭe śrāddhī brahmalokaṃ nayet pitṝn ātmayone maheśāni gayāyāntu tilairvinā paścime vāsudevasya dhanuraṣṭādaśāntare uttare mānase śrāddhī na bhūyo jāyate naraḥ dakṣiṇaṃ mānasaṃ taddhi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam mahānadyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe brahmalokaṃ nayet pitṝn gayāśire piṇḍadānād yathāpucche tathottare kāṅkṣanti pitaraḥ putrān narakād bhayabhīravaḥ paścime kāmanāthasya saptadhanvantare sthitām ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi devavad bhuvi modate sarvavidyāmavāpnoti rāśīnāmagraṇīrbhavet [vāsīnāṃ] pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā mantreṇānena pūjayet śivādhiṣṭhānarūpāya tintiḍīvṛkṣarūpiṇe

vāmahastasya saṃsparśe mālāyā grahaṇe tathā saṃskuryāt mālikāṃ devi tāmrapātre niveśayet paścāttenaiva mantreṇa hūṃ siddhyai nama ityuta tadānīya spṛśenmālāmantarīkṣeṣu vinyaset gandhacandanakaṃ datvā tathā dūrvākṣatāni ca śataṃ sāhasrakañcaiva ayutaṃ niyutaṃ tathā pratimāne cāṣṭahastaṃ sarvaparvaṇi sañjapet māle māle mahāmāle sarvatraiva svarūpiṇi puṣkarī sakhibījaṃ tvaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmānvitaṃ tathā eṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ śivaṃ japādau vinyasya japānte tu stutiṃ paṭhet anuloma vilomena mūlamantreṇa pūjayet jaya kāmeśi cāmuṇḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇi viśvamūrte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocane mahāmāye maheśāni kāmeśvari namo'stu te karāli vikarāli ca kāmeśvari namo'stu te niśumbhaśumbhamathini kāmeśvari namo'stu te kāmāṃśca dehi me nityaṃ kāmeśvari namo'stu te mahiṣāsuravadhe devi kāmeśvari namo'stu te jaya kāmaprade tuṣṭe kāmeśvari namo'stu te aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ upavāsī narottamaḥ saṃvatsareṇa labhate rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ punaḥ sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ nirvāṇamṛcchati trayīmaye devi ca te namāmi kare kapāle ca vikalpitāni śubhāśubhānāmapi tāṃ namāmi

viśvādhāre mahāmāye kāmeśvari namo'stu te kālagamye pare śānte kāmeśvari namo'stu te praṇato'smi parāṃ vīrāṃ kāmeśvari namo'stu te sarvataḥ sarvage devi kāmeśvari namo'stu te tathā vigatavastre ca darśanaṃ na tu saṃspṛśet na strīdevīṃ spṛśejjātu taddine darśanaṃ tyajet āśu [evaṃ] jyeṣṭhasitāṣṭamyāṃ kumāro nāvalokayet na rātrau saṃspṛśennārīṃ baliṃ na sparśayet kvacit viprāṇāṃ kṣīrabalayaḥ śālyannaṃ vātha pāyasam dadyāt kṣīrañca dugdhānnaṃ bhaktānnaṃ vā nivedayet rājñāṃ hi paśavaḥ śastā vaiśyānāṃ vrīhayastathā nivedayet śoṇatuṇḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā lulāyakam meṣañcātha varāhañca godhikāñca nivedayet daśabhiśchagalaireva kūrma ekaḥ praśasyate śaśakasya sahasrāṇāṃ varāhastu viśiṣyate dve sahasre lulāyasya khaḍgireko viśiṣyate dve sahasre mānuṣasya śoṇatuṇḍaḥ praśasyate śvetagrīvaśatenāpi godhikāpi varaṃ matam paśūnāñcaiva ṣaṇmāsāt parataśca balirbhavet sañjāte gugguluśuddhe śoṇākhyaṃ jambukaṃ tathā mūṣakañca karālañca kṣudramārjārameva ca śukaṃ gṛdhrañca kākolaṃ mayūraṃ citrakaṃ tathā bṛhatkapotakañcaiva khañjarīṭantathaiva ca saṃhate balidānena striyantu na vicārayet śmaśāne mahiṣaṃ dadyāddevakasya ca sannidhau

antargṛhamṛtānāñca sa yāti brahma śāśvatam patate nātra sandeho jñānadātā sadāśivaḥ mahāpātakayukto'pi yukto vāpyupapātakaiḥ akāmo vā sakāmo vā prāṇāṃstyajati tatra vai paradeśārjitaṃ vātha kṛtvā datvā baliṃ nṛpaḥ strījitaṃ vā brahmadviṣaṃ prayatnena na yojayet na nirmālyaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ tāmrapātraṃ tathaiva ca modakaṃ kṛśarañcaiva yāmārdhena maheśvari yāvaduṣṇaṃ bhavedannaṃ paramānnaṃ tathaiva ca muhūrtaṃ dadhi dugdhañca ājyaṃ yāmena śāṅkari javā bandhūkamālyañca nirmālya sārdhamāsake māsārdhena maheśāni tāmbūlaṃ dattamātrataḥ kadalī nāgaraṅgañca tathā jambūphalāni ca phalaṃ bilvañca dāḍimvaṃ jayantīṃ karkatīṃ tathā na nirmālyañca dāḍimbaṃ tathā bilvaphalaṃ priye kadalaṃ bījapūrañca dugdhaṃ pakvaṃ nivedayet ārdrakaṃ lavaṇañcaiva jīvakaṃ pippalīyakam rāmarambhāphalaṃ puṣpaṃ vadanaṃ dhūmratāpitam dhānyaṃ śrāvaṇakaṃ martyo dviḥ svinnañca vivarjayet nivedayenmahādevyai toyaṃ tasya viśeṣataḥ bakulasya phalaṃ pakvaṃ padmasya ca phalaṃ tathā śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi puṣpādhyāyaṃ samāsataḥ sitaraktaistathā puṣpairnīlapadmasya pāṇḍuraiḥ kiṃśukaistagaraiścaiva vakulaiścaiva mandaraiḥ madanaiḥ sindhuvāraiśca durvāṅkurasukomalaiḥ

sa kāmān prāpya cābhīṣṭān devīloke mahīyate notsṛjya dadyāt puṣpāṇi vanasthāni kadācana ekaikaṃ kusumaṃ yakṣā rakṣanti daśa vai yataḥ tasmādāhṛtya kusumaṃ dadyāddevān pitṝnapi iha kāmānavāpnoti durgāloke mahīyate agniṣṭomaphalaṃ labdhvā sūryaloke mahīyate jyotiṣṭomaphalaṃ prāpya sūryaloke mahīyate vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti nānyathā nīlotpalasahasreṇa yastu mālāṃ prayacchati varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi varṣakoṭiśatāni ca vakradhānyodbhavaṃ yacca sūkṣmadhānyodbhavaṃ tathā śastaṃ taṇḍulamakṣuṇṇaṃ saptāṣṭanavasaṃkhyayā aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet kuṅkumena vilipyārghaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet viliptāṃ pūjayed durgāṃ vahniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet kahlāraṃ tulasīñcaiva padmañca śreṣṭhapuṣpakam na duṣyet chinnabhinnañca jātīpuṣpañca śāṅkari śāṅkari śvetāṅgena ca kṛṣṇena vijayena na cārcayet nyāsañca tarpaṇañcaiva homaṃ paṅktyaṣṭakañcaret śuklapakṣe navamyāntu aṣṭamyāṃ parameśvarīm [-ri] sa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devī vyavasthitā snātvopavāsaniyamapūjājāgaramārjanaiḥ vimānavaramāruhya dhvajamālākulaṃ tathā ayane viṣuve caiva ṣaḍaśītimukhe priye

tat phalaṃ labhate devi navamyāṃ kārtikasya ca navamyāṃ pūjayed yastu tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu tat phalaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kiñcit prapadyate [vicārayet] muktimaṇḍapikaṃ nāma sthānaṃ paramadurlabham tataḥ kṛtāñjalirmudrāṃ kṛtvā devīṃ prasādayet saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ trāhi māṃ parameśvari tato'rcayed guruṃ bhaktyā puṣpagandhānulepanaiḥ māhātmyañca mahādevyā gītikāñcāpi kārayet māsi māsi tathāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ rathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā dṛṣṭvā tatra kadācana muktimaṇḍapikāṃ nītvā pūjayed yastu śāṅkarīm na kuryād divase yātrāṃ na ca rātrau mahāniśi sāyaṃkāle maheśāni sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet yaścaiva snapayeddevīṃ divase ca na dūṣyati skandhe devīṃ vahed yastu aśvamedhaṃ pade pade etasminnantare devyāḥ snānārthaṃ parvataṃ tathā tasyottare kāmasaro bhānuhastapramāṇataḥ kāmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yaḥ paśyet kāmamīśvaram caturbhujaṃ śūlahastaṃ khaṭvāṅgañca varābhayam dakṣiṇāmūrtiyantreṇa pūrayecca prasādayet tubhyaṃ kṛpāparāya namo māyāgehe nāśramāya namo'stute bhīmagaṇānugāya namo'stu nānābhuvanādikartre kanakairbilvapatraiśca raktarudrajaṭairapi caitre māsi trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kāmamīśvaram aṣṭamyāñca niśābhāge nayet kāmeśvarīgṛham

agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasmāt labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ yad yat prārthayate tatra tattadeva na saṃśayaḥ dhanuraṇṭāntare bhadre yajet koṭīśvarīṃ parām sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate tridhārā dṛśyate tatra madhyadhārā sarasvatī yāmune ca kṛtasnāno mucyate ghorakilviṣāt varuṇāyāṃ kṛtasnāno muktimāpnotyanuttamām ākāśagaṅgā sā devī mahāpātakanāśinī nīlaśailasthite bhadre pāpaṃ me hara jāhnavi tasyāḥ kauberadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ smareṇa pūjayelliṅgaṃ gandhyādyaiḥ pāyasairapi rātrau jāgaraṇādatra mucyate sarvapātakāt mahāśmaśāne bhagavān krīḍate strīgaṇaiḥ saha prasādanārthaṃ devasya nityamāyānti cādṛtāḥ prāptavān gāṇapatyaṃ hi devānāmapi durlabham nikṣipya mānuṣāsthīni bhasmībhūya prajāpatiḥ divyalokamavāpnoti bhinnadeho na saṃśayaḥ sampūjya tatra deveśaṃ sarvaprītaṃ pitāmaham tryaṃśañca dṛśyate tatra uttarāṅgaṃ haraṃ śrutam bhairavo dakṣiṇāṃśaśca tripuretyabhidhīyate vājimedhasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamam mahāvidyāmavāpnoti maṇḍalānnātra saṃśayaḥ sarvalokeśvaro yāti jātiśreṣṭho'bhijāyate rajanyāṃ sampradadyāttu kūrmamāṃsaṃ kadācana na spṛśet saptarātrañca śākaṃ vāmahṛdi [kāmeśvari] priye

kūṣmāṇḍaṃ parvatīyañca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ekaviṃśatisūtraiśca tathā triguṇitena ca koṣataḥ paṭṭasūtrañca abhāve raktakaṃ nyaset vānaprastho yatiścaiva brahmacārī tathā priye vāmahaste tato dhṛtvā saptabījāntaraṃ priye gṛhadvāre varadāya [samāgamya] tintiḍīkāya vai namaḥ kāmeśvarasya pṛṣṭhe tu yāvat siddheśvaraḥ sthitaḥ cātra vidhīyate agniṣṭomaśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā mātṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet vindhyeśī sā samākhyātā prayajet kamalādinā gavāmayutadānena yat phalaṃ [tatra pārvati] labhate priye tasyāḥ pūrvottare deśe iṣukṣepaśatādhike dakṣiṇena ca tasyāgraṃ [tasyāge] kiñciducce ca saṃsthitā aśvatthaṃ nandirūpañca mūle kūrmākṛtiḥ śilā gatipradīpikākāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ sarvāghanāśanam vyāsatīrthe naraḥ snātvā lalitāṃ yo'bhipūjayet viṃśaddhanvantare [sairupacihnitam] prācyāṃ vanadāsasucihnitam tasya mūlasthitā devī uccavāraṇarūpiṇī vṛkṣaṃ tatra sthitaṃ spṛṣṭvā vandhyā garbhadharā bhavet dāḍimasya ca pūrve tu nātidūre pratiṣṭhitam pūjayet kāmabījena vijayī jāyate naraḥ devaṃ gadādharaṃ tatra pūjayet kusumādinā jalpīśaṃ taṃ mahāliṅgaṃ pūjayettāvaduccaran agniṣṭomaphalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati mama priye

ekaviṃśatibhūbhāge sthitastatra sadāśivaḥ tasya devasya bhūbhāge pavitre kālahastake govindaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt pūjayeddharivāsare śaraśeṇī samākhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī tāñca sampūjya yatnena mahatīṃ śriyamāpnuyāt mahālakṣmīḥ sthitā tatra sitapuṣpeṇa pūjayet snātvā kuṇḍe dhruve nāma paurṇamāsyāṃ tathāśvine gautamasyāśramaṃ gatvā sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam paścimāduttaraṃ tāvat yāvaddakṣiṇamānasam gatvā tatra samabhyarcya brahmalokamavāpnuyāt dvādaśādityamabhyarcya uttamāṃ dīptimāpnuyāt abhyarcyendraṃ mahaiśvaryaṃ gaurisaubhāgyamāpnuyāt nārāyaṇantu sampūjya narāṇāmadhipo bhavet varāhaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhūmirājyamavāpnuyāt pāṇḍukūṭasya yā dhārā sā dhārā narmadā nadī śivaviṣṇormadhyagatā yā ca yonirviniḥsṛtā nitambastanayormadhye sā dhārā parameśvari bilvaśrīparvatānte ca yā dhārā sā sarasvatī mataṅgasya ca yā dhārā narmadā sā [prakīrtitā] na saṃśayaḥ kāmākhyāyāśca yā dhārā sā gaṅgā parikīrtitā kāmadhenvāśca yā dhārā sā vijñeyā sudharmiṇī nīlakuṇḍasya yā dhārā subhadrā parikīrtitā śakraśailasya yā dhārā urvaśī sā nigadyate yamaśailasya yā dhārā sā ca godāvarī smṛtā agniṣṭomaśatasyāpi labhate phalamuttamam

koṭiliṅgaṃ tato vīkṣet prāpayedāmarīṃ tanum koṭiliṅgantu yaḥ paśyed vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet namaḥ sahasraśīrṣāya koṭiliṅga namo'stu te namo yajñādhipataye koṭiliṅga namo'stu te pāyasañca baliṃ datvā stutvā japtvā visarjayet vetālaṃ taṃ mahādevaṃ vāme viṣṇudvikarṇakam dharmakāmārthamokṣāya krūrāya kathanāya ca tvameva brahmā viśveśa brahmarūpa namo'stu te brahmayoniṃ viśedyastu na punaryonimāviśet śivavallabhadeśe tu mokṣamārganirodhake niḥsṛto brahmayoneḥ sa gaṇeśaṃ dvāri pūjayet namo lambodara śreṣṭha devānāmiṣṭadāyaka tato gacchenmuktimārgaṃ śakrasyābhimukhe [mukho yathā] yadi urdhvaṃ kṛtayugañcaiva pārśve tretā ca dvāparaḥ taṃ praṇamya naro bhaktyā prāpnuyādaiśvaraṃ padam na jāyate punargarbhe yugadoṣairna lipyate tadyuge yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ trāhi tvaṃ [māṃ] parameśvara yadyuge [tad-] yat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tadvyapohatu bhūmijam hetubhūta [-taḥ] kṛtādīnāṃ satyadharma namo'stu te namāmi satataṃ bhaktyā pāpaṃ hara namo'stu te rājasūyāśvamedhasya tat phalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ pūjayitvā namaskṛtya brāhmaṇān bhojayettataḥ dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu tulāpuruṣadānena yat phalaṃ samudāhṛtam dakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt savitre'rghyaṃ nivedayet

utthāya sūryaṃ saṃvīkṣya paṭhenmantradvayaṃ priye namo'stu devyai girisambhavāyai namaḥ gajebhyo rakṣakebhyaśca kṣatriyebhyo namo namaḥ namaste dakṣiṇāmūrte daṇḍapāṇe namo'stu te kariṣyatīti viśvāsa etat siddhestu lakṣaṇam surādipātakaṃ ghoraṃ sa kiṃ mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati yoniṃ praviśya manujo varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vaset [bhramet] mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati so'pi guhyametanmama priye agastyasya ca tīrthe ca maṇikarṇe hrade tathā akṣatena viśeṣeṇa śatamārgasahasrakaḥ [-kaiḥ] kālākhyo raṇabhadraśca saurabhaśca mahābalaḥ ekajaṅgho'nalaścaiva kardamāliptavigrahaḥ balanāśo bhīṣaṇaśca paścimāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ keśavaścakrapāṇiśca dhanadasyottarā gaṇāḥ aviśeṣeṇa rakṣanti trayaḥ kāmeśvarīsthitāḥ dvāraṃ rakṣati vai sarvaṃ maṇḍapañca svayaṃ haraḥ śatasāhasrayakṣiṇyo muktidvārañca rakṣati kubjatīrthaṃ tato rakṣatyaṣṭabhirdaśabhiryutaiḥ vratayajñasamārambhe vighnāni nivasanti vai anyathā jāyate vighnamiti jānīhi me priye mānasāni jñānaghnāni tāni mama śṛṇu priye sannikarṣaṃ vidūraṃ vā sahasraṃ lakṣameva ca śokamohajarāvyādhitāruṇyadhananāśakam nānāvratasamākīrṇaṃ dhārmiko'smīti mānasaḥ vṛkṣapatrañca tulasī dhātrī vṛkṣaphalaṃ tathā

śivam dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ bhavedevaṃ tīrthajātaṃ jalaṃ tathā ityetāni ca vighnāni saṃyānti ca punaḥ punaḥ mana eva manuṣyāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ bandhamokṣayoḥ cittamantargataṃ duṣṭaṃ tīrthasnāne niṣidhyate putrārthī labhate putraṃ kīrtyarthī kīrtimāpnuyāt brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pāpaśuddhimavāpnuyāt kāvyārthī ca kavitvañca niḥsāraḥ sāramāpnuyāt idaṃ svastyayanaṃ dhanyaṃ yoginīnāmatantrakam ślokārdhapaṭhanādasya duṣṭagrahakṣayo bhavet liṅgāṣṭakaśataṃ cakre harikṣetrasamaṃ śubham hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇaṃ naranārīsamanvitam gṛhāṇāṃ purato ramyaṃ bhuvi catvarabhūṣitam nānātoraṇasaṅkīrṇaṃ vīthibhiḥ samalaṅkṛtam satatañca jalairdhautaṃ surābhāṇḍamivāśuci tasya pārśve ca dūre yadi hṛdayamaśuddhaṃ sarvametad viruddham [viśeṣataḥ] duṣṭāśayo duṣṭaratiḥ pranaṣṭavyadhitendriyaḥ tatra tasya kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayām yasmin pīṭhe ya ācāraḥ sa ācāro vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ annaṃ na dūṣayet tatra brāhmaṇena ca vṛtyatā vivāhavyatyayastatra parivittirna duṣyati duṣyenmatsyamāṃsakam pūrṇasandhyā svadharmeṇa kāladharmo na vidyate kāmarūpe na saṃnyāsastathā dīrghavrataṃ priye

saṃsargapātakenaiva strīdharmau dharmamāśrayet haṃsapārāvataṃ bhakṣyaṃ kūrmavārāhameva ca hīnācārastu saumāre sarvāśī sarvavikrayī kolvapīṭhe [kola-] jātidharmān svajātyuktena vartayet mahendre caiva yogī ca brahmajñānī subuddhimān etat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yat pṛṣṭaṃ hi tvayādhunā piśunāya na dātavyaṃ vedabhaktivivarjite sitaraktaistathā pītaiḥ kṛṣṇaiścānyaiśca varṇakaiḥ nityotsavaṃ pramuditaṃ nānāvāditranisvanam devatāyatanairdivyaiḥ prākārodyānamaṇḍitaiḥ striyastatra pramuditā dṛśyante tanumadhyamāḥ pīnonnatakucayugāḥ pūrṇacandrasamānanāḥ sukalpacārujaghanāḥ karṇāntāyatalocanāḥ sarāṃsi ca manojñāni prasatrasalilāni ca kadambaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ evaṃ nānāvidhairvṛkṣaiḥ pūrṇa nānāvidhai ravaiḥ āste tatra svayaṃ devo hayagrīvo janārdanaḥ puṣkariṇyastaḍāgāni vāpyaḥ kuṇḍāśca sāgarāḥ sarvalokahitārthāya rudraḥ somagaṇaiḥ saha yastatra yātrāṃ kurute vipule [pūtātmā] vijitendriyaḥ devānṛṣīnmanuṣyāṃśca pitṝn santarpayettataḥ snātvaivaṃ vidhivattatra so'śvameghaphalaṃ labhet yugādau ṣaḍaśītyāñca tathānye ca śubhe tithau pitṝṇāmakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ tat karoti na saṃśayaḥ varāhakāmayormadhye tattīrthaṃ sarvakāmadam

tatra snātvā naro yāti bhāskarasyālayaṃ prati anena snānaṃ kuryāttu paśyeddevaṃ trilocanam gokarṇaṃ vṛṣabhākāraṃ vikarṇaṃ puruṣākṛtim uttare ca sarastīre parvate bhadrakāśake pañcadhanvantare yāvadvaravīthīti kṣetrakam sampādya vidhivadbhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ triśūlābhayahastāya yajjaṭābhāradhāriṇe [jaṭābhāravidhāriṇe] yugarūpāya devāya candrahastāya viṣṇave maheśāya vṛṣasthāya jñānarūpāya jñānine apunarbhavapūrve tu navadhanvantarāya ca tatra snātvā maheśāni mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam sakṛd vārāṇasīkuṇḍe snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt [labhate kṣaṇāt] mārkaṇḍeyahrado nāma tatra snātvā vrajecchivam ye vā paśyanti ca snātvā kuṇḍe māheśvare tataḥ sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ tiṣṭhanti tatra muditāḥ kalpamekaṃ varānane vikhyāto vai hrado varaḥ] śrāddhaṃ kuryāt prayatnena upavāsaṃ samācaret gokarṇasya ca devasya [vikarṇasya] nātidūre maheśvari tatra snātvā klamaharaṃ na punarbhavamādiśet brahmakuṇḍa mahābhāga trāhi māṃ bhavasāgarāt kṛṣṇākhyaḥ śailarūpaśca varāho nāma nāmataḥ namaste] ca muktipradāyā'stu namo namaste madane parvate ramye gatvā paśyecca śaṅkaram

taṃ liṅgamavyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairnamaskāraistathā stavaiḥ sampūjya taṃ vidhānena śivalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ārohayāmi śikharaṃ pāpaṃ hara namo'stu te kṣaṇenaiva samuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati jaṭāmukuṭacandraśekharaṃ śitabhasmāṅgalepanam svasya vāme tatpuruṣe aghoramīśānam khaḍgagokṣīrayorvarṇaṃ uttaraṃ vāmadevakam pūrvaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ devaṃ gadāpadmadharaṃ param kapilaviṭaṅkadaṃṣṭraṃ [vikaṭadaṃṣṭraṃ] nīlameghāñjanopamam puṣpāñjaliṃ gṛhītvā pratimāmantreṇa pūjayet namo'stu śūlahastāya kedārāya namo namaḥ niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ praṇato'smi purātanam sarveṣāmeva goptāraṃ namaste śambhumavyayam iti prasādanaṃ kṛtvā kedārasya ca paścimam kedārañca namaskṛtya kalpavṛkṣaṃ tataḥ punaḥ namo'vyaktasvarūpāya mahāmalayavāsine kedārasya ca kauvere iṣukṣepatrayāntare saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanam tripurāre namaste'stu kamaleśa namo'stu te chatrakoragiriryo'sau sa giriḥ paripātrakaḥ aṣṭaṣaṣṭistu śaile'sminmadhya unnatako giriḥ pūrvabhage tu śailasya sthito madhuripurhariḥ kedāramudakaṃ pītvā kāmadhenuṃ spṛśedyadi anuttamottamaṃ kṣetraṃ śailaṃ mandārakaṃ priye

brahmeśvaraśca tatraiva homamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ bhāvabhūteśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam sampūjayecchivaṃ yastu mandāre kṣetraparvate prayāge saṅgame snātvā yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ dharmeśvarasya devasya kūpastiṣṭhati cāgrataḥ gosahasraphalaṃ samyak labhate ca varānane taṃ sampūjya naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate prapaśyanti bhayaṃ saṃsārasāgare dhanurekādaśānte ca tatraiva kālabhairavaḥ piśācamocane tīrthe pūjayāmāsa śūlinam pūjanīyaṃ prayatnena stotavyaṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ svayambhūstatra liṅgaṃ vai devānāmapi durlabham kṛttivāseśvaraṃ prāpya saṃsāravigatajvarāḥ sukhena muktimāyānti yathārhanti yatastathā kṛttivāseśvaraṃ prāptaṃ liṅgayonipratiṣṭhitam yadīcchettārakaṃ jñānaṃ śāśvataṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam madanācalasyeśāne iṣukṣepatrayāntare vatsahatantu liṅgānāṃ sarveṣāmuttamottamam tasya devasya vāyavye nānāvarṇena yā śilā darśanāttasya devasya gośatasya phalaṃ labhet anujñāṃ dehi pakṣīśa tvamasya darśanaṃ prati viṣṇorāyatanaṃ prāpya tatra śivajalaṃ śubham tataḥ prabhāte deveśi maṇikūṭasya cottare tatra snātvā caturdaśyāṃ māghe vā phālgune'thavā ballabhāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā nīlakaṇṭhasya darśanāt

tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā sādaramādhavam saṃsāre patitānāñca gaṅgā trāṇakarī bhavet aśokāmalasañjātā koladaṇḍaviniḥsṛtā maṇikūṭe ca saṃyātā tasya tatrādhikaṃ phalam namaste pāpavimale namo devi varāṅgane [śivaprade] svargadvārañca tatraiva imaṃ mantramudīrayet svargadvāraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ samāroheta sudurlabham arghyaṃ dadāmi dharmāya svargadvāranivāsine hrade vārāṇasīye ca mārkaṇḍeyahrarda tathā snātvā paścād durlabhāyāṃ tato harigṛhaṃ vrajet kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati viṣṇupuṣkarakaṃ nāma sarvatīrthodbhavaṃ jalam puṣkarākāramāsthāya sthito'sau vasudhātale snātvā cānena mantreṇa vāruṇaṃ tatra sañjapet maṇikūṭācale viṣṇurhayagrīvasvarūpadhṛk mantreṇārohayeddevi pītapuṣpeṇa pūjayet daṇḍahasta mahābāho kāladaityaniṣūdana pītañca dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ maṇikuṇḍalacarcitam [-maṇḍitam] sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ maṇiśailaṃ trilocanam maṇikūṭa giriśreṣṭha pītavarṇa trilocana taṃ pūrvābhimukhenaiva uttarābhimukhena vā gatvā vindhyācalaṃ paścāt kṛtvā tat triḥ pradakṣiṇam mūlena snapayeddevaṃ saugandhikajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ candanāgurupadmāni yāni kāmyāni kānicit sitāmalajalaiścaiva tathā koṣṇodakena ca

trisitaṃ candanaṃ padmamuśīraṃ parikīrtitam tīrthodakaṃ gandhatoyaṃ karpūrasyodakaṃ tathā snāpayitvā yathoktena tathā [punaḥ] snānaṃ samācaret aṣṭottarasahasraistu suvarṇaghaṭitairghaṭaiḥ aśaktastu śataṃ kuryāddaśadhā surasundari mārtikairvā ghaṭaiḥ snānamaśaktastu samācaret kumbhe kṛtvā vidhānataḥ amṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmudrāṃ tatra ca darśayet mahotsavaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snānārthaṃ devadakṣiṇe udvartanaṃ pratidinaṃ kartavyaṃ ca dināntare snehairvā rajanībhiśca taṇḍulodvartanādibhiḥ saṃghṛṣya gātraṃ patrairvā apāmārgasya mūlakaiḥ kuśena cāmareṇātha gobālena viśeṣataḥ datvā gobālakaṃ kurcaṃ sarvapāpādvyapohati [pāpānapohati] na varāhasya romeṇa na vaṃśena kadācana liṅge vā pratimāyāṃ vā śālagrāme tathaiva ca māsānte vātha pakṣānte kūrcayenmama sundari dvādaśyāṃ rāhugraste ca tailasnānaṃ na kārayet nāsikānte tathā guhye liṅge ca pulakeṣu ca raktavastrairbhavet kuṣṭhī pāṇḍuvyādhimavāpnuyāt paridhānaṃ pidhāyaivaṃ [-va] snānaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ so'pi nāśamavāpnoti dhananāśaṃ tathaiva ca bilvakāṣṭhodbhavenātha tulasīkāṣṭhakena vā pidhāya tilakaṃ śreṣṭhameṣāmekatamena ca atrālipya tato dehamayanena visarjayet

lalāṭe tu viśeṣeṇa varāṅge na kadācana pāde pṛṣṭhe tathā netre na dadyādanulepanam daridraḥ karalagne ca padalagne dhanakṣayaḥ padmapatre bilvapatre karavīradale tathā netrāṇi nāñjayeddevi kajjalaiśca viśeṣataḥ tāpayet pātayeddevi kajjalaṃ tatprakīrtitam amṛtaṃ prāpnuyāt so'pi ihaloke paratra ca so'pi mūḍho bhavedrogī kṣipraṃ vā nāśamāpnuyāt nīraiḥ samārjayedyantraṃ kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti ye vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ dvādaśākṣarabījena kṛṣṇabījena pūjayet tatrārkacandravahnīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vicintayet karṇikāyāṃ samāsīnaṃ jyotīrūpasvarūpiṇam keśavādipuraṃ kṛtvā dvādaśākṣarakaṃ nyaset cintayitvā tato yogaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam mīnarūpo varāhaśca narasiṃho'thavā punaḥ sumerośca pādapīṭhe padmakalpitamāsanam viṣṇo kamalapatrākṣa gṛhāṇa madhusūdana mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhāṇa puruṣottama gṛhāṇācamanīyaṃ tvaṃ mayā bhaktyā niveditam lokasaṃvittimātreṇa vāriṇā snapayāmyaham svarṇavarṇaprabhe hyete [prabhedena] vāsasī tava keśava mayā niveditān gandhān pratigṛhya vilipyatām sāvitrīgranthasaṃyuktamupavītamanakṣatam

tvameva jyotiṣāṃ deva dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām mayā niveditam bhaktyā naivedyaṃ tava keśava pradyumnaṃ paścime caiva tathaiśānye trivikramam tathā mahāgadāñcaiva nyaseddevasya dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe vasudhāṃ devīṃ vāṅmayaṃ tatra vinyaset vanamālyañca purataḥ śrīvatsakaustubhau tataḥ grahāṃśca dikpatīṃścaiva dadyāt puṣpabalitrayam labhedabhimatān kāmān naro nāsya tu saṃśayaḥ pūjitaṃ paśyati yastu na vighnaṃ viṣṇumavyayam janmamṛtyucarātītaḥ sa viṣṇoḥ padamāpnuyāt anvahaṃ tasya dve sandhye śvetadvīpaḥ prakalpitaḥ svanāma sarvatattvānāṃ mantra ityabhidhīyate pūjayed [pūjitaṃ] yastu deveśi gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet mudrāṃ tato nibadhnīyād yathoktakramayogataḥ aṣṭāviṃśatiraṣṭau vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā padma-śaṅkhaṃ śrīvatsañca gadāṃ garuḍameva ca arcanīyaṃ na jānanti harermantrān yathoditān vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa parameśaṃ samarcayet sahasraraśmipravarāya vedhase hayāsyarūpāya namo namaste namo'stu sūryānalatīkṣṇatejase hayāsyarūpāya namo namaste ramāpate bhuvanapate sadā namaḥ hayāsyarūpāya namo namaste (tasmai) turaṅgavadanāya namo namaste so'pyuddharet pitṛgaṇañca hare namaste tato'ghanāśanapuraghātakāya(?)hayādyarūpāya namo namaste

praṇatasuranarebhyo vājivaktro murāriḥ maṇikūṭakṛtāvāsa kamalākṣa namo'stu te tatkṣaṇāt pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kuryāt padmākāraṃ namettataḥ kṛtvāñjalistato bhaktyā [kṛtāñjaliḥ] bhramayitvā namettataḥ yo no namedbhramayitvā ca aparādho bhavettadā mohāndhakāranarake pacyate nātra saṃśayaḥ śapanti devatāstasya viphalaṃ parikīrtitam śarīre vā maheśāni tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu tāvadvarṇasahasrāṇi brahmaloke mahīyate maṇikūṭe tvayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthāpitaḥ kena vai purā kathayāmi purāvṛttaṃ pratimāyāśca sambhavam cinmayārto mahīpālaḥ pratimārthamaharniśam sargasthityantakartāraṃ paśyāmi puruṣottamam na bhuṅkte vividhān bhogān na snānaṃ na prasādhanam viṣṇoḥ pratimayogyo yaḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ tat kena vā kariṣyāmi cājñāpayatu me prabhuḥ [prabho] haridhyānaparo bhūtvā susvāpa niyatendriyaḥ ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa guptastasmai ca cakrabhṛt ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa tasmai suptāya cakrabhṛt yugāntādityavarṇābhaṃ nīlavaidūryasannibham kratunānena dānena dhiyā bhaktyā praśastayā [ca te nṛpa] yadatra pratimāṃ rājan jagatpūjyāṃ sanātanīm sāgarasya jalasyānte nānādrumavibhūṣite haste [paraśuhaste] ca paraśuṃ kṛtvā ūrmintaṃ tato vrajet

iti vākyaṃ samālocyacchedayannaviśaṅkitaḥ chitvā paraśunā [tailarasaṃ datvā] vṛkṣaṃ tadā bhūpāla cānaya evamuktvā mahābāhuḥ prayāto'darśanaṃ hariḥ tāṃ diśaṃ samudīkṣyaiva sthitastadgatamānasaḥ prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāntu satatānanyamānasaḥ taṃ dadarśa mahāvṛkṣaṃ yathā tejasvinaṃ drumam mahocchrāyaṃ mahākāyaṃ prasuptañca jalāntike nararājastathā viṣṇordrumaṃ dṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥ saptadhā drumarājaḥ sa nipapāta mahītale tadūrdhvakhaṇḍaṃ kāśmīre kabandhākārameva ca śoṇādityaṃ tadūrdhvāṅgaṃ śukreṇa sthāpitaṃ priye bhāgadvayaṃ kāmarūpe bhāgaikaṃ malaye girau prācyāṃ nāndīmaiśānye matsyākṣo nāma mādhavaḥ mahāvarāhanāmā ca yo'ṣṭādaśabhujairyutaḥ sambhavaṃ kathitaṃ devi prāpaṇaṃ śṛṇu pārvati kharjūraṃ panasañcaiva tathā tālaphalāni ca lakucaṃ madhukaṃ yuktaṃ tathā pūgaphalāni ca mūlakasya ca śākañca gājarasya [rājakasya] tathaiva ca vāstūkasya ca śākañca pālaṅgasya mama priye kuṣmāṇḍaṃ pārvatīyañca tathā cāraṇyasambhavam akālapanasañcaiva tathānyadapi varjayet ekacittaṃ samādhāya prāpaṇaṃ śṛṇu śāṅkari rājadhānyaṃ ṣaṣṭikañca devaballabhakaṃ tathā kṣārañca kṛṣṇakṣīrañca varṇañca mārtikodbhavam paśūnāñca pravakṣyāmi vanyānāṃ grāmavāsinām

śāśakantathā māhiṣaṃ varjayenmāṃsaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtantathā hāritaśca mayūraśca nārako vartakastathā vanyakukkuṭakaścaiva śarāriśca kapotakaḥ kṛṣṇamatsyāśanaścaiva patriṇāṃ tu viśiṣyate citramatsyaṃ rohitañca madguraṃ kabikaṃ tathā matsyānyetāni deyāni vibhālīñca vivarjayet kausumbhaśākaṃ piṇyākaṃ raktapādāṃśca keśarān pūtikraṃ kānakañcaiva varjayet sādhakottamaḥ abhakṣyaṃ varjayet sarvaṃ devatādhyānasādhane aharniśaṃ japed vidyāṃ tadgatenāntarātmanā rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devi tava snehāt prakāśitam prayatnena tadā martyairgantavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ sāgadeṣu ca śaileṣu nadīṣu ca saraḥsu ca tat phalaṃ kṛtsnamālokya mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ vadennaraḥ mahājyaiṣṭhyāṃ maheśāni sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ viṣṇulokaṃ naro yāti samuddhṛtya kulaṃ matam puṇyakṣayādihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāsādya tatra lokamavāpnuyāt kalpavṛkṣasya mūle tu pūjayed haricandanaiḥ yātrāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca viṣṇulokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa tāvat kālaṃ viṣṇuloke sukhaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ tatra dṛṣṭvā naraḥ kaścid viṣṇuloke mahīyate na saṃspṛśet tato devaṃ daṅgabhūmau na saṃspṛśet

aputro labhate putrān nirdhano labhate dhanam āyuḥ kīrti yaśo medhāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ dhṛtiṃ paśum yān yān samīhate bhogān dṛṣṭvā taṃ puruṣottamam akāraḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā sarvāṅgebhyo yathā śreṣṭhamuttamāṅgaṃ maheśvari varuṇo yādasāṃ yadvad yamaḥ saṃyamatāṃ yathā samudrāṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭhaḥ kṣīrodaḥ saritāṃ patiḥ na taṃ paśyāmi deveśi yastena sadṛśo bhuvi satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kṣetraṃ tat paramaṃ mahat bhuktvā bhogān vicitrāṃśca [vividhā] devayoṣitsamanvitān jāyate yogino [jāyate yogināṃ] devi jñānajño jāyate gṛhī dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā paśyeddakṣiṇasāgaram mandāraṃ [mandāraṃ ca] tannamaskṛtya brahmaloke mahīyate darśanādeva śailendra viṣṇurūpa namo'stu te brahmavidyāṃ sa vijñāya garbhavāsaṃ na saṃspṛśet [na paśyati] saṃvatsaramupoṣitvā māsamātramathāpi vā mandārasyottare bhāge yāmilā raktasannibhā kavacena tu sā pūjyā dharmārthakāmadāyinī jayāñca vijayāñcaiva bhadrakālīṃ kapālinīm madhye bhavānīṃ kālīṃ ca kālarātriṃ ca saṃyajet dhyānenadhyānaṃ [-vyānena] kuryāt śṛṇu dhyānaṃ mama priye ghorairaṭṭāṭṭahāsairduritaśataharāṃ kālarātriṃ bhajāmi viśvamūrte śubhe śuddhe virūpākṣi trilocane mahārātri vicitrāṅge gopanṛtyapriye śubhe cāmuṇḍe muṇḍamālāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre [mahāvidye] mahābale

kāli karāla vikrānte [kāli karālavaktre ca] sarvadevanamaskṛte iti saṃpūjya tāṃ devīṃ vrataṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ samvatsaraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vā pakṣaṃ vāpi tadūrdhvakam matsyamāṃsaṃ ca bhuñjaṃśca na rātrau bhojanaṃ caret pratyaṅgaṃ pūjayeddevīṃ gandhapuṣpairadīnakaiḥ [sugandhakaiḥ] kuryādamāyāṃ deveśi paśupāyasamodakaiḥ nīla raktena saṃveṣṭya pañcapallavacarcitam naivedyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyād valiñca triguṇaṃ tathā svayamarghyañca gṛhṇīta nṛtyagītamahotsavaiḥ ciñcāñca nālikāśākaṃ kalāyaṃ niṅkucaṃ tathā kaṃkāraṃ kusumaṃ jhindīṃ kundaṃ mandārameva ca pūjayitvā maheśāni pūjāsthānaṃ na vīkṣyate brāhmaṇāya tato dadyānna śūdrāya kadācana na tatrātibhayaṃ ghoraṃ sarpacaurādikaṃ tathā saputra pautro matimān samṛddhimupagacchati sa vatsareṇa labhate rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ nṛpaḥ tatra kāmeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayecca vṛṣadhvajam hayagrīvasya pūrve tu yā śilā śuklasannibhā yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānadānena kīrtitam tulasīdve (?) ca mandāre kalhāre ca tamālake tasyāḥ savye ca yā yoniḥ sā vijñeyā sarasvatī yat phalaṃ vanavāse ca vānaprasthe ca kīrtitam tasyāḥ pūrve ca vivare pañcaśeṣākṛtiḥ śilā dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya upoṣya mama sundari mukto bhavettu vai devi sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ

gandhapuṣpādibhirdhūpaiḥ praṇamya śirasā prabhum pradadyādharaśirasi tatra siddhiśca jāyate kāverī sā samākhyātā snānānnaśyati pātakam tasyāmeva caturdaśyāṃ snānāt pāpakṣayo bhavet kauśikyāṃ vidhivat snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate śiprāyāṃ snānamātreṇa daridro'pi dhanī bhavet karatoyāmupaspṛśya viṣṇuloke mahīyate tasyāḥ svacchodakaṃ pītvā na punarjāyate naraḥ aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti bhāvini narastat phalamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya ca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ naro natvā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ pramudito guṇaiḥ trisaptakulamuddhṛtya ante viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet gandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārddhaṃ yathā viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ sarvajñaḥ satyavādī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ āsādya vaiṣṇavaṃ jñānaṃ tato muktimavāpnuyāt jitendriyo jitakrodhaḥ saptasaṃvatsarāyatam kṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnoti tato'dhikataraṃ phalam viṣṇulokaṃ samāsādya na cyavanti kadācana sudūrastho'pi yo bhaktyā kīrtayet puruṣottamam yātrāṃ karoti kṛṣṇasya śraddhayā yaḥ samāhitaḥ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā harerdūrāt prāsādopari saṃsthitam āste yaścaturo māsān vārṣikān viṣṇupuṣkare sarvakāle tu tatraiva ye vasanti manīṣiṇaḥ tapastaptvānyatīrtheṣu varṣāṇāmayutaṃ naraḥ

tapasā brahmacaryeṇa saṅgatyāgena tatphalam sarvatīrtheṣu yat puṇyaṃ snānadāne prakīrtitam tat phalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ tat phalaṃ labhate tatra pratyahaṃ niyatendriyaḥ ||] so'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktiṃ gacchati durlabhām tatra dehaṃ parityajya te'pi yānti parāṃ gatim kāmarūpopakārāya āste sa puruṣottamaḥ icchannanicchannapi tatra dehaṃ saṃtyajya mokṣaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ te bhinnadehā praviśanti kṛṣṇaṃ haviryathā mantrakṛtaṃ hutāśe pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mantreṇa ca prasādayet tasmai namo'stu puruṣāya gaṇeśvarāya maṇikūṭaṃ tato gatvā prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ padam namaste sarvalokeśa bhaktānāmabhayaprada yāste mayā kṛtāḥ pūjā maṇikūṭe jagatpate evaṃ prasādya taṃ devaṃ daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca sūryāyārghyaṃ tato datvā brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ sa lokaṃ śāśvataṃ viṣṇoryāti nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ na nāstikāya mūrkhāya na kṛtaghnāya mānine kāmarūpa iti khyātaḥ svargamokṣapradāyakaḥ deśo'sau puṇyaśīlānāṃ guṇaiḥ sarvairalaṅkṛtaḥ tapaḥ svādhyāyaniratā vandyāḥ pūjyāśca te sadā praśastāḥ sarvakāryeṣu tatra deśodbhavā dvijāḥ itihāsavidaścaiva purāṇārthavidaśca [-sta] te putradārādhanairmuktā dātāraḥ satyavādinaḥ svadharmaniratāḥ śāntāstatra tiṣṭhanti dhārmikāḥ

āgastyaḥ śaunakaścaiva bhāradvājakapiñjalāḥ jāmadagnyo vaśiṣṭhaśca ātreyaśca parāśaraḥ śāṇḍilyaścāparaṃsaśca cyavano'ṅgirasastathā tasmāt [tāṃśca] pūjyāśca vandyāśca tyājyā ye śṛṇu śāṅkari te varjyāḥ pīṭhapūrvasthāḥ sauvarcala vināvadhi (?) pravakṣyāmi maheśāni śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava kapiñjalastathāgastyaḥ mādhavaśca dharādharaḥ ātreyyāścābhavad dharmo bhānuścaiva dhanañjayaḥ vatsaśca narasiṃhaśca dāmodaramahīdharau sāvarṇāḥ śaṅkaro bhānurmadhuśca madhusūdanaḥ bhāskaro bhūdharo rāmaḥ sarve śiṣṭā mahaujasāḥ bhāradvājād bhaved rāmaḥ smṛtorantargṛhe dvijaḥ vaśiṣṭhaścaiva damanaḥ kramaścaiva trivikramaḥ bhrātarau dvau dharmaratau prajāpato kamaṇḍaloḥ gaṅgānnīlāmbaro jātaḥ sa evokto maheśvari kauśikād vāsudevaśca putraścaiva mahīdharaḥ ete vaśiṣṭhāt sañjātā āśramasthāstathodgatāḥ cyavanācca bhavedrāmastathā caiva dhanañajayaḥ aparastho bhaved bradhyā narasiṃhamahīdharau ete ca pannagājjātāḥ pṛthivībhāramāśritāḥ āṅgirasāllakṣaṇaśca dharmavān satyavikramaḥ bhīmo dāmodaro vatso vedagarghaśca me priye ekaikamuttamaṃ caiṣāṃ vrātyā jātā sahasraśaḥ mahīkṣetre sthitaḥ sūryaḥ śāmbenaivāvatāritaḥ samantāt krośamātrañca bhukti muktiphalapradaḥ

māsi māsi site pakṣe pañcamyāṃ [saptamyāṃ] vijitendriyaḥ lauhitye vidhivat snātvā arcayecca [arcayati] samāhitaḥ uttirya dāsasī dhaute paridhāya sunirmale upaviśyodaye kāle prāṅmukhaḥ savitustathā vartulañcordhvakarṇikam raktapuṣpañca darbhañca prakṣipya tāmrabhājane pidhāya tanmaheśāni pātraṃ pātreṇa vinyaset nāsti] sampūjya padmañcārabhya gaganāttatra bhāskaram kṛtvārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ dhyātvā taṃ samupāhitaḥ [samupasyitaḥ] piṅgalākṣaṃ mahākāyaṃ padmahastāruṇāmbaram svarūpaṃ baladaṃ śāntaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam tatastatpātramādāya jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ tryakṣareṇa tu mantreṇa sūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet yāvanna vīkṣate viṣṇuṃ śaṅkaraṃ vā maheśvaram [sureśvaram] ādityāya śuciḥ snātvā sa labhedīpsitaṃ phalam tāntrikairvaidikairmantrairbhānostasya ca buddhimān snātvā kapotakuṇḍe ca ārohedudayācalam karaṇe vidhivat snātvā meṣārke ravivāsare saptāvarān sapta parān vaṃśānuddhṛtya pārvati upagīyamāno [-ne] gandharveḥ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati yaḥ karoti narastatra pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ labhet [bhavet] vāre tithiravau caiva sarvakāle maheśvari vimānenārkavarṇena sūryalokaṃ vrajanti te rāmeśvara iti khyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ

naro vā yadi vā nārī sarvakāmaphalaṃ labhet śatahastamidaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sūryaraśyisamudbhavam sarvatīrthāmbhasi snātvā kuśairāsicya mūrdhani dharmāraṇyasya pūrve tu saptadhanvantarāyatam sūryaraśmisamudbhūta kapotākhya saṃritpate tāreṇārghyaṃ tato datvā snātvā mantreṇa śāṅkari tasya paścimadigbhāge daśadhanvāntarāyatam phālgune vā tathā māghe saptamyāṃ snānamācaret kapotasya ca pāścātye dhanurekādaśammitam snātvā vāruṇamantreṇa vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt [sabhaktikaṃ] śrāddhañca muṇḍanaṃ kuryāddānaṃ dadyād yathāvidhi nakṣatrakūṭavāyavye śivayūpastu paścime pūrvato nāgaśailaśca tatra madhyatamaḥ priye snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ sarvamakṣayamaśnute candanaṃ nāma tat kṣetraṃ vārāṇasīsamaṃ śubham tatra snātvā ca vidhivannaraḥ kaivalyamaśnute tatra snātvā navamyāñca svargaloke |] jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt vṛṣākāragiriḥ somagiristu vṛṣabhācalaḥ candrasūryagrahe snātvā kaivalyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ tasya sampūjanād devi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate śeṣe brahmagṛhaṃ prāpya tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt tataḥ parasmin divase gacched bhasmācalaṃ prati tatra ratnāhvayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayedvijitendriyaḥ

gireraiśānyabhāge tu kānnakaṃ [kānvakaṃ] nāma vai saraḥ tasyottarapūrvabhāge śivaviṣṇorbiladvayam gaṅgākuṇḍaṃ tu tatraiva dhanuḥṣoḍaśakaṃ mitam tasyāṃ diśi haviṣyāśī saṃyatastad [saṃyatastu] dinaṃ nayet tato'nyadivase prāpte gacchennakṣatraparvatam dakṣiṇe rasakūṭasya nātidūre vyavasthitā sā tu puṣpanadī khyātā sarvapāpapramocanī sampūrṇamāghamāse tu snātvā viṣṇupurīṃ vrajet dvāparasya tu sā gaṅgā viṣṇukūṭasamudbhavā tat tīrthe muṇḍanaṃ kuryān mahīkṣetre tu saṅgataḥ tatraṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet ihaloke hyarogī syāt śeṣe śivapuraṃ vrajet sā jñeyā maladhārā ca snātvā tatra ca kilviṣī pramādāt snānamātreṇa pauṣpakaṃ snānamācaret etat puṇyakaraṃ kṣetraṃ bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ candrikā ca nadī puṇyā tasya kṣetrasya pūrvataḥ tasya pūrvottare bhāge liṅgaṃ vai kṛttivāsasam candrikāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā sampūjya kṛttivāsasam krośāntare maheśāni pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā phenilāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā phālgune [karatāle] ca viśeṣataḥ sukṛtārghye [mṛdyotordhve] sthitā puṇyā nadī pāpapraṇāśinī caitre ca [caitryāñca] vidhivat snātvā gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet māghaśuklacaturthyāntu pūjayitvā maheśvaram trisrotā ca nadī tatra dakṣiṇasyāṃ vyavasthitā kṣīrodaśca maheśaśca guhāmadhye vyavasthitaḥ

gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvibhavairapi śaṅkaraṃ sevyamānaṃ tu samāsādya prasādayet putra pautrasamṛddhiśca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varastriyaḥ kāmākhyā pūrvabhāge tu kṣīrodā yā nadī ṣarā kṣīrodāyāḥ pūrvabhāge parvate'marakaṇṭake [śarakaṇṭake] taṃ sampūjya prayatnena na śokaṃ labhate naraḥ dṛṣṭvā taṃ liṅgamatyugraṃ śraddhayā susamāhitaḥ pūrvāgneye maheśāni parvato gandhamādanaḥ tatra sanātvāśvamedhasya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt tīrthaṃ vilvasaro [vilveśaro] nāma snātvā naśyati pātakam pūjayitvā tato bhṛṅgaṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt dakṣiṇe tasya śailasya nivedho nāma parvataḥ tatra snātvā naro nārī brahmalokamavāpnuyāt tasyottare tu lauhitye dhanuḥ saptapramāṇataḥ tatra snātvā ca tāreṇa pretatvaṃ naiva gacchati lauhitasyodadhestīre dakṣiṇe parameśvari snānaṃ tatra varārohe mahāpātakanāśanam snātvā kṣīraṃ pibennārī mṛtāpatyā bhavennahi tasyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge bhūmipīṭhe maheśvari bhṛṅgīśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tatra pūjayedbhaktitatparaḥ śaṅkaraṃ pūjayed bhaktyā brahmaloke mahīyate viṣṇulokamavāpyaivaṃ tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt kuṇḍale bibhrataṃ śubhre nāgahāravibhūṣitam sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ [-saṃyuktaṃ] jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam puṣpāñajaliṃ samādāya pratimantreṇa pūjayet

namaste bhagavan deva lokapāla jagatpate [namāmyaham] śvetarūpaṃ brahmarūpaṃ kuberaṃ taṃ samarcayet tasmin kuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate baliṃ dadyāt kuberāya vyañjanenāśūnyakam maheśasya mukhodbhūtaḥ kūrpaṭo nāma vai nadaḥ rohitākāramāsthāya sthito'sau vasudhātale ityanena tu mantreṇa snātvā tu dhanadeśvaram lauhitye vidhivad snātvā ārohed vahniparvatam prāpyate viṣṇulokañca modate viṣṇunā saha tatraiva vāruṇaṃ liṅgaṃ kuṇḍañca vāruṇāhvayam tasya pūrve nātidūre kāliṅgo nāma parvataḥ paśyati] dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca bhaktyā ca na bhūyo jāyate kvacit gaṅgātīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ snānānnaśyati pātakam snātvā ca kāmabījena spṛṣṭvā pāṇḍuśilāṃ tataḥ pustakābhayahastāya sākṣasūtradharāya ca prasādayet tato devaṃ martyasya [uttare] dṛṣṭigocare saptarṣīṇāmekaikena tadrūyaṃ parvataṃ bhajet saptācale sapta-ṛṣīn madhyādipūrvataḥ kramāt kule tasya bhayaṃ nāsti puṇyavān jāyate bhuvi tasyottare kalpavṛkṣaṃ vilvavṛkṣaṃ mahātarum vṛkṣāṇāṃ pūjanād devi tasya patreṇa śāṅkari tasya vāyavye dhanadapuraskārako giriḥ dakṣiṇe tasya devasya vāsavasya sadastrayam

madhye kuṇḍe ca adhanī dhanī bhavati nānyathā yasmin kasmin sthito devi naraḥ snātvā saro'mbhasi gaṇaṃ caṇḍaṃ kārtikeyaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tathā tasyottare madhyabhāge'ntargṛhasamīpataḥ tatra siddheśvarī yonihastadvayapramāṇataḥ tāṃ pūjayettu aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ samācaret tasyāḥ pūrve vilvakūṭe virūpākṣaṃ samarcayet parvataṃ hastirūpañca uccaughaṃ kṛṣṇasāyinam candrañca kārtikeyañca pūrvabhāge guhādvaye ākāśagaṅgācihnena raktarakṣaṃ hiraṇmayam trikoṇāntaṃ gataṃ toyaṃ ṣaṭkoṇāt teṣu veṣṭanam vṛṣodbhūtaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ vṛṣākāraṃ sarastaṭe yasteṣu tīrthaṃ vidhivat karoti niyatendriyaḥ nāṭakasya pūrve tu dṛṣṭvā nīlācalaṃ girim mantrāṇāṃ sādhane tatra vāñchitaṃ phalamāpnuyāt dakṣiṇe māraṇaṃ kuryād ramyaṃ dakṣiṇabhāgataḥ subhadrā ca layāgneye dṛṣṭimātrāntare sthitaḥ tatra dīrgheśvarīṃ yoniṃ raktapāṣāṇarūpiṇīm māyābījena kāmena aṣṭamyāṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ caturbhujā umādevī pīnonnatapayodharā jaṭāmaṇḍitaśīrṣā ca raktapretopari sthitā evaṃ kṛtvā naro vīraḥ punaryonau na jāyate durgāñca pañca tatraiva snānānnaśyati pātakam tāṃ pūjayet śrībījena nālakṣmīrjāyate kvacit pūjayecca caturdaśyāṃ śivaloke mahīyate

sampannaṃ caiva lauhitye parvataṃ kūrmarūpiṇam adhastāccaiva lauhitye dvāviṃśadhanurāyatam tatra snātvā sakṛt loke brahmaloke mahīyate kulaikaviṃśamuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate madgure parvate ramye liṅgaṃ tatra ca madguram pūrvottare tu devasya vilvāraṇye guhāntare tatraiva niḥsṛtā pūrvabhāgād girivarā nadī yāmamātraṃ paścimāśāṃ punaryāti parāṅmukhī tat kṣetraṃ durlabhaṃ loke yatra gatvā na śocati sitagaṅgā triyāmānte ambhaḥ śailā ca sāgatā tasmin kṣetravare puṇye nimeṣamāvaset sudhīḥ yatra sārdhaṃ śailaputryā jalakrīḍāṃ sadā haraḥ tatra snātvā mahāmādhyāṃ gaṅgeva phaladāyinī sarvapāpakṣayastasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate tapodhanyaḥ puṇyadeśaḥ prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate vandye tvaṃ nirmale rudre pāpaṃ hara namo'stu te satraṃ mantramataṃ śāntaṃ tathā vijayamambaram jale vā antarīkṣe vā sthale vā yo mṛto bhavet sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ vrajet brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi pāpāni vividhani ca mīne meṣe trayodaśyāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ kurute sudhīḥ phālgunyāṃ vidhivat snātvā dṛṣṭvā ca vṛṣabhadhvajam yasyāḥ paścimavāyavye iṣukṣepadvayāntare saṃyuktā somavāreṇāmāvāsyā yadā tu bhavet kulaikaviṃśamudghṛtya sa gacchet paramaṃ padam

devañca keśavaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet śvetadvīpeśvaro bhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate raktadhārā sā vijñeyā tasyāṃ snānaṃ vivarjayet tasyāṃ ca vidhivat snātvā mahākīrtimavāpnuyāt [mahāgatim] tasyāñca vidhivat snātvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ tatpūrvasyāṃ maheśāni nadī vetravatī parā tasmādīśānakāṣṭhāyāṃ yā nadī uttarasravā tripurāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣake sa yāti viṣṇusadanaṃ śarīreṇa virājitaḥ [vijānatā] pūjayet parayā bhaktyā nānānaivedyavedanaiḥ eṣā ca mandarā khyātā chinatti dīpavattamaḥ tasyāñca vidhivat snātvā sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet durvārākhyo maheśāni tatra snātvā divaṃ vrajet durvāre viṣuve snātvā kārtikyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ pañcamānasasambhūtā nadī śivajalā parā someśvaraṃ mahāliṅgaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ maheśvari tasyāsanne nātidūre padmā nāma nadī parā p. 339) padmamānasasambhūtā prathate cottarasravā kalau pañcanadī khyātā bilvakṣetre mama priye padmāvatī pañcadhārā khyātā pañcanadī smṛtā aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ śivaloke mahīyate kadambabilasaṃyātā tāñca yāmavahā nadī kadambamānasodbhūtā gaṅgeva phaladāyinī campāvatījale snātvā dṛṣṭvā śambhuṃ viśeṣataḥ liṅgasvarūpī bhagavān śambhustatra vyavasthitaḥ

tīre tasya paścimāyāṃ nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ tatra snātvāmāvāsyāñca sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet aśvamedhasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamam snātvā mantreṇa manujā divaṃ gacchanti pāritāḥ divyapure jale snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ trilocanam campāvatīṃ nadīṃ laṅghya yo'nyataḥ snānamācaret tatra snātvā sakṛnmaunī madhukūṭasya dakṣiṇe rājasūyasya yajñasya labhate phalamīpsitam sakṛd dṛṣṭvā tu tāṃ devīṃ bhaktyā pūjya praṇamya ca anyāśca tatra tiṣṭhanti virajā lokamātaraḥ āste vaitaraṇītīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param devyāḥ pūrve nātidūre kuṇḍaṃ vaitaraṇīyakam āste svayantu tatraiva kolarūpī hariḥ svayam kapilā gogṛhe somatīrthaṃ ca lobhasaṃjñake tīrthakṣetreṣu matimān viraje saṃyatendriyaḥ naraḥ svayaṃ tatra snātvāmaralokaṃ sa gacchati sa karotyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ pitṛṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ parityajanti puruṣāste mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti vai paśupāyasagandhaiśca mahāvibhavavistaraiḥ liṅgāntaragatā yonirmaṅgalā nāma candrikā vāgbhavaṃ madhyabījañca śrībījaṃ purato bhavet ṛṣiḥ syānnāradaḥ chando gāyatrī parikīrtitā dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu yojayenmama suvrate tatra saṃsthāpya kalaśamaṅgerāpūjanañcaret camakaṃ vādanenāsya praṇavādyaṃ visarjayet

kadalañca śamīpatraṃ dhatrīñca tulasīṃ tathā varālīñca tathā matsyaṃ na dadyādapi karhicit aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ samarcayet ciñcābhyaktanaraḥ pṛṣṭvā tathā pañcaśirā api abhakṣairnārcayed devīṃ nīlīraktaṃ na dāpayet mahādevyai na dadyāttu dadyād haṃsaṃ ca chāgalam javāpuṣpaṃ kuṅkumaṃ ca bilvapatra sakomalam jalajāni ca deyāni tathā kālodbhavāni ca devīṃ ca dvibhujāṃ pītāṃ svarṇakaṅkaṇadhariṇīm vistare vā tathā carmakambale puṣparetasaḥ kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhiḥ śrīmokṣau vyāghracarmaṇi carmāsane daridraḥ syāt pāṣāṇe vyādhijaṃ bhayam tṛṇāsane yaśohāniḥ parṇe ca vittavibhrabhaḥ tatraiva paścime bhāge vārāhīṃ pratipūjayet hayamedhasya yajñasya prāpyate cottamaṃ phalam dhruveṇa pañcapatreṇa gandhādyaiḥ pratipūjayet rambhātīrthaṃ vijānīyāt snānād bhayaparikṣayaḥ sarodvayaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭirdhanuṣāñca pramāṇataḥ tatra śailaṃ cañcalākhyaṃ nārohecca kadācana paścime kajjalasyānte kapilāyāśca saṅgame mṛdmūrte (?)kapilāyāśca saṅgamāvadhi śāṅkari dakṣiṇasyāṃ triyāmānte raivate parvatāntare navapīṭhasya yattīrthaṃ śṛṇu vai tasya devatāḥ ekatra tīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca ekatra caiva devatāḥ pūjayet parayā bhaktyā pratipīṭhaphalaṃ labhet

kurukṣetraṃ mahākṣetraṃ yatra brahmasaraḥ smṛtaḥ daśāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyāt nātra saṃśayaḥ tasyāṃ ca vidhivat snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati udakāpsarā tu prathame dvitīyā paścimāpsarāḥ kavilāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā makarasthe divākare muktaye sarvapāpānāṃ brahmaṇā nirmitā purā anena snānaṃ kṛtvā tu dadyādarghyaṃ vibhūtaye dṛṣṭvā kṣīrañca toyañca tato'rghyaṃ samudīritam mahāsenaṃ vahnijāyāmarghyamantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ pūrṇāyāṃ vā maheśāni śivasya sadanaṃ vrajet iha loke tvarogī syāt saṃprāpya cottamaṃ sukham kuśāvarte daivate ca samprāpte [saṃgate] kubjikāmukhe mānase kubjidhārā ca prācīdhārā sarasvatī tatra pūjā japo homaḥ kṛtaṃ bhavati dehinām dattaśrāddhaṃ tadā tatra kṛtaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ūrdhvabhāge tu yāmārdhe ekasyaiva tu saṅgamam tasyāṃ ca cāruvān snātvā rogī bhavati nānyathā pūrvasyāñcaiva yā dhārā kīrtitā sā sarasvatī uttare kṣetra aiśānye dhanuṣāñca pramāṇataḥ kubjiprāptaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṛṇāmanṛṇo bhavet kubjikāyāḥ prasādena mucyate brahmahatyayā haṃsayuktavimānena yānti sarve triviṣṭapam tāvat kṣetraṃ bhadrakālyā gatvā sampūjya kālikām kalidvāparayoḥ sandhau guptakālī sarasvatī kṣetrasyārohaṇāddevi labhate vipulāṃ śriyam

yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati nṛtyanti pitarasteṣāṃ tuṣṭāścaiva pitāmahāḥ ādīśvaraṃ mahāliṅgaṃ pūrvabhāge pratiṣṭhitam spṛṣṭvā tu mānasaṃ tatra mucyate bhavabandhanāt ye punarbhāvitātmānastatra snātvā janārdanam dhanānāṃ kāñcanaṃ yadvat pavitrāṇāñca dakṣiṇā aśvamedhastu yajñeṣu yathā śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ devarṣīṇāṃ yathā śreṣṭho nārado mama suvrate uttare kālikṣetrasya devadevo janārdanaḥ kuśāvartasya pāścātye krośamātrāntare sthitaḥ caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāmekādaśyāñca parvaṇi so'śvamedhamavāpnoti tatra vā sevane kṛte dakṣiṇe kalpavṛkṣaśca krośamātrañca madhyamam atra yaddīyate dānaṃ kurukṣetrādhikaṃ phalam prayāge kubjitīrthe vā vagāhya na punarbhavet aśvakrānte picchilāyāṃ muṇḍane uttamaṃ phalam tāvatsakhyaṃ kalpaśataṃ brahmaloke virājate bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ vrajet tatra snātvā mahāmāghyāṃ punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam abhūdbrāhmī ca vārāhī lakṣmīścaivānumadhyamā sampūjya ca trayodaśyāṃ mucyate bhavabandhanāt bhādre māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ na śoko jāyate kvacit viṣṇudhārājale snātvā nākapṛṣṭhe [svargaloke] pramodate kālidhārājale snātvā sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt kṣetraṃ śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāma kardinaṃ ha varjayet (?)

śṛṅgāṭakaṃ samāruhya pūjayecca kapardinam ante bhargagṛhaṃ yāti tato mokṣamavāpnuyāt kālanarā nadī khyātā sarvapāpapramocinī navamyāṃ vā maheśāni pūjayet pārvatīpatim viṣṇukūṭasamudbhūte pāpa hara namo'stu te vāntaṃ daśākṣarayutaṃ raśmibinduvibhūṣitam pūjane'rghyapradāne ca yo japedvijitendriyaḥ kallolā ca śikhaṇḍī [śikhinī] ca śatarudrā ghṛtārcikā catuḥ snātvā caturdaśyāṃ grahadoṣairna lipyate kallolāsaṅgame snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati vāsavaṃ snāpayāmāsa varāhasya mukhodgatā tatra śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tīre kurukṣetrasamaṃ phalam te dhanyāḥ puruṣā jātā ye vasantyuttare priye tasyāḥ pūrve ca krośānte maṅgalāyāśca paścime tasyāṃ snātvā maheśāni tatkṣaṇāt pātakī bhavet gautamasyāśramājjātā ataḥ [yataḥ] śailā [śailāt] sarasvatī pūrve sauraśilā tasya pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā yāvat [tārā] pūjāvahā devī tāvat toya na saṃspṛśet ūrdhvā yā [ūrdhvārthe] gautamakṣetrāt puṇyatoyā saridvarā tīre naiva vaset tasyāstoyaṃ naiva spṛśet kvacit uddhṛtena ca toyena yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ sitagaṅgāmbhasi snāyādāgastye vā samāhitaḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ pīṭhaṃ paramadurlabham bhadrapīṭhetivikhyātaṃ śatatīrthasamanvitam gṛhagopurasaṃyuktaṃ mahācatvarabhūṣitam

prāsādo jayamadhyastho mantro'ya parikīrtitaḥ viniyogo dharmakāme jāyate mama suvrate svastikaṃ prathamaṃ deyaṃ patrāṣṭakasamanvitam dharaṇīsadanaṃ kuryāt saraktaṃ [mūla] guṇasammatam pūrve kāmañca śrībījaṃ prāsādaṃ praṇavaṃ tathā raśmibindusamāyuktaṃ smarañcaiva vahiśchade gairikena likhitvā ca kuṅkuma-rocanena vā nāgajena sapuṣpeṇa na kuśena kadācana na kadācid budhaḥ kuryāt śambhuṃ gauryā viyojanam arghyapātraṃ svarṇamayaṃ vilvāmitrakapātrakam ekāṅgulantu śarakāsa yatra vinisammitam (?) śastaṃ bhadradārumayaṃ sahakāramapatrayā caturbhujaṃ trinetrañca dakṣiṇe ca triśūlakam śvetaṃ śvetāmbaradharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam devadānavagandharvairarcitaṃ vā manoharam asitāṅgādayaḥ patre śrīkaṇṭhādīṃśca tadvahiḥ śaṅkhapadmanidhiścāṣṭau brahmāṇamagrato'rcayet rāmādyāḥ sarvataḥ pūjyā grahāṃścaiva ca dikpatīn naivedyañcaiva pānīyaṃ śrīphalañca nivedayet modakaṃ pāyasañcaiva dhānyaṃ haimantikaṃ tathā (dhānyañcaiva nīvārādīn)] śimvīṃ karkīñca mānañca kavīraṃ madhukāni ca candraṃ śākaṃ candrabimbamagravaktraṃ prarohakam vādhrīnasañca eṇañca śaśakaṃ salakaṃ tathā vārāhañca tathā kaurmaṃ kṛṣṇacchagaṃ tathaiva ca

mahiṣasya ca khaḍgasya prayatnena vivarjayet sarārīñca kapotañca tathā pārāvataṃ sitam ṭiṭṭibhaṃ raktapucchañca hārītaṃ kāṣṭhakukkuṭam tathā citrabakaṃ navyaṃ vartakaṃ raktatuṇḍakam śastānyetāni māṃsāni varjanīyāni tvaṃ śṛṇu mayūrañcaiva dātyūhaṃ tathā ca grāmyakukkuṭam matsyaṃ vaiḍālikaṃ varjet rājīvaṃ madguraṃ tathā kuvaṅkuṭaṃ jālapādān tathā citrabakaṃ priye bhojayecca prayatnena śambhunā tān śṛṇu priye śastakaṃ vikirañcaiva varvāśākañca vṛtrakam vṛtrikā pucumardañca tathā ca hinamocikā [dīnamīcikā] puṣpāṇi yāni deyāni varjanīyāni yāni ca jalajāni ca deyāni karavīrāṇi dāpayet droṇapuṣpañca nālañca javā siṃhāsyakaṃ tathā mallikā campakāśokaṃ punnāgaṃ nāgakeśaram ketakīṃ vandhujīvañca śirīṣaṃ bakulaṃ tathā mādhyañcaiva sitāśokaṃ karṇikāraṃ vivarjayet aṣṭottarasahasreṇa śivamālā upāhṛtā varjayet sarvadeveṣu trivarṇañca vivarjayet sarvakṣṛṇaṃ sarvapītaṃ na deyaṃ mama suvrate raktakṛṣṇaṃ na dadyāt tu śvete pītaṃ na dāpayet śivamālā bāhumātrā caturaṅganasammatā jalajānāṃ yathāyogaṃ mālye dattaṃ vivarjayet hastamānena tat kuryāccaturhastaṃ tathottamam kaniṣṭhaṃ daśahastañca tathā ṣoḍaśahastakam

anyeṣāñcaiva patrāṇāṃ tatra saṃkhyā na duṣyati pañcapatrakṛtaṃ mālyaṃ śāṅkarañca na duṣyati tulasīvilvakahlāraṃ dhātrīpatraṃ tamālakam caturdaśyāṃ thā rātrau śivāya ca nivedayet na kāṣṭhena na vaṃśena na keśena kadācana śatahastamitaṃ datvā rājalakṣmīmavāpnuyāt tulasyāḥ śatahastena śivāya ca nivedayet karavīrasya raktasya dadyānmālyaṃ samāhitaḥ rājasūyasya yajñasya labhate phalamuttamam jātīyūthyoḥ kṛtā mālā sarvaśvetena duṣyati malayācalasambhūtamathavā bhṛguṇānvitam dvisamantu pradadyāttu ekaikaṃ na kadācana catuḥsamañca kathitaṃ dvisamañca kalāgaruḥ agaruṃ na dadedekaṃ guggulena samanvitam niśavo kṛṣṭakañcaiva kuśītaṃ gandhamuramadam tilatailena snehena ghṛtenābhyaṅgamācaret śālipiṣṭakacūrṇena yavacūrṇena śāṅkari vāriṇā prathamaṃ snānaṃ kṣīreṇa tadanantaram guḍena snānaṃ kuryācca kṣīradhārāñca pātayet śatena madhyamaṃ kuryāt kaniṣṭha pañcaviṃśakam śatena madhyamaṃ devi kaniṣṭhaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ arghasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryād vāruṇaṃ kalaśaṃ punaḥ astreṇa snāpayeddevi mahāsnānaṃ vidhīyate nidrārthaṃ samupāsate] māsānte vā maheśāni kūrcayet mama sundari

na kūrcayet śūkarasya vālairnaiva kadācana prabhāte snāpayelliṅgaṃ madhyāhne tadanantaram madhyandine śeṣayāme mahāpūjāvasānake saptabhirbilvapatraiśca pañcapatraiśca mārjayet nārikelajalairdevaṃ snāpayenmadhubhistathā padmapatrasya rajasā vastrakārpāsajena vā ghṛtena cālayeddīpaṃ paritaḥ pañcakaṃ nyaset snānabhojanakāle caturdaśyāmaṣṭamīṣu ca godohamātramāpekṣyaṃ pūjānte dantamātrakam pauṣasya ca trayodaśyāṃ divyeśaṃ na spṛśet kvacit tṛtīyaṃ kāmaśatruñca caturthaṃ hi vikambanam vyastena vā samastena tadā antanamo'nvitam pūrṇimā māghamāsasya magharkṣe lakṣyate yadā kāyavāṅmanasāśu tadbhāvenānanyamānasaḥ kalpavṛkṣaṃ vaṭaṃ ramyaṃ yatra sākṣājjanārdanaḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpāt saptajanmasamudbhavāt yaḥ paśyati tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhe divyanāmakam kārtikasya caturdaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ pinākinam yatphalaṃ sarvadāneṣu vratena niyamena ca dṛṣṭvā naroñjaliṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇipatya ca dṛṣṭvā liṅgaṃ naro natvā mokṣaṃ prāpnoti durlabham śriyā paramayā yuktaḥ sarvaiḥ pramuditairguṇaiḥ triḥsaptakulasamuddhṛtya naraḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet gandharvāpsarasaiḥ sārdhaṃ śivaḥ syāt sa caturbhujaḥ sarvajñaḥ satyavādī ca jāyate gatamatsaraḥ

abhyasya ca śivajñānaṃ tato muktimavāpnuyāt tasyeṣṭāni prasidhyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā rasaṃ rasāyanañcaiva pādukāñjanameva ca kamaṇḍaluṃ sākṣasūtraṃ yaṣṭimajīvanaṃ (?) tathā jvaladagnisphuliṅgormivepitaṃ triśikhaṃ yadi viṣe nyastaṃ viṣaṃ hanyāt kuṣṭhaṃ hanyāt tanau sthitam mahāgrāhagṛhīteṣu jvalamānaṃ vicintayet bālānāmaṅgakeśānāṃ rakṣā bhavati nityaśaḥ evaṃ tatra prabhāvo'pi devadevasya śāṅkari trisandhyamāsamekantu sarvarogān vināśayet laṅghane samasūtrasya brahmahatyāñca vindati nivartanaṃ punastatra vāsaṃ kṛtvā tadāvadhi yasyāgre bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā prakuryāt praṇatiṃ budhaḥ jyotirliṅgasya nirmālyaṃ naivedyaṃ parameśvari anyeṣāṃ śambhuliṅgānāṃ sthāpitānāṃ varānane naśyed vilvaphalenāpi tasmāt tatparivarjayet someśvarañca kedāraṃ manīṣaṃ kāmamīśvaram divyeśañcaiva jalpīśaṃ nandīśaṃ kakudeśvaram cyavanākhyaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ koṭīśaṃ siddhināyakam prakīrtitāḥ nayet saugavatīrthañca snāpayedarṣajairjalaiḥ tatra dṛṣṭvā naro nārīṃ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt pūjayedvidhivad devaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvātha kaścana vasante viṣuve yātrāṃ kuryānnīlācalaṃ prati kuryād hi divase yātrāṃ vittake ayanaṃ vinā

māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ nayecca dakṣiṇāṃ diśam varṣāsu caturo māsān caturdaśyāṃ divāgame darśayeddivyayānañca tatra dṛṣṭvā ca muktibhāk kapilāśatadānena yatphalaṃ puṣkare smṛtam kanyāśatapradānena yat phalaṃ makare ravau validānena vidhivad yatphalaṃ samudāhṛtam suvarṇaśataniṣkena dattena yatphalaṃ smṛtam pañcamyāṃ tvamāvasyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ grahaṇeṣu ca tatra dṛṣṭvāsanaṃ dhānyaṃ sarvaṃ hanti na saṃśayaḥ vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa pratipuṣpeṇa pūjayet paśūnāṃ pataye caiva divyeśāya namo'stu te tryambakāya trinetrāya vaibhavāya namo namaḥ daṇḍine śaṅkukarṇāya kāmaratnāya vai namaḥ vilohitāya dhūmrāya kamalāya namo namaḥ nama stutāya guhyāya gopeśāya namo namaḥ namo jyeṣṭhāya proṣṭhāya gopeśāya namo namaḥ pañcāṅgīyavihaṅgāya divyeśāya namo namaḥ yajñavāhāya daṇḍāya divyeśāya namo namaḥ yatphalaṃ snānadānena devatāprekṣaṇena ca natvā tīrthaṃ named dūrān naraścodaṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ pāpagrastamacetanam namaḥ śivāya śāntāya sarvapāpaharāya ca nābhimātrajale sthitvā vidhivad devatāpitṝn ūrdhvabāhuṃ tataḥ kṛtvā utthāyārghyaṃ nivedayet mānasañca tato gacchet kuverācaladakṣiṇe

tatra svacchodakaṃ kuṇḍaṃ śivasya vivaraṃ smṛtam [subham] śivamānasadeveśa yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam anena vidhivat snātvā sva [ṣat] pitṝṃśca pratarpayet tvamāpaḥ saritāṃnātha jagat kāraṇasattamam ityanena tu mantreṇa snāyāde [snāpayeccaṃ] tannivedayet dhanuraṣṭapramāṇañca kuṇḍaṃ vārāṇasīyakam sāgarebhyaḥ samuddhṛtya jalamekīkṛtaṃ tvayi manteṇa snātvā vidhivaddadyādarghyaṃ vibhūtaye sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sa gacchet tridaśālayam tarpayet pīṭhadevāṃśca sarvān bandhāṃśca yatnataḥ prayañcha kāmānatulān pāpācca trāhi sarvataḥ brahmaśailasya vāyavye nātidūre vyavasthitam mantreṇa snātvā deveśi dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram mārkaṇḍeyo muniśreṣṭhastapastepe mahāmatiḥ kalpavṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā sakṛt kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam namo vyaktasvarūpāya mahāpralayavāsine pāṭhaḥ adhikaḥ] paśyed devañca divyeśaṃ muktirnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ dakṣiṇāśāsamārohānmahābhayakaraṃ bhavet uttare caiva dhanavān jāyate mama sundari mūlamantreṇa sampūjya devaṃ divyeśvaraṃ haram trilocana namastestu namaste nāgabhūṣaṇa mārkaṇḍeyahrade devi vārāṇasīhrade tathā chāyāṃ tasya samākramya kalpavṛkṣasya pārvati dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtaṃ brahmatoyasamaṃ param

saṃjapet śatarudrīyaṃ kañcid vedādikaṃ japet govindo brahmaṇaścaiva pāripātraḥ subhadrakaḥ ādityaśca kaseruśca manaśca mānasastathā agrataḥ pūrvabhāge tu nīlaśca kumudastathā (rāmaśca lakṣmaṇaścaiva śubhado |)] kuruśca dharmarūpaśca kāhālo lona eva ca kamalaḥ kāmadhenuśca haraśca makarandakaḥ ete lauhityasyānte [ete vai madhyaprānte tu] tu paścimādiṣu kīrtitāḥ āgneye jālaśailaśca aiśānye rākṣasācalaḥ sahasraṃ vārāṇasīkṣetraṃ śṛṇu cāntargṛhaṃ priye nārohenmalabhadrañca mahāpātakamāpnuyāt etadantargṛhaṃ devi sarvatīrthamayaṃ smṛtam duṣkṛtaṃ yanmaheśāni kalpe brahmavadhaiḥ samam taddurlabhaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvanti na saṃśayaḥ so'pi duḥkhavinirmukto muktimāpnoti mānavaḥ [durlabhām] atra dehaṃ parityajya te'pi yānti parāṃ gatim amuktāstan na paśyanti muktāḥ paśyanti cetasā tatra pivan na sevante saṃsārabhayamocakam bhaviṣyanti sadādevi dharmāśrayavivarjitāḥ sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kalau yuge bhadrapīṭhaṃ praviṣṭasya tat sarvaṃ vrajati kṣayam janmāntarasahasreṣu puṇya-yānamavāpnuyāt tat sarvañcaiva paurastyaṃ caureṇāpi hṛtañca yat mahākūle [mahātīrthe] nimagnañca tat kulaṃ pāralaukikam antargṛhaṃ samāsādya te yānti paramāṃ gatim

tatra snātvā brahmalokaṃ na paśyed yamasādanam mayūre caiva divyeśaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam pāripātre sthitā durgā tasyā mantreṇa pūjayet vijaye ca jayantākhyaṃ nāgakaṃ mama lakṣaṇam kaśeruśaile yogīśaḥ mānase manasā śivā kārtikākhye mahāśaile'tyugrastatra [yadyugrastatra] nāyakaḥ gayāśiro gayāśaile viṣṇoścaiva padadvayam kṛṣṇaśaile sthitaḥ kṛṣṇo vanaśaile vanastathā subhadre nīlavāsī ca mandare ca janārdanaḥ kuberaśaile padmākṣi śivaviṣṇorviladvayam dharmaśaile mahāyūpe devī kāmeśvarī sthitā lolākhye jambhakeśaśca liṅge paśupatīśvaraḥ kamale kamalaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmadhenau tu keśavaḥ kāmaśaile sthitā sītā anasūyāśrame priye prapitāmahaśca gomedhe gavākṣe viṣṇuravyayaḥ tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kāmakuṇḍasya dakṣiṇe sampūjya gandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyacandanaiḥ jāgaraṃ kurute tatra sa yāti paramāṃ gatim tasyāḥ svacchodakaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate dhanuṣāñca tathā koṭī rakṣyate gaṇanāyakaiḥ kṛttivāseśvaro devo draṣṭavyaśca punaḥ punaḥ te dhanyāste kṛtārthāśca taiḥ prāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca nīlaśailasya pāścātye dakṣiṇe'pyatha suvrate tatra sthitvā nimeṣañca sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet

daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ tatra vāsena tatphalam tena devamanuṣyeṣu seturvārkastu gīyate sūryatīrthamiti khyātaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśakam stutiṃ kuryācca stotreṇa nīlakaṇṭhe kadācana namaḥ kapālamālāya divyeśāya namo namaḥ mayūraguhāvāsāya divyeśāya namo namaḥ śaśāṅkādityanetrāya divyeśāya namo namaḥ khaṭvāṅgaśūlaḍamaruvilasadvāhave namaḥ gopeśvarāya varadāya namo namaste gatvā snātvā ca vidhivanmantreṇānena sādhakaḥ sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ snānamātreṇa mānavaḥ pāṣāṇenāvṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ hastapañcadaśāyatam adhastāt samasūtrañca kuṇḍaṃ vārāṇasīyakam mucyate pātakairghoraiḥ saptajanmārjitairapi vāsudevasarastatra snātvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet [pradam] brahmācalaṃ tato gatvā brāhmaṇān tatra pūjayet tatra snātvā navamyāñca brahmaloke mahīyate aṣṭadhanvantaraṃ yāvat pañcadhanvantaraṃ tathā bhāskarākhyaṃ saraḥ pūrve paṅktidhanvantaraṃ viduḥ śakrarūpī śilā tatra tasya madhye vyavasthitaḥ tataḥ ṣaṣṭirdhanurmānaṃ tīrthaṃ sārasvataṃ param dvāviṃśaddhanurākīrṇamamṛtākhyantu vai saraḥ tate'nu krauñcatīrthañca dhanuraṣṭapramāṇataḥ tato'ṣṭadhanurākīrṇaṃ nandikuṇḍaṃ samujjvalam dhanuḥ saptadaśaṃ yāvad ūrdhvāśārāsakaṃ (vāsaka) saraḥ

trayodaśyāñca snānena śivalokañca gacchati nāsti tena samaṃ tīrthaṃ yamunāyā na saṃśayaḥ kuṇḍaṃ hāri saṃjñakañca snātvā kratusamaṃ phalam ṛṣidhanvantare pūrve puṣkarācaladakṣiṇe durgākūpañca tatraiva kālahastapramāṇataḥ pūrve nagācale tatra sthāne śrīpuruṣottame gayākuṇḍajale devi gajavaddhi dhanurmitam sarvapāpavinirmukto mucyate vai ṛṇatrayāt tatra snātvārcayelliṅgaṃ na yāti bhāskarībhayam tatraiva mānasaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇe caiva jānīhi paśyet siddheśvarīṃ yoniṃ raktapāṣāṇarūpiṇīm atyādakṣiṇabhāge tu nātidūre ca saṃsthitā kāmakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā kāmānāpnoti nityaśaḥ astahastamitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pāṣāṇatrayamadhyagam madhyāhne lavaṇaṃ vā tu aparāhṇe tu kṛṣṇakam yā dhārā kāmakuṇḍasya jaṭodakā prakīrtitā dakṣiṇe śivakuṇḍasya yā dhārā sā viyannadī vahnikūṭasya madhye tu yā dhārā giriniḥsṛtā paścime makarandasya niḥsṛtā bhūmipīṭhagā vakrakūṭasya yā ghārā sā vijñeyā ca gomatī taduttare saptadhārā dhanuḥ saptatrayāntare snātvā ca vāruṇe kuṇḍe vārurṇa lokamāpnuyāt saptahastamitaṃ liṅgamāyāme cākṣihastakam tasmādīśānakāṣṭhāyāṃ vahnikūṭe'nalaṃ śivam lauhityapāyasi snātvā āruhya vahniparvatam

vahnikūṭasya vāyavye sarpākārastu tad [sarpākārastadā] giriḥ purastād bhairavasyātha kuṇḍaṃ mānasasaṃjñakam tasya tīre girivaro nando vipulaparvataḥ ekākṣareṇa haṃsena pūjayed vṛṣabhadhvajam mayūrad vāyukoṇe ca dhanuṣāṃ saptakaṃ mitam tato gacchet svargadvāraṃ kāmadīśān tato diśi upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet dhanustrayaṃ mayūrasya antike nandanaṃ smṛtam tasyottare brahmasaro mūrtirgośca saraḥ śubham tato gacchenmaheśāni varāhasya biladvayam [vilatrayam] tatra gatvā caturdaśyāṃ lauhitye parikīrtitam ekahaṃseśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ madhye tu parikīrtitam ekahaṃseśvare snātvā gosahasraphalaṃ labhet tīrthaṃ rāmahradaṃ tatra aṣṭaṣaṣṭirdhanurmitam kṛtakṛtyo bhaved devi aśvamedhañca vindati tasmin pañcahrade snātvā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ ravikandarpayormadhye yā dhārā sā sarasvatī tatra snātvā mahāmādhyāṃ prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam jyotiṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ samyak samaśnute taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet arcayitvā mahādevamupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ tato vrajenmayūrañca pūrvāśābhimukhena tu pade pade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ bhavati dharmataḥ mayūraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ girirūpadharaṃ harim kalpakoṭiśatasthāya kalpavṛkṣadharāya ca

mayūragirimāruhya dakṣiṇaṃ sāgaraṃ mayā namaste brahmaputrāya namaḥ śantanusūnave mayūragirimāruhya paśyato vihagācalam tadā abhīkṣṇaṃ deveśi brāhmaṇānāñca sampadaḥ tadā tu makare rājye hāhākāraśca jāyate yadā bhavati deveśi cāturvarṇasya sampadaḥ tadā tu kṣatriyo rājā dharmarājye sthiro bhavet pañcavarṣāntare devi jalpīśaścāti mlecchakaḥ yadā tu dakṣiṇe tasya krūro rājā bhavedanu tadā pariharedvāso bhadrapīṭhe viśeṣataḥ saṃśayaḥ tadā pṛthvī bhaved bhogyā bhaviṣyati phalādhikā bhānave'rghyaṃ tato dadyād brāhmaṇān bhojayet tataḥ tatra snātvā maheśāni tiryag yonau na jāyate ca tridivaṃ) | pāṭhaḥ keṣucit pāṇḍulipiṣu nāsti] vrajet tasyāñca parvaṇi snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati kapotakuṇḍasambhūtā kapilenāvatāritā tasyāḥ pūrve ca krośānte divyanāmā sarasvatī ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāntyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ yadā pūrvamukhaṃ yāti brāhmaṇānāṃ bhayantadā yadā aiśānye gamanaṃ mahāmārī tadā bhavet paścimasthāśca ye kecid dhana-dhānya-kṣayo bhavet tatra vāsaṃ na kuryācca dūrataḥ parivarjayet tasmin snāne bhaved yaddhi vāyurlakṣmīḥ pravardhate yāvacca bandhanamurvyāstāvad kulaṃ śapanti ca

nadīnirodhake toye yastu snānaṃ samācaret tasyāḥ paścima-bhāge tu dakṣiṇe parameśvari tasyāḥ sampūjanādeva sarvān kāmānavāpsyate tatra liṅgaṃ gaṇeśasya pūjayitvā śriyaṃ labhet yonirūpāṃ mahāmāyāṃ pūjayed bhaktitatparaḥ dviputra iti vikhyātastatra snātvā divaṃ vrajet sā dhārā tāpinī nāma snātvā naśyati pātakam niḥsṛtā sarvapāpaghnī digvāsā nāma viśrutā tasyāṃ snātvā mandireṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati kārttikyāṃ grahaṇe caiva ayane viṣuve tathā kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ yaḥ snāyāt parameśvari bhaumavāre caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāñca śanaiścare namaste sarvapāpaghni svacche svacchāmbuvāhini tadvatśrāntaṃ sadānantaṃ pārśvaṃ daśasu varddhitag snātvānena tu mantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ samāhitaḥ muṇḍanañca tataḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ samācaret digvāsālokavikhyātā tīrthānāmuttamā nadī tārayet sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca śāṅkari sadevāsuragandharvā ṛṣayastu tapodhanāḥ prātaḥ snātvā naro yastu niyamastho jitendriyaḥ yojanaśatasāhasraṃ śrūyate sariduttamā brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ evaṃ dharmasamācāro yastu pāpān parityajet śatavarṣasamaṃ prāṇī svarge modeta śāṅkari divyagandhaiśca liptaśca divyapuṣpopaśobhitaḥ

tataḥ svargāt paribhraṣṭo rājate vā sa dhārmikaḥ stambhairmaṇimayairdivyairdhvajavaidūryabhūṣitam reje vāgīśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvastrījanavallabhaḥ saṅgame tīrtharajasya bhuktiṃ muktiñca vindati tasyāñca vidhivat snātvā śivaloke mahīyate aśoka[soma]kuṇḍe daśamyāñca yaḥ snāyāt parameśvari somasya duhitā kanyā cyavanena ca pālitā tataḥ kagyāśramo nāma sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham dhanurdvādaśakaṃ yāvad antaḥ kṣetraṃ maheśvari rudrasya ca tathā viṣṇoḥ krauñcasya ca gaṇasya ca vāsavasya tathā śyāmaṃ pāṣāṇābhaṃ paraṃ priye yadā viṣṇupadaṃ raktaṃ dṛśyate parameśvari tasyottare mahāpuṇyaṃ tathā rudrapadaṃ priye virājapaṃ [vivarjayet] vidhānañca tasmādatra samācaret tārayet saptagotrāṇi kulamekottaraṃ śatam sarvalokaviśuddhātmā brahmaloke mahīyate jñānaṃ pāśupataṃ prāpya yastu dehaṃ parityajet asmin kṣetre ca ekāgre lauhitye virajeṣu ca siddhācale maheśāni paścimābhikrameṇa tu nāradasya ca tatraiva tīrthaṃ paramadurlabham tapastaptaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ nāradena mahātmanā [surarṣiṇā] brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tena brahmasara [brahmeśvara] iti śrutam rāmatīrthaṃ tato gatvā svajanānmucyate bhayāt tāmreśvaraṃ [bhāseśvaraṃ] tato gacchet sarvavyādhivināśanam tato gacchet pūrvabhāgaṃ piṅgaleśvaramuttamam

tasmin tīrthe ca deveśi kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate akṣayaṃ modate svarge yāvaccanbradivākarau te muktāḥ svargamāyānti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā nivartitā purā tena vahantī sā mahānadī pradakṣiṇe tu yaḥ kuryāt yasmin kṣetre maheśvari tasyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge iṣukṣepadaśāṣṭake āmrasyādhaḥ sthitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanuḥ ṣoḍaśakaṃ mitam bhūmipīṭhe sthitaṃ devaṃ śaṅkaraṃ parameśvaram siddhacāraṇa-gandharva-kinnarāśca mahoragāḥ pūrve brahmasaraścaiva uttare pārvatīvaṭaḥ etanmadhyagataṃ kṣetraṃ sugandhaṃ nāti-viśrutam snātvā ca dikkarāyinyāṃ saṃspṛśet pārvatīvaṭam tāraṃ ca maṅgalaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsaṃ śravaṇavādanam chando'nuṣṭuv bhavo deva ityārthe viniyojayet khaṭvāṅgañcaiva śūlañca varadañcābhayaṃ tathā sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ sarvālaṅkāramaṇḍitam pīṭheśān pūjayedagre yaddigīśān bahiryajet devasyottarabhāge tu nātidūre vyavasthitam tatrābhiṣekaṃ kuryāttu pitṝdevārcane rataḥ triśūlatīrthayāmye ca dhanuḥ ṣaṣṭeranantaram samabhyarcya tataścaitre māsi kṛṣṇe viśeṣataḥ varjayenmuṇḍanañcātra tathā kanyāśrameṣu ca tato vrajet kulakṣetraṃ devyāḥ kṣetraṃ sudurlabham devasyaiśānyabhāge tu saṃsthitā parameśvarī

manasā prārthitān kāmān labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ baddhvā jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥ namo'nugrahakartre ca nāgeśāya namo namaḥ puruṣāya namaste'stu nāgeśāya namo namaḥ namastrailokyanāthāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥ namaḥ cakreśasaṃjñāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥ namastriśūlahastāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥ kalākalādhināthāya nāgeśāya namo namaḥ tatra devaṃ tryambakākhyaṃ liṅgaṃ mūrtigataṃ param bhūmipīṭhe vyavasthānaṃ tāreṇa pratipūjayet saṃspṛśet dharmāraṇyaṃ mahākṣetraṃ gacchet tatra maheśvari nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nānāpuṣpopaśobhitam eko viṣṇustathā cendro [candro] vidyādharagaṇairvṛtaḥ māsi māsi tu dvādaśyāṃ yo drakṣyati mama priye devasya paścime bhāge viṣṇoḥ puṣkaratīrthakam paurṇamāsyāṃ tu jyaiṣṭhasya yastu yātrāṃ samācaret mahājyaiṣṭhyāntu yaḥ paśyenmādhavantu nareśvaram śikhidhvajānte yo jātaḥ śālo nāma bhaven nṛpaḥ bālaprāyo yadā tatra kaivartaśca vināśakaḥ ekadvivarṣe sa bhaved droheṇaiva svayaṃ [tato] hataḥ yadā punarbhavo jātastasminneva bhavennṛpaḥ yadā tu yavano rājā vāṇaśūnyaśca vatsaraḥ yadā kalerbhavedrājā tasmin kāmasamudbhavaḥ lakṣmīnārāyaṇo nāma bhavedvaṃśonnataḥ sutaḥ
